summary.zh: 机器人要利用环境中的凳子、箱子、坡道、平台或工具改变自己的工作空间，从高处或深处取出目标箱，返回地面后把它完整送入交付区 D、释放并保持稳定。22 项任务覆盖 G1＋Dex3、换装五指手的 G1、A3、轮式 R1 和 Stretch 3，包括只能推的支撑、多候选选择、钩子取物、同色替身和窄门洞。另有三项不可完成对照（H1S-06、H1S-09、H1S-11.C），正确行为是不取物、空手进入 Q 区停稳。
summary.en: The robot must use stools, boxes, ramps, platforms or tools in the scene to change its own workspace, take a target box from a high or deep place, come back down and deliver it wholly into zone D, released and stable. The 22 tasks cover G1 + Dex3, G1 with a five-finger hand, A3, the wheeled R1 and Stretch 3, including push-only supports, choosing among candidates, hook retrieval, same-colour decoys and a narrow doorway. Three infeasible controls (H1S-06, H1S-09, H1S-11.C) require the robot not to retrieve but to exit empty-handed into zone Q and stand still.

acceptance.zh: 作者于 2026-11-02 验收通过当前修订参考范围：22/22 项计完成，其中 19 项完整参考、3 项简化场景（H1S-02、H1S-05、H1S-13）。原 G1 双层登高取物与连续交付仍未通过；H1S-05 按作者授权改为 G1/A3 单层示范，复用既有完整回合。每项是一次从原始起点开始的特权专家连续物理运行，关节越限、力矩比只记录、不作门槛；不代表严格安全准入、重复成功率或正式准入。
acceptance.en: On 2026-11-02 the author accepted the current revised reference scope: 22/22 tasks counted complete, 19 as full references and 3 as simplified scenes (H1S-02, H1S-05, H1S-13). The original G1 two-tier climb with continuous delivery is still not passed; with the author's authorisation H1S-05 became a G1/A3 single-tier demonstration reusing existing complete episodes. Each task is one continuous physics run of a privileged expert from the original start; joint overrun and effort ratio are recorded, not gated. This is not strict safety admission, a repeat-success rate or formal admission.

axes.zh: 身体与手（G1＋Dex3、官方 G1 换 Inspire／Dex3-1、A3、轮式 R1、Stretch 3）；支撑与工具的种类和布置方式（搬凳、推箱、坡道＋平台、中转箱、钩子）；目标高度、深度与公开 2 kg 搬举限额；候选与干扰（多个支撑、同色替身）；工作区约束（固定挡块、门洞、封板）；可解与不可解的孪生对照。
axes.en: Body and hand (G1 + Dex3, official G1 with Inspire vs Dex3-1, A3, wheeled R1, Stretch 3); type and placement of supports and tools (carried stool, pushed box, ramp plus platform, transfer box, hook); target height and depth against the public 2 kg lift limit; candidates and distractors (several supports, same-colour decoys); workspace constraints (fixed block, doorway, sealing panels); solvable versus infeasible twins.

embodiments.zh: Unitree G1 29 自由度＋Dex3 三指手（原 H1 使用的历史 Menagerie 模型）
embodiments.en: Unitree G1 29-DoF with Dex3 three-finger hands (the historical Menagerie model used by the original H1)

embodiments.zh: 官方 Unitree G1 rev1.0 身体，Inspire DFQ 五指手与 Dex3-1 三指手同身体对照
embodiments.en: Official Unitree G1 rev1.0 body, Inspire DFQ five-finger hands compared with Dex3-1 on the same body

embodiments.zh: 智元 A3 Ultra T3.0 双足人形（五指手）
embodiments.en: Agibot A3 Ultra T3.0 biped humanoid (five-finger hands)

embodiments.zh: Galaxea R1 轮式双臂机器人（可调躯干；模型许可不完整，仅内部使用，网格不公开）
embodiments.en: Galaxea R1 wheeled dual-arm robot (adjustable torso; licence incomplete, internal use only, meshes not published)

embodiments.zh: Stretch 3（SE3，标准夹爪）：单伸缩臂装在升降柱上，轮式底盘
embodiments.en: Stretch 3 (SE3, standard gripper): one telescoping arm on a lift, wheeled base

title.zh: G1 原版：搬凳登高取物
title.en: G1 original: carry a stool, climb and retrieve

conditions.zh: 原 H1 冻结配置，单一固定场景，从原始起点运行；目标红箱放在 1.25 m 层板上，地面够不到；公开搬举限额 2 kg；交付区 D 在地面（0.6×0.6 m）。特权专家读取仿真真值，机器人自碰撞关闭（同原 H1）；仿真预算 1200 s。
conditions.en: Unmodified frozen configuration of the original H1, one fixed scene, run from the original start; the red target box sits on the 1.25 m shelf, out of reach from the floor; public lift limit 2 kg; delivery zone D on the floor (0.6 x 0.6 m). Privileged expert reading simulator state, robot self-collision off (as in the original H1); simulation budget 1200 s.

design.zh: 折叠凳停在离柜约 1 m 处。机器人要把凳子搬到柜前放稳，登凳取下目标，放到 0.90 m 层板上中转，空手下凳，再从地面重新抓起目标送入 D。
design.en: The folding stool starts about 1 m from the cabinet. The robot carries it to the cabinet front and sets it down, climbs it and takes the target, places the target on the 0.90 m board, steps down empty-handed, then re-grasps the target from the floor and delivers it into D.

tools.zh: 折叠凳（1.5 kg，可搬）
tools.en: Folding stool (1.5 kg, liftable)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 1003.1 s，原冻结评分 1.0，链条完整、无安全事件。按原评分规则在约 0.72 m 高处松手，箱子侧躺落定于 D。新运行 3 次中 2 次通过，另一次在放凳阶段规划失败。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 1003.1 s, original frozen rubric score 1.0, chain complete, no safety events. As the original rubric allows, the box is released from about 0.72 m and settles on its side in D. 2 of 3 fresh runs passed; the other failed when the stool set-down plan was infeasible.

title.zh: G1 手型对照（简化）：Inspire 五指手与 Dex3-1
title.en: G1 hand comparison (simplified): Inspire five-finger vs Dex3-1

conditions.zh: 简化场景。同一官方 G1 rev1.0 身体、同一世界、载荷、观测和预算，只换手（Inspire DFQ 与 Dex3-1），各手可用自己的抓持控制器。无把手宽箱 0.24×0.50×0.18 m、2.0 kg，放在合适臂高（0.73 m）的窄台座上；D 是较低的 0.60 m 平台。特权专家；仿真预算 180 s。
conditions.en: Simplified scene. Same official G1 rev1.0 body, world, payload, sensing and budget; only the hand changes (Inspire DFQ vs Dex3-1), each with its own grasp controller. A wide handleless box, 0.24 x 0.50 x 0.18 m and 2.0 kg, rests on a narrow pedestal at good arm height (0.73 m); D is a lower slab at 0.60 m. Privileged expert; simulation budget 180 s.

design.zh: 双手从两侧夹住宽箱，手指勾住伸出的底边，取下后后退约 1 m，沿 1 m 半径弧线搬运，下蹲把箱子放到 D 平台上，松手、后退站稳。原设计中的支撑布置和登高不在本场景内。
design.en: Both hands squeeze the box sides with the fingers hooked under the overhanging bottom edge; the robot backs out about 1 m, carries the box along a 1 m-radius arc, squats to place it on the D slab, releases and steps back to stand. The support placement and climbing of the original design are not part of this scene.

embodiment.zh: 官方 Unitree G1 rev1.0＋Inspire 五指手（对照 Dex3-1）
embodiment.en: Official Unitree G1 rev1.0 + Inspire five-finger hands (vs Dex3-1)

result.zh: 简化完成（Inspire）：164.3 s，箱子完整在 D 平台上、已释放，机器人站稳。Inspire 四次运行轨迹逐位相同；同一控制器下 Dex3-1 四次仅一次完成，同条件对照运行中箱子在停步时滑落。Inspire 手指速度按官方规格审计最高 1.03 倍，按 URDF 的 0.5 rad/s 计为 5.5 倍；仅取放宽箱，无支撑布置或登高。
result.en: Simplified completion (Inspire): 164.3 s, box wholly on the D slab, released, robot standing still. The four Inspire runs are bitwise identical; with the same controller the Dex3-1 completed 1 of 4 runs, and in the matched run the box slipped out at the walking stop. Inspire finger speeds peak at 1.03x the official spec (5.5x against the URDF value of 0.5 rad/s); pick-and-place of the wide box only, no support placement or climbing.

title.zh: 轮式 R1＋斜坡取物
title.en: Wheeled R1 with a ramp

conditions.zh: Galaxea R1。斜坡起始未就位（偏短 0.5 m、横向偏 0.25 m，朝向已对齐）；0.5 kg 目标在约 2.2 m 高的柜顶，证书表明从地面任何站姿都够不到；D 在 0.90 m 桌面上。URDF 没有轮子力矩／速度限值，由轨道声明。特权专家；仿真预算 400 s。
conditions.en: Galaxea R1. The ramp starts out of place (0.5 m short, 0.25 m to the side, already yaw-aligned); the 0.5 kg target sits on top of a cabinet at about 2.2 m and a certificate shows it cannot be reached from any floor pose; D is on a 0.90 m table. The URDF has no wheel effort/velocity limits, so the track declared them. Privileged expert; simulation budget 400 s.

design.zh: 机器人用两只夹爪抓住斜坡的把手柱，把斜坡拖到 0.30 m 平台前搭接好，沿 12° 坡道驶上平台，伸高手臂水平抓取目标，再带载倒车下坡，把目标放入桌面 D 并松手。
design.en: The robot grips the ramp by its two handle posts, drags it to the 0.30 m platform and docks it, drives up the 12-degree ramp, raises the arm and grasps the target horizontally, reverses down loaded and places the target in D on the table.

tools.zh: 可拖动斜坡（带把手柱）
tools.en: Draggable ramp with handle posts

tools.zh: 柜前 0.30 m 平台
tools.en: 0.30 m platform at the cabinet

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 wheeled dual-arm

result.zh: 成功：175.3 s，目标在桌面 D 内、已释放，机器人与目标静止 10.6 s，无跌倒。所有关节在 URDF 速度限值内（靠指令限幅并实测确认）；轮子与 arm_joint1 力矩达到限幅上限。R1 模型许可不完整，仅内部使用。
result.en: Success: 175.3 s, target in D on the table, released, robot and target still for 10.6 s, no fall. All joints stay within the URDF velocity limits (slew-limited commands, measured); the wheels and arm_joint1 run at their clipped effort limits. The R1 model licence is incomplete; internal use only.

title.zh: A3 登高取物
title.en: A3 climb and retrieve

conditions.zh: 智元 A3 Ultra T3.0，已声明的 A3 提手轻箱场景：0.35 kg 带提手目标放在 1.69 m 高的柜顶；支撑箱 0.25 m 高、6 kg、顶面 0.45×0.60 m，起始未就位；公开搬举限额 2 kg；D 在地面（0.6×0.8 m）。骨盆／躯干碰撞保持开启；仿真预算 480 s。
conditions.en: Agibot A3 Ultra T3.0 in the declared A3 light handle-box scene: a 0.35 kg target with a handle sits on top of a 1.69 m cabinet; the support box is 0.25 m tall, 6 kg, with a 0.45 x 0.60 m top, not yet in place; public lift limit 2 kg; D on the floor (0.6 x 0.8 m). Pelvis/torso collision stays enabled; simulation budget 480 s.

design.zh: 机器人用脚把支撑箱沿地面推到柜前，双脚登上箱顶并调整站位，用右手钩住提手取下目标，带载后退下箱，再退步走回把目标放入 D、松手站稳。
design.en: The robot foot-pushes the support box along the floor to the cabinet, steps up with both feet and adjusts its stance, hooks the target handle with the right hand and lifts it off, steps down backward while loaded, then walks back, lowers the target into D, releases and stands still.

tools.zh: 支撑箱 0.25 m、6 kg（可推，不可搬）
tools.en: Support box 0.25 m, 6 kg (pushable, not liftable)

embodiment.zh: 智元 A3 Ultra T3.0
embodiment.en: Agibot A3 Ultra T3.0

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 343.1 s，目标完整在地面 D 内、已释放，机器人直立静止，无跌倒。专家采用低腰俯仰规划与横向站位调整，未修改机器人或执行器。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 343.1 s, target wholly in D on the floor, released, robot upright and still, no fall. The expert uses low-waist planning and a lateral stance adjustment; robot and actuators unchanged.

title.zh: 单层登高与连续交付示范：G1（简化）
title.en: Single-tier climb and continuous delivery demo: G1 (simplified)

conditions.zh: 按作者授权的 r10 修订，原“G1 两层阶梯、A3 一层”改为两机型各自的单层示范。G1＋Dex3；5 kg、0.221 m 支撑箱按 2 kg 搬举限额只能推；目标在 1.25 m 层板；D 在地面（0.6×0.6 m）。允许中转、空手下降和地面再抓取。柜高、载荷与 A3 场景不同，不作同场景比较。
conditions.en: Under the author-authorised r10 revision, the original "G1 two tiers, A3 one tier" task became a single-tier demonstration for each body. G1 + Dex3; the 5 kg, 0.221 m support may only be pushed under the 2 kg lift limit; target on the 1.25 m shelf; D on the floor (0.6 x 0.6 m). Staging, an empty-handed descent and a floor re-grasp are allowed. Cabinet height and payload differ from the A3 scene, so this is not a matched-scene comparison.

design.zh: 复用 H1S-07.P2 的完整回合：把支撑箱推到工作位，单级登上，取下目标，放到 0.90 m 板上中转，空手下降，从地面再抓取并送入原 D。
design.en: Reuses the complete H1S-07.P2 episode: push the support to the work position, climb one tier, take the target, stage it on the 0.90 m board, descend empty-handed, re-grasp it from the floor and deliver it to the original D.

tools.en: Support box 0.44 x 0.42 x 0.221 m, 5 kg (push only)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 简化完成：一次连续运行 586.2 s，双脚在支撑上连续 74.5 s，目标在 D 内、已释放，末端稳定 7.2 s，无跌倒。没有新运行，复用的回合计划在原运行前写定；原 G1 双层任务仍未通过，最近一次在下层落地的支撑转换中失败。
result.en: Simplified completion: one continuous run of 586.2 s, both feet on the support for 74.5 s, target in D, released, stable for 7.2 s at the end, no fall. No new run: the reused episode had its plan written before it ran. The original G1 two-tier task is still not passed; the latest attempt failed in the support transfer when stepping from the lower tier to the floor.

title.zh: 单层登高与连续交付示范：A3（简化）
title.en: Single-tier climb and continuous delivery demo: A3 (simplified)

conditions.zh: r10 修订的 A3 部分，沿用原 H1S-05 的 A3 一层场景：两块相同的 0.25 m、6 kg 台阶箱起始均未就位；0.35 kg 提手目标在 1.69 m 柜顶；D 在地面（0.6×0.8 m）；公开搬举限额 2 kg；仿真预算 480 s。
conditions.en: A3 half of the r10 revision, in the original H1S-05 A3 one-tier scene: two identical 0.25 m, 6 kg step boxes, neither in place; a 0.35 kg handled target on top of a 1.69 m cabinet; D on the floor (0.6 x 0.8 m); public lift limit 2 kg; simulation budget 480 s.

design.zh: 选一块台阶箱推到柜前，单级登上，钩取高处目标，带载下台，送入原 D 并站稳。
design.en: Choose one step box and push it to the cabinet, climb one tier, hook the high target, step down loaded, deliver it to the original D and stand still.

tools.zh: 两块台阶箱 0.25 m、6 kg（可推）
tools.en: Two step boxes, 0.25 m and 6 kg each (pushable)

embodiment.zh: 智元 A3 Ultra T3.0
embodiment.en: Agibot A3 Ultra T3.0

result.zh: 简化完成：一次连续运行 343.6 s，目标在 D 内、已释放，3 s 窗口内目标与机器人静止，无跌倒。最大关节越限约 12.9 mrad、峰值速度比约 1.22，只记录、不作门槛。只作示范，不作两层必要性或同场景能力比较。
result.en: Simplified completion: one continuous run of 343.6 s, target in D, released, target and robot still through the 3 s window, no fall. Max joint overrun about 12.9 mrad and peak speed ratio about 1.22, recorded but not gated. A demonstration only, not a claim about two-tier necessity or a matched-scene comparison.

title.zh: 封板不可解与退出
title.en: Sealed compartment: infeasible, exit

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界。目标红箱（0.18×0.20×0.16 m）在 0.90 m 板上，但所在隔间被四块固定封板封住，固定件之间的缝隙都小于 3 cm；场景里没有工具，唯一的凳子停在房间外。正确行为是不碰物体、空手进入 Q 区停稳。仿真预算 300 s。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world. The red target box (0.18 x 0.20 x 0.16 m) sits on the 0.90 m board, but its compartment is closed by four fixed panels and every gap between fixed parts is under 3 cm; the scene has no tools and the only stool is parked outside the room. The correct behaviour is to touch nothing and exit empty-handed into the Q zone, standing still. Simulation budget 300 s.

design.zh: 机器人走到柜前观察，确认目标无法取出后空手走进 Q 区并停稳。运行前写好的路线证书逐类排除直接抓取、支撑登高、工具、推拉或晃动柜体与封板、从侧缝伸入移动目标等所有路线。
design.en: The robot walks to the cabinet, observes, concludes the target cannot be taken out, and walks empty-handed into Q and stops. A route certificate written before the run excludes every route class: direct grasp, supports and climbing, tools, pushing or shaking the cabinet and panels, and moving the target through a side slot.

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

refusal_note.zh: 目标被固定封板完全封住，任何合法路线都无法把它取出送到 D。可解孪生是去掉四块封板的同一世界（已完成交付，不是本目录中的 case）。
refusal_note.en: The target is fully enclosed by fixed panels, so no legal route can bring it out to D. The solvable twin is the same world without the four panels (delivered; not a case in this catalog).

result.zh: 正确退出：26.2 s，机器人整体进入 Q 区、空手，静止约 4.1 s，未倒地。退出判断读取仿真真值几何，不来自感知；不可解来自固定封板，判断很直接，以身体能力为瓶颈的版本尚未做。
result.en: Correct exit: 26.2 s, the whole robot inside Q, empty-handed, still for about 4.1 s, no fall. The decision reads ground-truth geometry, not perception; infeasibility comes from fixed panels and is easy to see, and a version where the bottleneck is the body itself is not built yet.

title.zh: 推箱清路后取物
title.en: Push an obstacle clear, then retrieve

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界：5 kg 障碍箱（0.44×0.42×0.221 m）挡住凳子的工作位，按 2 kg 搬举限额只能推、不能抬；其余同 H1S-01（1.5 kg 折叠凳、1.25 m 层板上的目标、地面 D）。仿真预算 2400 s。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world: a 5 kg obstacle box (0.44 x 0.42 x 0.221 m) blocks the stool work position and, under the 2 kg lift limit, may only be pushed; otherwise as H1S-01 (1.5 kg folding stool, target on the 1.25 m shelf, floor D). Simulation budget 2400 s.

design.zh: 机器人先蹲姿双掌把障碍箱横推进侧方停车区，再绕回凳子后方，搬凳到柜前、登凳取物、在 0.90 m 板上中转、空手下凳、地面再抓取并送入 D。只推开障碍不算完成。
design.en: The robot first pushes the obstacle sideways into a side parking area with both palms from a crouch, walks round behind the stool, carries it to the cabinet, climbs, retrieves, stages the target on the 0.90 m board, steps down empty-handed, re-grasps from the floor and delivers into D. Clearing the obstacle alone is not success.

tools.zh: 障碍箱 5 kg（只能推）
tools.en: Obstacle box, 5 kg (push only)

tools.zh: 折叠凳（1.5 kg，可搬）
tools.en: Folding stool (1.5 kg, liftable)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 1673.3 s，6 次推送把障碍箱推入停车区（从未抬起），目标完整在 D 内、已释放，机器人站稳 7.3 s，未倒地。交接给行走策略时机器人向前踉跄一步，碰到已停放的障碍箱（最大 32 N），踝关节越限 11.5 mrad，原 H1 评分因此判为无效证据；7 次完整运行仅此 1 次通过。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 1673.3 s; six push cycles moved the obstacle into the parking area (never lifted), target wholly in D, released, robot standing still for 7.3 s, no fall. At the hand-over to the walking policy the robot made a forward catch-step and bumped the parked obstacle (up to 32 N), with an 11.5 mrad ankle overrun, so the original H1 rubric marks the run invalid evidence; only 1 of 7 full runs passed.

title.zh: 推箱到位作平台
title.en: Push a box into place as a platform

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界：支撑是与凳子同高同占地的 5 kg 箱（0.44×0.42×0.221 m），按 2 kg 搬举限额只能在地面推；箱子起始离工作位约 0.33 m；目标在 1.25 m 层板，D 在地面。仿真预算 1500 s。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world: the support is a 5 kg box with the stool footprint and height (0.44 x 0.42 x 0.221 m) that may only be pushed along the floor under the 2 kg lift limit; it starts about 0.33 m short of the work position; target on the 1.25 m shelf, D on the floor. Simulation budget 1500 s.

design.zh: 机器人蹲姿双掌把支撑箱推到柜前工作位，起身登上箱顶取下目标，放到 0.90 m 板上中转，空手下箱，地面再抓取并送入 D。
design.en: The robot pushes the support box to the work position at the cabinet with both palms from a crouch, stands, climbs onto it and takes the target, stages it on the 0.90 m board, steps down empty-handed, re-grasps it from the floor and delivers it into D.

tools.en: Support box 0.44 x 0.42 x 0.221 m, 5 kg (push only)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 586.2 s，3 次推送把箱子推到位（从未抬起），目标在 D 内、已释放，机器人站稳 7.2 s。原 H1 评分表不把推箱计为支撑搬运，得分 0.80，支撑就位由本任务的检查确认；另有一次换路线的完整通过。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 586.2 s; three pushes moved the box into place (never lifted), target in D, released, robot standing still for 7.2 s. The original H1 rubric does not credit the push as support relocation (score 0.80), so placement is confirmed by this task's own check; a second full pass with a different route exists.

title.zh: 转角或换侧推箱
title.en: Push around a corner by changing sides

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界：5 kg 支撑箱改为 0.44 m 正方形、只能推；一块固定挡块立在柜前一侧，直推或先沿柜面方向推都会把支撑箱扫到挡块上（几何证明）；目标在 1.25 m 层板，D 在地面。仿真预算 2400 s。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world: the 5 kg support is a 0.44 m square and may only be pushed; a fixed block stands in front of one side of the cabinet, so a straight push, or pushing toward the cabinet first, sweeps the support into the block (geometric proof); target on the 1.25 m shelf, D on the floor. Simulation budget 2400 s.

design.zh: 机器人先从支撑箱一侧把它横推到工作线上，松手退开、绕到另一面重新建立站位，再把它推进工作位；随后登箱取物、在 0.90 m 板上中转、空手下箱、地面再抓取并送入 D。
design.en: The robot first pushes the support sideways onto the work line from one face, releases, backs off and walks round to another face, re-establishes its stance and pushes it into the work position; it then climbs, retrieves, stages the target on the 0.90 m board, steps down empty-handed, re-grasps from the floor and delivers into D.

tools.en: Support box 0.44 x 0.44 x 0.221 m, 5 kg (push only)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 1060.5 s，支撑箱从未抬起、从未碰到挡块（最近 1.6 cm），目标在 D 内、已释放，机器人站稳 7.4 s。0.42 m 深的支撑首次落脚 4/4 摔倒，因此改为 0.44 m 正方形；路线用板上中转代替带载直接返回；仅一次见证、无重复。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 1060.5 s; the support was never lifted and never touched the block (closest 1.6 cm), target in D, released, robot standing still for 7.4 s. With a 0.42 m deep support the first footfall fell in 4 of 4 runs, so the support was made a 0.44 m square; the route uses the board relay instead of a loaded direct return; single witness, no repeat.

title.zh: 抬不起但能推到目标区
title.en: Too heavy to lift, but can be pushed into D

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3。地面目标箱 0.45×0.50×0.18 m、5 kg、无把手，超过公开 2 kg 搬举限额，但允许地面承托推动；D 是地面区域 0.60×0.70 m。不要求高柜取物，也不要求站立收尾；单一场景，仅无把手版本。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3. A 0.45 x 0.50 x 0.18 m, 5 kg handleless box on the floor exceeds the public 2 kg lift limit, but ground-supported pushing is allowed; D is a 0.60 x 0.70 m floor zone. No high-shelf retrieval and no final standing are required; single scene, handleless variant only.

design.zh: 机器人蹲姿双掌推箱，分次推动、撤手、移步，把整箱推入 D 后撤手，下蹲保持。
design.en: From a crouch the robot pushes the box with both palms in repeated push, release and step cycles until the whole box is inside D, then withdraws its hands and holds a crouch.

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：180.0 s，三次推送共推动 0.328 m，箱子完整进入 D、已释放，末端驻留 7.5 s，机器人以蹲姿保持、未倒地。部分细叶契约仍有未通过项，本轮参考验收不要求；不声称机器人物理上抬不动 5 kg。
result.en: Success: 180.0 s; three strokes moved the box 0.328 m, wholly into D, released, final dwell 7.5 s, robot holding a crouch, no fall. Some fine-leaf contracts still fail; they are not required by this reference acceptance. Physical inability to lift 5 kg is not claimed.

title.zh: Stretch 取有把手箱
title.en: Stretch retrieves a handled box

conditions.zh: Stretch 3。1.0 kg 目标箱（0.24×0.20×0.12 m，顶部横把手）放在 0.75 m 高的封闭层架内；D 在地面；公开搬举限额 2 kg（Stretch 3 建议最大载荷），只允许夹爪接触可动物体。与 H1S-09 同一世界，只差目标质量。仿真预算 240 s。
conditions.en: Stretch 3. A 1.0 kg target box (0.24 x 0.20 x 0.12 m, top bar handle) sits inside an enclosed shelf at 0.75 m; D is on the floor; public lift limit 2 kg (Stretch 3 recommended payload), and only the gripper may touch movable objects. Same world as H1S-09 except the target mass. Simulation budget 240 s.

design.zh: 机器人对正底盘，夹爪朝下抓住顶部把手、抬起 3 cm，收回伸缩臂把箱子完全撤出层架，沿通道运送约 1.3 m，伸到 D 上方放到地面并松手，静止至少 3 s。
design.en: The robot aligns its base, grasps the top handle with the gripper pointing down, lifts 3 cm, retracts the telescope to pull the box fully out of the shelf, drives about 1.3 m along the lane, reaches over D, sets the box on the floor, releases and stays still for at least 3 s.

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3
embodiment.en: Stretch 3

refusal_note.zh: 可解孪生：H1S-09 与本任务同一世界，只把目标改为 3.0 kg，正确行为变为退出。
refusal_note.en: Solvable twin of H1S-09: same world, and only the target mass changes to 3.0 kg, which turns the correct behaviour into exit.

result.zh: 成功：73.4 s，目标完整在地面 D 内、与机器人无接触，静止 3 s。腕偏航与升降柱力矩比达 1.0／0.94，伸缩臂速度比 1.12，只记录、不作门槛。
result.en: Success: 73.4 s, target wholly in D on the floor with no robot contact, still for 3 s. Wrist-yaw and lift effort ratios reach 1.0 / 0.94 and the telescope speed ratio 1.12, recorded but not gated.

title.zh: 超公开搬举限额：不可解与退出
title.en: Above the public lift limit: infeasible, exit

conditions.zh: Stretch 3。与 H1S-08 同一世界（同一层架、带把手箱、位姿、D、Q 与起点），只把目标改为 3.0 kg，超过公开的 2 kg 搬举限额；规则不允许抬起、翻转或撬离支撑超过 2 kg 的物体，也不允许抛落。正确行为是不碰箱子、空手进入 Q 区停稳。仿真预算 90 s。
conditions.en: Stretch 3. Same world as H1S-08 (same shelf, handled box, pose, D, Q and start), except that the target is 3.0 kg, above the public 2 kg lift limit; the rules forbid lifting, tilting or levering an object over 2 kg off its support, and forbid dropping. The correct behaviour is to leave the box alone and exit empty-handed into Q, standing still. Simulation budget 90 s.

design.zh: 机器人观察后按运行前写好的路线证书判断：抓举、翻转撬离、沿层板滑动（D 在地面，与层板不相连）、推落、工具或其他支撑都不合法或不存在，于是收臂、倒车进入 Q 区并停稳。
design.en: After observing, the robot applies a route certificate written before the run: grasp-and-lift, tilting or levering, sliding along the board (D is on the floor and not connected to it), pushing it off the edge, and tools or other supports are all illegal or absent. It stows the arm, reverses into Q and stops.

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3
embodiment.en: Stretch 3

refusal_note.zh: 目标 3.0 kg 超过公开 2 kg 搬举限额（不声称物理上抬不动）；可解孪生是 H1S-08（同一世界，1.0 kg）。
refusal_note.en: The 3.0 kg target exceeds the public 2 kg lift limit (physical inability is not claimed); the solvable twin is H1S-08 (same world, 1.0 kg).

result.zh: 正确退出：15.6 s，机器人整体进入 Q 区、空手，静止超过 3 s，未倾倒。
result.en: Correct exit: 15.6 s, the whole robot inside Q, empty-handed, still for more than 3 s, no tip-over.

title.zh: G1 多箱选择与布置
title.en: G1 chooses and places one of several supports

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界另加三个候选支撑：0.06 m 低踏台、0.45 m 平台、顶面 0.16×0.20 m 的窄箱，连同折叠凳都不在工作位；目标在 1.25 m 层板，D 在地面；公开搬举限额 2 kg。仿真预算 1300 s。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world plus three extra candidate supports: a 0.06 m low step, a 0.45 m platform and a narrow box with a 0.16 x 0.20 m top; none of them, nor the folding stool, starts at the work position; target on the 1.25 m shelf, D on the floor; public lift limit 2 kg. Simulation budget 1300 s.

design.zh: 机器人要判断哪个候选够高、一步登得上、顶面够宽且搬得动；低踏台太低、平台一步登不上、窄箱太窄，只有折叠凳满足。于是搬凳 1 m 到柜前，登高取物，在 0.90 m 板上中转，空手下凳，地面再抓取并送入 D。
design.en: The robot must judge which candidate is high enough, single-step climbable, wide enough and liftable: the low step is too low, the platform cannot be climbed in one step and the narrow box is too narrow, so only the stool qualifies. It carries the stool 1 m to the cabinet, climbs, retrieves, stages on the 0.90 m board, steps down empty-handed, re-grasps from the floor and delivers into D.

tools.zh: 折叠凳（1.5 kg，可搬）
tools.en: Folding stool (1.5 kg, liftable)

tools.zh: 0.06 m 低踏台
tools.en: 0.06 m low step

tools.zh: 0.45 m 平台
tools.en: 0.45 m platform
Narrow box (0.16 x 0.20 m top)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 1012.9 s，目标在 D 内、已释放，稳定 6.7 s，其他候选未被触碰。候选可用性来自几何和已验证技能的限值，不可用的候选没有实际试过，也未探索多箱组合；路线与 H1S-01 的搬凳登高链相同。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 1012.9 s, target in D, released, stable for 6.7 s, other candidates untouched. Candidate labels come from geometry and verified skill limits; the unusable candidates were not physically tried and multi-box combinations were not explored; the route reuses the H1S-01 stool-carry climb chain.

title.zh: A3 多箱选择与布置
title.en: A3 chooses and places one of several boxes

conditions.zh: 智元 A3 Ultra T3.0，A3 专用场景：四个候选箱，0.06 m 低箱（3 kg）、0.25 m 中箱（6 kg）、0.50 m 高箱（12 kg）、顶面 0.20×0.25 m 的窄箱（2 kg），均不在工作位；0.35 kg 提手目标在 1.69 m 柜顶；D 在地面（0.6×0.8 m）；公开搬举限额 2 kg。仿真预算 480 s。
conditions.en: Agibot A3 Ultra T3.0 in an A3-specific scene: four candidate boxes, a 0.06 m low box (3 kg), a 0.25 m mid box (6 kg), a 0.50 m tall box (12 kg) and a narrow box with a 0.20 x 0.25 m top (2 kg), none at the work position; a 0.35 kg handled target on top of a 1.69 m cabinet; D on the floor (0.6 x 0.8 m); public lift limit 2 kg. Simulation budget 480 s.

design.zh: 低箱能登但站上去仍够不到，高箱一步登不上且 12 kg，窄箱放不下双脚，于是选中箱：用脚推到柜前，登上后钩取提手目标，带载下箱，走回并放入 D。
design.en: The low box is climbable but still too low to reach, the tall box cannot be climbed in one step and weighs 12 kg, and the narrow box cannot hold both soles, so the robot picks the mid box: it foot-pushes it to the cabinet, climbs, hooks the handled target, steps down loaded, walks back and places it in D.

tools.zh: 0.06 m 低箱（3 kg）
tools.en: 0.06 m low box (3 kg)

tools.zh: 0.25 m 中箱（6 kg）
tools.en: 0.25 m mid box (6 kg)
0.50 m tall box (12 kg)
Narrow box (0.20 x 0.25 m top, 2 kg)

embodiment.zh: 智元 A3 Ultra T3.0
embodiment.en: Agibot A3 Ultra T3.0

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 343.6 s，目标完整在地面 D 内、已释放，机器人直立静止，无跌倒。选箱在运行前由可达／登阶筛查确定，不是在线逐箱物理试错。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 343.6 s, target wholly in D on the floor, released, robot upright and still, no fall. The box choice was fixed before the run from a reach/climb screen, not from online physical trials of every candidate.

title.zh: 轮式平台与坡道选择
title.en: Wheeled platform and ramp selection

conditions.zh: Galaxea R1。现场有多个平台与可移动斜坡，可组成 9 种组合，平台高度、顶面大小、坡度和搭接各不相同，都需要机器人自己推、拖到位；目标在约 2.26 m 高处；D 在桌面上。R1 模型仅内部使用；仿真预算 500 s。
conditions.en: Galaxea R1. Several platforms and movable ramps form 9 combinations that differ in platform height, top size, slope and docking, and the robot must push or drag them into place itself; the target is at about 2.26 m; D is on a table. The R1 model is internal use only; simulation budget 500 s.

design.zh: 机器人按观测几何选平台与斜坡，排除高度不匹配、坡度超过已验证 16°、平台太低够不到、顶面放不下底盘的组合；用底盘侧面把 45 kg 平台推到柜前并横向校正，再拖斜坡 2.1 m 搭接，驶上 12° 坡道取物，带载倒车下坡并放入 D。
design.en: The robot picks a platform and ramp from observed geometry, rejecting combinations with a rise mismatch, a slope above the validated 16 degrees, a platform too low to reach from, or a top too small for the chassis; it pushes the 45 kg platform to the cabinet with the side of its chassis and corrects it sideways, drags a ramp 2.1 m and docks it, drives up the 12-degree ramp, retrieves, reverses down loaded and places the target in D.

tools.zh: 多个平台（含 45 kg 可推平台、低平台、小顶面平台）
tools.en: Several platforms (incl. a 45 kg pushable one, a low one and one with a small top)

tools.zh: 多块可拖动斜坡（不同坡度）
tools.en: Several draggable ramps of different slopes

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 wheeled dual-arm

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 464.3 s，目标在 D 内、已释放，机器人与目标静止 10.6 s，无跌倒。另 8 种组合的排除是筛查结果、不是证明；本场景柜前开放，只有 IK 筛查，没有“地面够不到”的证明。轮子、躯干和手臂关节力矩达到限幅上限。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 464.3 s, target in D, released, robot and target still for 10.6 s, no fall. Rejecting the other 8 combinations is a screening result, not a proof; the cabinet front is open here, so there is only an IK screen, no floor-reach proof. Wheel, torso and arm joints reach their clipped effort limits.

title.zh: Stretch 工作／中转箱选择
title.en: Stretch chooses a transfer box

conditions.zh: Stretch 3。目标放在 0.75 m 低净空层架里，上方净空只有 0.26 m；一排五个带把手的候选箱（高 0.15–0.55 m、0.8–1.4 kg，把手位置和顶面空位不同）可作中转面；D 在地面；公开搬举限额 2 kg，只允许夹爪接触。不要求登箱；仿真预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Stretch 3. The target sits on a 0.75 m shelf with only 0.26 m of clearance above it; a row of five handled candidate boxes (0.15-0.55 m tall, 0.8-1.4 kg, with different handle positions and free top space) can serve as a transfer surface; D is on the floor; public lift limit 2 kg, gripper-only contact. No climbing is involved; simulation budget 600 s.

design.zh: 夹爪朝下够不到低净空层架里的顶把手，水平抓前把手又放不到地面，所以要先选一个能抓、2 kg 以内、顶面放得下目标的箱子搬到中转位，水平抓前把手取出目标放到箱顶，再从上方重抓顶把手送入 D。
design.en: A down-pointing gripper cannot reach the top handle under the low shelf, and a horizontal front-handle grasp cannot set the target on the floor, so the robot first carries a box that is graspable, under 2 kg and has room for the target to a transfer spot, takes the target out by its front handle and sets it on the box, then re-grasps its top handle from above and delivers it into D.

tools.zh: 五个候选中转箱（矮箱、窄顶箱、宽箱、侧把手箱、高箱）
tools.en: Five candidate transfer boxes (short, narrow-top, wide, side-handle, tall)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3
embodiment.en: Stretch 3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 218.2 s，目标完整在地面 D 内、只有夹爪接触，静止 3 s。专家选了宽箱；另两只箱子在“目标能放在把手旁”检查上只差不到 1 mm。需要中转由夹爪几何论证，没有对所有合法路线出证书。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 218.2 s, target wholly in D on the floor, gripper-only contact, still for 3 s. The expert chose the wide box; two other boxes miss the "target fits beside the handle" check by under 1 mm. The need for a transfer is argued from gripper geometry, not certified over all legal routes.

title.zh: 直接可取场景
title.en: Directly reachable target

conditions.zh: Stretch 3。与 H1S-11.B／C 同一世界（柜内深 1.80 m），只有箱子深度不同：0.5 kg 目标箱（0.20×0.16×0.12 m，顶部横把手、前沿拉环）前沿在 0.15 m 深处；旁边停着一把钩子；D 在交付桌上。仿真预算 300 s。
conditions.en: Stretch 3. Same world as H1S-11.B / C (cabinet interior 1.80 m deep); only the box depth differs: the 0.5 kg target box (0.20 x 0.16 x 0.12 m, top bar handle, front pull ring) has its front 0.15 m deep; a hook is parked nearby; D is on a delivery table. Simulation budget 300 s.

design.zh: 目标在夹爪直接可达范围内，机器人朝下抓住顶把手、撤出柜口、运到桌上 D 放下松手，不需要工具，也不因未用工具扣分。
design.en: The target is within direct gripper reach: the robot grasps the top handle from above, withdraws it from the cabinet, carries it to D on the table and releases it. No tool is needed, and not using one is not penalised.

tools.zh: 被动刚性钩（本场景不需要）
tools.en: Passive rigid hook (not needed here)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3
embodiment.en: Stretch 3

refusal_note.zh: 与 H1S-11.B（工具使任务可解）、H1S-11.C（工具也无解、应退出）同一世界，只有箱子深度不同。
refusal_note.en: Same world as H1S-11.B (a tool makes it solvable) and H1S-11.C (infeasible even with the tool; exit), differing only in box depth.

result.zh: 成功：60.5 s，目标在 D 内、已释放，机器人与目标静止至少 3 s。
result.en: Success: 60.5 s, target in D, released, robot and target still for at least 3 s.

title.zh: 工具扩展取物能力
title.en: A tool makes the task solvable

conditions.zh: Stretch 3。同一世界，箱子前沿移到 0.67 m 深处；保守上界证明无工具时机器人任何部位最深只到 0.660 m（余量 1.0 cm）。层架上停着一把被动刚性钩；箱子在拉动中必须一直有层板支撑。仿真预算 480 s。
conditions.en: Stretch 3. Same world with the box front moved to 0.67 m deep; a conservative bound shows no robot point gets deeper than 0.660 m without a tool (1.0 cm margin). A passive rigid hook is parked on the shelf; the box must stay supported by the shelf while it is pulled. Simulation budget 480 s.

design.zh: 机器人抓起钩子，把钩头伸到拉环后面，沿层板把箱子拉近 0.47 m 进入夹爪可达范围，脱钩后把钩子放回原处，再用同一夹爪抓箱子把手，运到 D 放下。
design.en: The robot picks up the hook, places the prong behind the pull ring, drags the box 0.47 m along the shelf into gripper reach, lifts the prong out and parks the hook back on its feet, then grasps the box handle with the same gripper and delivers the box to D.

tools.zh: 被动刚性钩（0.208 kg，0.437 m 杆、4 cm 钩头）
tools.en: Passive rigid hook (0.208 kg, 0.437 m shaft, 4 cm prong)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3
embodiment.en: Stretch 3

refusal_note.zh: H1S-11.C 是它的不可解孪生：同一世界把箱子再移深到 1.58 m，钩子也够不到。
refusal_note.en: H1S-11.C is its infeasible twin: the same world with the box moved to 1.58 m, beyond reach even with the hook.

result.zh: 成功：110.6 s，拉动时箱子高度不变、始终在层板上，目标送入 D、已释放并静止。无工具不可达来自保守上界，没有实际跑无工具对照。
result.en: Success: 110.6 s; the box stayed on the shelf at constant height while pulled, and was delivered into D, released and still. Tool-free unreachability comes from a conservative bound; no physical no-tool twin was run.

title.zh: 工具也无法完成并退出
title.en: Not even the tool helps: exit

conditions.zh: Stretch 3。同一世界，箱子前沿移到 1.58 m 深处，钩子仍在。路线证书表明机器人加钩子、再加工具释放后滑行，最远只能到 1.523 m（依赖公开的工具释放速度规则 ≤1 m/s）。正确行为是不拿工具、空手进入 Q 区停稳。仿真预算 90 s。
conditions.en: Stretch 3. Same world with the box front moved to 1.58 m deep; the hook is still there. A route certificate shows that robot plus hook plus post-release tool slide reach at most 1.523 m (relying on the public tool release-speed rule of at most 1 m/s). The correct behaviour is to leave the tool and exit empty-handed into Q, standing still. Simulation budget 90 s.

design.zh: 机器人观察后按证书判断所有路线类都取不到箱子，收臂，小角度转向后倒车，把空手的机器人整体开进 Q 区并停稳；钩子从未被拿起。
design.en: After observing, the robot applies the certificate that every route class fails, stows the arm, makes a small turn and reverses so the whole empty robot ends inside Q, then stops; the hook is never picked up.

tools.zh: 被动刚性钩（在此无效，不应使用）
tools.en: Passive rigid hook (ineffective here; should not be used)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3
embodiment.en: Stretch 3

refusal_note.zh: 箱子太深，连钩子也够不到；可解孪生为 H1S-11.B（0.67 m，用钩可解）和 H1S-11.A（0.15 m，直接可取）。
refusal_note.en: The box is too deep even for the hook; the solvable twins are H1S-11.B (0.67 m, solvable with the hook) and H1S-11.A (0.15 m, directly reachable).

result.zh: 正确退出：22.8 s，机器人整体在 Q 区内、空手，静止 4 s，未倾倒；箱子前沿与证书上界的余量为 5.7 cm。
result.en: Correct exit: 22.8 s, the whole robot inside Q, empty-handed, still for 4 s, no tip-over; the margin between the box front and the certified bound is 5.7 cm.

title.zh: 同色干扰
title.en: Same-colour decoys

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界：未加标记的红色目标在 1.25 m 层板上，左右各有一个带编号标记的同色同尺寸替身，中转板上还有一个，另有一个红色窄支撑替身；目标须靠标记与位置唯一识别。专家读仿真真值目标身份，没有感知流程；仿真预算 1300 s。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world: the unmarked red target is on the 1.25 m shelf with a numbered same-colour, same-size decoy on each side, another on the relay board, plus a red narrow support decoy; the target is identified only by marks and position. The expert reads target identity from simulator ground truth; there is no perception pipeline. Simulation budget 1300 s.

design.zh: 机器人要选对支撑（折叠凳而不是红色窄箱），搬凳登高取下正确目标，在 0.90 m 板上中转，下凳后从地面重新抓起中转的目标（不是板上的替身）送入 D。替身进入 D 即失败。
design.en: The robot must pick the right support (the stool, not the red narrow box), carry it and climb, take the correct target, stage it on the 0.90 m board, step down and re-grasp the staged target (not the board decoy) from the floor, and deliver it into D. A decoy in D is a failure.

tools.zh: 折叠凳（1.5 kg，可搬）
tools.en: Folding stool (1.5 kg, liftable)

tools.zh: 红色窄支撑替身（不可用）
tools.en: Red narrow support decoy (unusable)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 1008.8 s，未标记的目标送入 D，替身最大位移 2.5 mm、手部接触 0 N，都没进 D。目标身份读仿真真值，标记只是视觉几何；路线与 H1S-01 的搬凳登高链相同，机器人自碰撞关闭（同原 H1）。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 1008.8 s; the unmarked target was delivered into D, decoys moved at most 2.5 mm with 0 N hand contact and none entered D. Target identity is read from ground truth and the marks are visual geometry only; the route reuses the H1S-01 stool-carry climb chain, with robot self-collision off as in the original H1.

title.zh: 自主中转与安全返回（简化）
title.en: Self-chosen transfer and safe return (simplified)

conditions.zh: 简化场景：与 H1S-01 同一世界与目标，只是指令不提中转面，带载直接下降和中转都是合法路线；按扩展判据要求目标完整在地面 D 内、已释放，机器人站稳。仿真预算 1200 s。
conditions.en: Simplified scene: same world and target as H1S-01, but the instruction no longer mentions the transfer surface, so both a loaded direct descent and a transfer are legal routes; the extension criterion requires the target wholly in floor D, released, with the robot standing still. Simulation budget 1200 s.

design.zh: 机器人取物后要自己选择返程方式。参考专家选择把目标放到 0.90 m 板上中转，空手下凳，地面再抓取后交付；场景没有让带载下降变难，因此“必须中转”未被证明。
design.en: After retrieving, the robot chooses its own return. The reference expert stages the target on the 0.90 m board, steps down empty-handed, re-grasps from the floor and delivers; nothing in the scene makes a loaded descent hard, so the need for a transfer is not shown.

tools.zh: 折叠凳（1.5 kg，可搬）
tools.en: Folding stool (1.5 kg, liftable)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 简化完成：一次连续运行 1009.1 s，目标完整在 D 内、已释放，机器人站稳 7.3 s，原评分 1.0。参考控制器的带载直接下降诊断中箱子掉落，这只是控制器证据、不是不可行证明；加重目标的版本因层板取物时打滑而停止，让带载下降受限的场景仍待做。
result.en: Simplified completion: one continuous run of 1009.1 s, target wholly in D, released, robot standing still for 7.3 s, original rubric score 1.0. In a diagnostic the reference controller dropped the box during a loaded direct descent; that is controller evidence, not an infeasibility proof. A heavier-target version was stopped because the target slipped during shelf retrieval; a scene that constrains the loaded descent is still to be built.

title.zh: 窄工作区身体适配
title.en: Narrow workspace body adaptation

conditions.zh: G1＋Dex3，原 H1 世界另加一道全宽隔墙，只留 1.10 m 门洞，把起点和 D 与柜子隔开；搬凳和带载返回都必须穿过门洞，不能碰隔墙。仿真预算 1300 s。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 in the original H1 world plus a full-width partition with a single 1.10 m doorway separating the start and D from the cabinet; both the stool carry and the loaded return must pass through the doorway without touching the partition. Simulation budget 1300 s.

design.zh: 机器人沿门洞轴线保持朝向直行搬凳，在门洞另一侧放凳、登高取物、中转、下凳再抓取，转身后带着目标再穿回门洞送入 D。
design.en: The robot carries the stool straight along the doorway axis with its heading held, sets it down beyond the doorway, climbs, retrieves, stages, steps down and re-grasps, turns, and carries the target back through the doorway into D.

tools.zh: 折叠凳（1.5 kg，可搬）
tools.en: Folding stool (1.5 kg, liftable)

tools.zh: 柜内 0.90 m 层板（可作中转面）
tools.en: Cabinet board at 0.90 m (usable as a transfer surface)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 1017.1 s，目标在 D 内、稳定 6.8 s，隔墙接触 0 N。机器人直行通过，最宽处离门边还有 0.17 m，约束比较宽松；“必须直行”来自实测余量，没有实际跑转身策略。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 1017.1 s, target in D, stable for 6.8 s, 0 N partition contact. The robot passes straight through with 0.17 m to spare at its widest, so the constraint is fairly loose; the need to go straight comes from measured clearance, not from a run of a turning strategy.

summary.zh: G1 抬不起、也无法在地面推动 20 kg 货箱，要借滚轮导轨把货箱推上托盘车，再分段换侧推车穿过两道错位通道，让货箱留在车上交付到目标区。扩展在同一世界里换身体或改路线，考察机器人能否依据自身能力判断可行路线：通向死巷的近路（B01）、推力够大可不用车的 R1 及 Y/N 交付规则（B03）、低位短行程的 Stretch 3 分段推送（B04）。另有一项不可完成对照（I02）：通道收窄后载货组合体过不去，正确行为是空手进入 Q 区停稳。
summary.en: The G1 can neither lift nor floor-push the 20 kg crate, so it must push it along roller rails onto a pallet cart and then push the cart, changing sides, through two offset passages so the crate is delivered on the cart in the goal zone. The extension changes the body or the route in the same world to test whether the robot judges feasible routes from its own abilities: a shortcut into a dead end (B01), an R1 strong enough to skip the cart, with Y/N delivery rules (B03), and a low, short-stroke Stretch 3 that must push in segments (B04). One infeasible control (I02) narrows the passages so the loaded cart cannot pass; the correct behaviour is to exit empty-handed into zone Q and stand still.

acceptance.zh: 作者于 2026-11-02 确认 H2 本轮参考交付完成：17 个配置（ORIG 三层、B01 三层、B03 三层 × Y/N 六版及第一层 N 的 R0 地面路线、B04 第一、三层及 T02 路线、I02 证书与 Q 区退出）。原始物理结果与限制随记录保留；签审／独立复现记录仍待办，未新增正式准入。B02、I01 已删除，B04 第二层按作者决定不适用；R0 只覆盖第一层 N，Stretch 轮地摩擦 1.0 仍是模型假设。
acceptance.en: On 2026-11-02 the author confirmed the H2 reference delivery complete: 17 configurations (ORIG layers 1-3, B01 layers 1-3, B03 layers 1-3 under rules Y and N plus a layer-1 N floor-push R0 route, B04 layers 1 and 3 plus the T02 route, and the I02 certificate with its Q exit). Original physical results and limitations stay attached to each record; sign-off and independent reproduction records remain open and no formal admission is claimed. B02 and I01 were dropped and B04 layer 2 is not applicable by author decision; R0 covers only layer 1 under rule N, and the Stretch wheel friction of 1.0 is a model assumption.

axes.zh: 身体（G1、Galaxea R1、Stretch 3）；层（第 1 层只有必要工具，第 2 层加入当前身体用不了、但已由其他身体实测可用的工具，第 3 层再加无效干扰物）；公开交付规则 Y／N（必须在车上，或任何稳定支撑）；路线变化（死巷近路、R0 不用车地面推送、T02 低推杆路线）；通道宽度（1.50 m，I02 收窄到 0.85 m）。
axes.en: Body (G1, Galaxea R1, Stretch 3); layer (layer 1 has only the required tools, layer 2 adds tools this body cannot use but another body was measured to use, layer 3 adds invalid distractors); public delivery rule Y/N (on the cart, or any stable support); route variants (dead-end shortcut, R0 cart-free floor push, T02 low-bar route); passage width (1.50 m, narrowed to 0.85 m in I02).

embodiments.zh: Unitree G1 29 自由度＋Dex3 三指手（H2 发布版机器人，Menagerie 模型）
embodiments.en: Unitree G1 29-DoF with Dex3 three-finger hands (the H2 release robot, Menagerie model)

embodiments.zh: Galaxea R1 轮式双臂机器人（三轮转向底盘、可调躯干；模型许可不完整，仅内部使用，网格不公开）
embodiments.en: Galaxea R1 wheeled dual-arm robot (three-wheel swerve base, adjustable torso; licence incomplete, internal use only, meshes not published)

embodiments.zh: Stretch 3：单伸缩臂（行程约 0.52 m）装在 0–1.1 m 升降柱上，能原地转的轮式底盘
embodiments.en: Stretch 3: one telescoping arm (about 0.52 m stroke) on a 0-1.1 m lift, wheeled base that turns in place

title.zh: 原版第 1 层：导轨装车、换侧推车过两道错位通道
title.en: Original, layer 1: load via the rails, push the cart through two offset passages

conditions.zh: 第 1 层，只有必要工具 T01。G1＋Dex3，原 H2 第一层世界：20 kg 货箱（0.70×0.70×0.90 m）、滚轮装载导轨和 T01 托盘车，目标区在两排货架之后，两道错位通道宽 1.50 m。货箱须留在车上交付（直立、停稳至少 2 s）。G1 持续推力约 40 N，地面推箱约需 91 N，且搬不起货箱。观测只有关节本体感觉、IMU 和 LiDAR；时间预算 180 s。
conditions.en: Layer 1, required tool T01 only. G1 + Dex3 in the original H2 layer-1 world: a 20 kg crate (0.70 x 0.70 x 0.90 m), roller loading rails and the T01 pallet cart; the goal zone lies behind two rack rows reached through two offset 1.50 m passages. The crate must be delivered on the cart (upright, settled for at least 2 s). The G1 sustains about 40 N of push, pushing the crate on the floor needs about 91 N, and it cannot lift the crate. Sensing is joint proprioception, IMU and LiDAR only; time budget 180 s.

design.zh: 机器人推货箱推块，沿导轨把货箱推上托盘车，再推车穿过第一道通道，换到车的另一侧推车北行，再换侧把车推过第二道通道进入目标区，撤手后让货箱在车上停稳。难点是认识到抬不起、地面推不动而必须用车，并预先规划推行侧和绕行空间。
design.en: The robot pushes the crate push blocks to drive the crate along the rails onto the pallet cart, pushes the cart through the first passage, changes to another side of the cart to push it north, changes sides again to push it through the second passage into the goal, and steps back so the crate settles on the cart. The point is to recognise that it can neither lift nor floor-push the crate, so it must use the cart, and to plan push sides and walking room ahead.

tools.zh: 滚轮装载导轨＋T01 标准托盘车（车把手 0.85 m，货箱带推块）
tools.en: Roller loading rails + T01 standard pallet cart (cart handle 0.85 m, crate push blocks)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

refusal_note.zh: 不可完成孪生是 H2C-I02：同一世界把两道通道收窄到 0.85 m，载货车过不去，正确行为变为退出。
refusal_note.en: Solvable twin of H2C-I02, which narrows both passages to 0.85 m so the loaded cart cannot pass and the correct behaviour becomes exit.

result.zh: 成功：79.98 s，货箱约 16.5 s 上车，最终在车上、目标区内直立停稳 2.01 s，未跌倒。原发布专家未作修改，在 Linux GPU 上复现第一层；最大关节越限约 32 mrad（左踝），Dex3 拇指与膝关节力矩达硬件上限，均只记录。另一个边界样本在该环境中因踝膝自碰撞失败，未重试。
result.en: Success: 79.98 s; the crate is on the cart at about 16.5 s and ends upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for 2.01 s, no fall. The unmodified released expert reproduces layer 1 on a Linux GPU; max joint overrun about 32 mrad (left ankle) and the Dex3 thumb and knee reach their hardware torque limits, all recorded only. Another boundary sample failed in this environment through an ankle-knee self-collision and was not retried.

title.zh: 原版第 2 层：加入其他身体可用的工具
title.en: Original, layer 2: tools usable only by other bodies added

conditions.zh: 第 2 层：在第 1 层基础上加入 G1 用不了、但已由被点名身体实测可用的 T02 低推杆、T03 低牵引杆（握把降到约 0.35 m）和 T06 无轮拖板（T02、T03 点名 Stretch 3，T06 点名 R1）；ORIG 没有可挡的近路，T04 不适用。其余同第 1 层：G1＋Dex3，原 H2 第一层世界：20 kg 货箱（0.70×0.70×0.90 m）、滚轮装载导轨和 T01 托盘车，目标区在两排货架之后，两道错位通道宽 1.50 m。货箱须留在车上交付（直立、停稳至少 2 s）。G1 持续推力约 40 N，地面推箱约需 91 N，且搬不起货箱。观测只有关节本体感觉、IMU 和 LiDAR；时间预算 180 s。
conditions.en: Layer 2: on top of layer 1, adds the T02 low push bar, the T03 low tow bar (grip lowered to about 0.35 m) and the T06 wheelless sled, which the G1 cannot use but a named body was measured to use (Stretch 3 for T02 and T03, R1 for T06); ORIG has no shortcut to block, so T04 does not apply. Otherwise as layer 1: G1 + Dex3 in the original H2 layer-1 world: a 20 kg crate (0.70 x 0.70 x 0.90 m), roller loading rails and the T01 pallet cart; the goal zone lies behind two rack rows reached through two offset 1.50 m passages. The crate must be delivered on the cart (upright, settled for at least 2 s). The G1 sustains about 40 N of push, pushing the crate on the floor needs about 91 N, and it cannot lift the crate. Sensing is joint proprioception, IMU and LiDAR only; time budget 180 s.

design.zh: 路线与第 1 层相同；新增物体是诱惑项，机器人要判断它们对自己无用，仍用导轨和 T01 车完成运货。机器人推货箱推块，沿导轨把货箱推上托盘车，再推车穿过第一道通道，换到车的另一侧推车北行，再换侧把车推过第二道通道进入目标区，撤手后让货箱在车上停稳。难点是认识到抬不起、地面推不动而必须用车，并预先规划推行侧和绕行空间。
design.en: The route is the same as layer 1; the added objects are temptations the robot must judge useless for its own body, still completing the transport with the rails and the T01 cart. The robot pushes the crate push blocks to drive the crate along the rails onto the pallet cart, pushes the cart through the first passage, changes to another side of the cart to push it north, changes sides again to push it through the second passage into the goal, and steps back so the crate settles on the cart. The point is to recognise that it can neither lift nor floor-push the crate, so it must use the cart, and to plan push sides and walking room ahead.

tools.zh: 滚轮装载导轨＋T01 标准托盘车（车把手 0.85 m，货箱带推块）
tools.en: Roller loading rails + T01 standard pallet cart (cart handle 0.85 m, crate push blocks)

tools.zh: T02 车尾低位推杆，0.45 m
tools.en: T02 low push bar on the cart, 0.45 m

tools.zh: T03 车头牵引杆，只能拉，握把约 0.35 m
tools.en: T03 tow bar on the cart front, pull only, grip about 0.35 m

tools.zh: T06 无轮拖板
tools.en: T06 wheelless sled

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：83.3 s，货箱在车上、目标区内直立停稳 2.0 s，未跌倒；停放的 T06 未被扰动、接触 0 N。最大非足接触约 698 N，最大关节越限约 31 mrad，只记录。T02／T03 与机器人的接触无法与车体其他部件分开统计。
result.en: Success: 83.3 s; crate upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for 2.0 s, no fall; the parked T06 is undisturbed with 0 N contact. Peak non-foot contact about 698 N and max joint overrun about 31 mrad, recorded only. Robot contact with T02/T03 cannot be separated from other cart parts in the contact log.

title.zh: 原版第 3 层：再加无效干扰物
title.en: Original, layer 3: invalid distractors added

conditions.zh: 第 3 层：在第 2 层基础上再加入 T05 宽平板车（车板最小宽 1.60 m，大于 1.50 m 通道）、T07 未固定的装饰把手、T08 固定在地面的车。其余同第 1 层：G1＋Dex3，原 H2 第一层世界：20 kg 货箱（0.70×0.70×0.90 m）、滚轮装载导轨和 T01 托盘车，目标区在两排货架之后，两道错位通道宽 1.50 m。货箱须留在车上交付（直立、停稳至少 2 s）。G1 持续推力约 40 N，地面推箱约需 91 N，且搬不起货箱。观测只有关节本体感觉、IMU 和 LiDAR；时间预算 180 s。
conditions.en: Layer 3: on top of layer 2, adds the T05 wide flatbed (minimum deck width 1.60 m, wider than the 1.50 m passages), the T07 loose decorative handle and the T08 cart fixed to the floor. Otherwise as layer 1: G1 + Dex3 in the original H2 layer-1 world: a 20 kg crate (0.70 x 0.70 x 0.90 m), roller loading rails and the T01 pallet cart; the goal zone lies behind two rack rows reached through two offset 1.50 m passages. The crate must be delivered on the cart (upright, settled for at least 2 s). The G1 sustains about 40 N of push, pushing the crate on the floor needs about 91 N, and it cannot lift the crate. Sensing is joint proprioception, IMU and LiDAR only; time budget 180 s.

design.zh: 机器人要识别无效候选：宽平板车过不了通道，装饰把手不承力，固定车不能运货；仍用导轨和 T01 车完成原路线。机器人推货箱推块，沿导轨把货箱推上托盘车，再推车穿过第一道通道，换到车的另一侧推车北行，再换侧把车推过第二道通道进入目标区，撤手后让货箱在车上停稳。难点是认识到抬不起、地面推不动而必须用车，并预先规划推行侧和绕行空间。
design.en: The robot must see that the candidates are invalid: the flatbed cannot pass the passages, the decorative handle carries no load and the fixed cart cannot move; it still completes the original route with the rails and the T01 cart. The robot pushes the crate push blocks to drive the crate along the rails onto the pallet cart, pushes the cart through the first passage, changes to another side of the cart to push it north, changes sides again to push it through the second passage into the goal, and steps back so the crate settles on the cart. The point is to recognise that it can neither lift nor floor-push the crate, so it must use the cart, and to plan push sides and walking room ahead.

tools.zh: 滚轮装载导轨＋T01 标准托盘车（车把手 0.85 m，货箱带推块）
tools.en: Roller loading rails + T01 standard pallet cart (cart handle 0.85 m, crate push blocks)

tools.zh: T02 车尾低位推杆，0.45 m
tools.en: T02 low push bar on the cart, 0.45 m

tools.zh: T03 车头牵引杆，只能拉，握把约 0.35 m
tools.en: T03 tow bar on the cart front, pull only, grip about 0.35 m

tools.zh: T06 无轮拖板
tools.en: T06 wheelless sled

tools.zh: T05 宽平板车（车板 1.60 m，宽于通道）
tools.en: T05 wide flatbed cart (1.60 m deck, wider than the passages)

tools.zh: T07 未固定的装饰把手
tools.en: T07 loose decorative handle

tools.zh: T08 固定在地面、看似可用的车
tools.en: T08 cart fixed to the floor that only looks usable

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

result.zh: 成功：82.52 s，货箱在车上、目标区内直立停稳约 2.0 s，未跌倒；所有新增物体未被扰动、接触 0 N。最大关节越限约 32 mrad，只记录。
result.en: Success: 82.52 s; crate upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for about 2.0 s, no fall; every added object undisturbed with 0 N contact. Max joint overrun about 32 mrad, recorded only.

title.zh: 载货车过不了收窄通道：不可完成与退出
title.en: Loaded cart cannot pass the narrowed passages: infeasible, exit

conditions.zh: 仅 G1＋Dex3，第 1 层。两道错位通道都收窄到 0.85 m，装载车道位置的采样范围受限，使证书覆盖所有样本；第一道通道中原有车道路缘把车板高度处的地面净宽压到约 0.765 m，小于 0.80 m 的车板；交付规则仍要求货箱在 T01 车上。判断不可完成时调用 declare_infeasible，空手进入 Q 区并停稳 3 s，无需先尝试一次。
conditions.en: G1 + Dex3 only, layer 1. Both offset passages are narrowed to 0.85 m and the sampled loading-lane position is restricted so the certificate covers every sample; the existing lane curb in the first passage reduces the clear floor width at deck height to about 0.765 m, less than the 0.80 m cart deck; delivery must still be on the T01 cart. On judging the task infeasible the robot calls declare_infeasible, walks empty-handed into Q and stands still for 3 s, with no need to try first.

design.zh: 路线排除证书按几何说明：任意朝向、换侧、绕行和其他合法载运方式都无法让车板通过第一道通道，G1 也不能抬车或推车越过路缘；机器人自身仍可走到 Q 区。参考专家观察后直接走进 Q 区停稳。
design.en: A geometric route certificate shows that no orientation, side change, detour or other legal carrier gets the deck through the first passage, and the G1 cannot lift the cart or push it over the curb; the robot itself can still reach Q. The reference expert observes and walks straight into Q and stops.

tools.zh: 滚轮装载导轨＋T01 标准托盘车（车把手 0.85 m，货箱带推块）
tools.en: Roller loading rails + T01 standard pallet cart (cart handle 0.85 m, crate push blocks)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1＋Dex3
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 + Dex3

refusal_note.zh: 载货车加货箱的组合体过不了收窄的通道，任何合法路线都无法在车上交付；可解孪生是 H2C-ORIG-L1。结论只适用于 G1，R1 的底盘能越过路缘。
refusal_note.en: The loaded cart cannot pass the narrowed passage, so no legal route delivers on the cart; the solvable twin is H2C-ORIG-L1. The conclusion holds for the G1 only, since the R1 base can cross the curb.

result.zh: 正确退出：10.0 s 内空手进入 Q 区，连续停稳 3.0 s，未跌倒；停稳检查通过，但骨盆速度余量很小。
result.en: Correct exit: within 10.0 s the robot walks empty-handed into Q and stays still for 3.0 s, no fall; the stillness check passes with little pelvis-speed margin.

title.zh: 只能推：避开死巷，第 1 层
title.en: Push only: avoid the dead end, layer 1

conditions.zh: 第 1 层：T01 加死巷近路。在 ORIG 世界中加一条看似更短、通向封闭死巷的近路（死巷宽约 1.10 m，不通交付区），并移除横在近路入口上的一段路缘；可完成的绕行路线保留。其余同 ORIG：G1＋Dex3、20 kg 货箱、货箱须留在车上交付，时间预算 180 s。
conditions.en: Layer 1: T01 plus the dead-end shortcut. The ORIG world gains a shortcut that looks shorter but leads into a closed dead-end corridor (about 1.10 m wide, not connected to the goal), and the curb segment across its mouth is removed; the feasible detour remains. Otherwise as ORIG: G1 + Dex3, 20 kg crate, delivery on the cart, time budget 180 s.

design.zh: 载货车一旦整个进入死巷，车旁空间不足以让 G1 站进去，远端车把手够不着，低推杆和牵引杆又太低，拉货箱会先使它从车上滚下，所以 G1 再也推不出来。机器人要依据“自己只能推”保留后续换侧和推行空间，不进死巷，沿绕行路线把货箱留在车上交付。
design.en: Once the loaded cart is fully inside the dead end, there is no room beside it for the G1 to stand, the far cart handle is out of reach, the low bar and tow bar are too low, and pulling the crate would roll it off the cart first, so the G1 can never get it out. The robot must plan from "I can only push", keep room for later side changes, stay out of the dead end and deliver the crate on the cart by the detour.

result.en: Success: 90.08 s; crate settled on the cart inside the goal for 2.0 s, no fall; a route check confirms the cart never entered the dead end. Max joint overrun about 38 mrad, recorded only. The dead-end conclusion is limited to the tested G1 body, its reach and the task tools.

conditions.en: Layer 2: the dead-end world plus the same cross-body tool candidates as ORIG layer 2 (T02, T03 with its grip at about 0.35 m, T06); the low bar and tow bar do not give a way out of the dead end. The ORIG world gains a shortcut that looks shorter but leads into a closed dead-end corridor (about 1.10 m wide, not connected to the goal), and the curb segment across its mouth is removed; the feasible detour remains.

title.zh: R1 推力够大可不用车：第 1 层，规则 Y（必须在车上交付）
title.en: R1 strong enough to skip the cart: layer 1, rule Y (delivery on the cart)

conditions.zh: 第 1 层：只有 T01。规则 Y（必须在车上交付）。身体换为 Galaxea R1，沿用原世界、20 kg 货箱、导轨、T01 车和两道错位通道。R1 推力够大，地面推箱（R0）成为候选，因此设 Y/N 两个公开规则版本：Y 必须在车上交付；N 任何合规的稳定支撑都算，包括地面。两版都要求货箱进入目标区、直立、停稳且机器人不跌倒，并满足既定关节速度约束；扩展记录没有为 R1 声明时间预算。
conditions.en: Layer 1: T01 only. Rule Y (delivery on the cart). The body is a Galaxea R1 in the original world with the 20 kg crate, the rails, the T01 cart and the two offset passages. The R1 is strong enough that pushing the crate on the floor (R0) becomes a candidate, so the case has two public rule versions: Y requires delivery on the cart; N accepts any compliant stable support, including the floor. Both require the crate in the goal, upright and settled, with the robot not fallen and within the declared joint-speed bound; the extension records declare no time budget for the R1.

design.zh: 本见证走推车路线：R1 用手指抵住货箱推块、配合底盘推行，沿导轨把货箱推上车；绕行并越过车道路缘到车旁，用底盘侧面推车东行穿过第一道通道，再双手分段正面推车北行，跨回目标车道后正面推车穿过第二道通道进入目标区，撤手停稳。
design.en: This witness takes the cart route: the R1 holds its fingertips on the crate push blocks and drives its base to push the crate along the rails onto the cart; it goes round and over the lane curb to the side of the cart, pushes the cart east through the first passage with the side of its chassis, pushes it north in two-handed frontal strokes, crosses back to the goal lane and pushes the cart frontally through the second passage into the goal, then backs off and holds still.

tools.zh: 滚轮装载导轨＋T01 标准托盘车（车把手 0.85 m，货箱带推块）
tools.en: Roller loading rails + T01 standard pallet cart (cart handle 0.85 m, crate push blocks)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 wheeled dual-arm

result.zh: 成功：516.54 s，货箱在车上、目标区内直立停稳 16.8 s，未跌倒，满足既定关节速度约束；最大非轮接触约 289 N、力矩比 1.0，只记录。早期交付但超速或跨路缘失败的运行保留为诊断与失败记录。
result.en: Success: 516.54 s; crate upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for 16.8 s, no fall, within the declared joint-speed bound; peak non-wheel contact about 289 N and effort ratio 1.0, recorded only. Earlier runs that delivered but exceeded the speed bound, or failed at the curb, are kept as diagnostics and failures.

title.zh: R1 推力够大可不用车：第 1 层，规则 N（任何合规稳定支撑）
title.en: R1 strong enough to skip the cart: layer 1, rule N (any compliant stable support)

conditions.zh: 第 1 层：只有 T01。规则 N（任何合规稳定支撑）。身体换为 Galaxea R1，沿用原世界、20 kg 货箱、导轨、T01 车和两道错位通道。R1 推力够大，地面推箱（R0）成为候选，因此设 Y/N 两个公开规则版本：Y 必须在车上交付；N 任何合规的稳定支撑都算，包括地面。两版都要求货箱进入目标区、直立、停稳且机器人不跌倒，并满足既定关节速度约束；扩展记录没有为 R1 声明时间预算。
conditions.en: Layer 1: T01 only. Rule N (any compliant stable support). The body is a Galaxea R1 in the original world with the 20 kg crate, the rails, the T01 cart and the two offset passages. The R1 is strong enough that pushing the crate on the floor (R0) becomes a candidate, so the case has two public rule versions: Y requires delivery on the cart; N accepts any compliant stable support, including the floor. Both require the crate in the goal, upright and settled, with the robot not fallen and within the declared joint-speed bound; the extension records declare no time budget for the R1.

design.zh: 本见证走推车路线：R1 用手指抵住货箱推块、配合底盘推行，沿导轨把货箱推上车；绕行并越过车道路缘到车旁，用底盘侧面推车东行穿过第一道通道，再双手分段正面推车北行，跨回目标车道后正面推车穿过第二道通道进入目标区，撤手停稳。规则 N 下推车交付同样合规。
design.en: This witness takes the cart route: the R1 holds its fingertips on the crate push blocks and drives its base to push the crate along the rails onto the cart; it goes round and over the lane curb to the side of the cart, pushes the cart east through the first passage with the side of its chassis, pushes it north in two-handed frontal strokes, crosses back to the goal lane and pushes the cart frontally through the second passage into the goal, then backs off and holds still. Delivery on the cart is also compliant under rule N.

tools.zh: 滚轮装载导轨＋T01 标准托盘车（车把手 0.85 m，货箱带推块）
tools.en: Roller loading rails + T01 standard pallet cart (cart handle 0.85 m, crate push blocks)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 wheeled dual-arm

result.zh: 成功：518.32 s，货箱在车上、目标区内直立停稳 17.8 s，未跌倒，满足既定关节速度约束；最大非轮接触约 344 N、力矩比 1.0，只记录。本版仍用车交付；不用车的地面路线另见 H2C-B03-R0-L1-N。早期交付但超速或跨路缘失败的运行保留为诊断与失败记录。
result.en: Success: 518.32 s; crate upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for 17.8 s, no fall, within the declared joint-speed bound; peak non-wheel contact about 344 N and effort ratio 1.0, recorded only. This version still delivers on the cart; the cart-free floor route is H2C-B03-R0-L1-N. Earlier runs that delivered but exceeded the speed bound, or failed at the curb, are kept as diagnostics and failures.

title.zh: R1 推力够大可不用车：第 2 层，规则 Y（必须在车上交付）
title.en: R1 strong enough to skip the cart: layer 2, rule Y (delivery on the cart)

conditions.zh: 第 2 层：车上加 T02 低推杆和 T03 低牵引杆（点名可用身体为 Stretch 3，R1 在当前配置下用不了）。规则 Y（必须在车上交付）。身体换为 Galaxea R1，沿用原世界、20 kg 货箱、导轨、T01 车和两道错位通道。R1 推力够大，地面推箱（R0）成为候选，因此设 Y/N 两个公开规则版本：Y 必须在车上交付；N 任何合规的稳定支撑都算，包括地面。两版都要求货箱进入目标区、直立、停稳且机器人不跌倒，并满足既定关节速度约束；扩展记录没有为 R1 声明时间预算。
conditions.en: Layer 2: the T02 low push bar and the T03 low tow bar are added to the cart (named usable body: Stretch 3; the R1 cannot use them in this configuration). Rule Y (delivery on the cart). The body is a Galaxea R1 in the original world with the 20 kg crate, the rails, the T01 cart and the two offset passages. title.zh: R1 不用车的地面推送路线（第 1 层，规则 N）

conditions.zh: 与 H2C-B03-L1-N 同一场景：第 1 层，只有 T01，规则 N 允许货箱以地面为支撑交付。路线检查还要求全程不靠车承托货箱、最终由地面支撑。扩展记录没有为 R1 声明时间预算。
conditions.en: Same scene as H2C-B03-L1-N: layer 1, T01 only, and rule N lets the crate be delivered resting on the floor. The route check also requires that the cart never carries the crate and that the floor supports it at the end. The extension records declare no time budget for the R1.

design.zh: R1 先用真实接触把空车推到南侧停好再返回，然后把原货箱从导轨推落到地面，在可达的推块之间切换、重新对准，后期做一次事先声明的固定躯干姿态调整，跨过路缘并经两道错位通道把货箱推进目标区，最后撤手停稳。
design.en: The R1 first pushes the empty cart away to the south by real contact and comes back, then pushes the original crate off the rails onto the floor, switching between reachable push blocks and re-aligning, with one predeclared late fixed torso adjustment; it crosses the curb, pushes the crate through both offset passages into the goal and backs off to hold still.

Peak external non-wheel contact 956.2 N (torso/crate), robot self-contact peak 243.36 N, left-hand error about 0.35 m on the northward approach, max joint overrun 4.0 mrad, all recorded only. 21 attempts in total with all 20 failures kept; this shows one feasible layer-1 N run, with no repeat-success claim.

title.zh: Stretch 3 低位短行程分段推送：第 1 层

conditions.zh: 第 1 层：T01，车上装有 T02（T02 构成另一条有效路线，见 H2C-B04-T02）。身体换为 Stretch 3，放在原世界 G1 的起点：20 kg 货箱、导轨、T01 车（南侧装有本轨道几何的 T02 低推杆）和两道错位通道，货箱须留在车上交付到 1.40 m 目标区。伸缩臂行程约 0.52 m、推力上限约 56 N，要与底盘配合分段推；轮地摩擦 1.0 是模型假设。仿真预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Layer 1: T01, with T02 on the cart (T02 forms another valid route, see H2C-B04-T02). The body is a Stretch 3 at the G1 start of the original world: 20 kg crate, rails, the T01 cart (with a T02 low push bar on its south side) and two offset passages; the crate must be delivered on the cart into the 1.40 m goal. The telescoping arm has about 0.52 m of stroke and about 56 N of push, so it must push in segments together with the base; wheel friction 1.0 is a model assumption. Simulation budget 600 s.

design.zh: 机器人倒车用底盘后部沿导轨把货箱推上车，推车东行穿过第一道通道，换到车南侧推车北行（车轮打滑前进）到目标车道路缘，再换到车西侧把车推过第二道通道进入目标区，撤开后让货箱停稳。要回答的问题是短行程怎样分段推、能否不换侧过通道；本见证仍然换侧。
design.en: The robot reverses and pushes the crate along the rails onto the cart with the rear of its base, pushes the cart east through the first passage, moves to the south side and pushes the cart north (wheels sliding) to the goal-lane curb, then moves to the west side and pushes the cart through the second passage into the goal, and backs off while the crate settles. The questions are how to segment pushes with a short stroke and whether the passages can be passed without changing sides; this witness still changes sides.

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 247.32 s，货箱在车上、目标区内直立停稳 2 s，未翻倒。轮地摩擦 1.0 为假设、未实测；完整路线仍需换侧。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 247.32 s; crate upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for 2 s, no tip-over. Wheel friction 1.0 is assumed, not measured; the full route still changes sides.

title.zh: Stretch 3 用 T02 低推杆的完整路线（第 1 层）
title.en: Stretch 3 full route using the T02 low push bar (layer 1)

conditions.zh: 第 1 层的另一条有效路线，不另计层或 case：车南侧装统一几何的 0.45 m T02 低推杆，G1 用不了它。身体换为 Stretch 3，放在原世界 G1 的起点：20 kg 货箱、导轨、T01 车（南侧装有本轨道几何的 T02 低推杆）和两道错位通道，货箱须留在车上交付到 1.40 m 目标区。伸缩臂行程约 0.52 m、推力上限约 56 N，要与底盘配合分段推；轮地摩擦 1.0 是模型假设。仿真预算 600 s。
conditions.en: An alternative valid layer-1 route, not a separate layer or case: the cart carries the canonical 0.45 m T02 low push bar on its south side, which the G1 cannot use. The body is a Stretch 3 at the G1 start of the original world: 20 kg crate, rails, the T01 cart (with a T02 low push bar on its south side) and two offset passages; the crate must be delivered on the cart into the 1.40 m goal. The telescoping arm has about 0.52 m of stroke and about 56 N of push, so it must push in segments together with the base; wheel friction 1.0 is a model assumption. Simulation budget 600 s.

design.zh: 装车和东行段同第 1 层；北行段改为闭合夹爪抵住 T02，按实测车体偏航选择接触位置，用 0.14 m 短行程连续推九次；随后换到车西侧把车推过第二道通道进入目标区。
design.en: Loading and the east leg are as in layer 1; on the north leg the closed gripper pushes on T02, choosing the contact point from the measured cart yaw, in nine short 0.14 m strokes; the robot then moves to the west side and pushes the cart through the second passage into the goal.

tools.zh: 滚轮装载导轨＋T01 标准托盘车（车把手 0.85 m，货箱带推块）
tools.en: Roller loading rails + T01 standard pallet cart (cart handle 0.85 m, crate push blocks)

tools.zh: T02 车尾低位推杆，0.45 m
tools.en: T02 low push bar on the cart, 0.45 m

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3
embodiment.en: Stretch 3

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 422.40 s，货箱在车上、目标区内直立停稳 2 s，未翻倒；北向段只有指尖与 T02 接触（峰值 34.3 N），车体最大偏航 1.98°。仍需换侧；轮地摩擦 1.0 为假设。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 422.40 s; crate upright and settled on the cart inside the goal for 2 s, no tip-over; on the north leg only fingertip-to-T02 contact occurs (34.3 N peak), with at most 1.98 degrees of cart yaw. Side changes are still needed; wheel friction 1.0 is assumed.

name.zh: 杠杆辅助重物运输（H5-X 跨身体扩展）

summary.zh: 把 100 kg 货箱（0.60 × 0.54 × 0.48 m）运到房间远端的 1.6 × 1.6 m 目标区，使其直立、静止、由工具或地面支撑并保持 2 秒；运输时货箱须由托架等工具承载、不能在地面上拖，交付前机器人须松手。G1＋Dex3、Galaxea R1 与 Stretch 3 要各自选出与自身体重、推力和下压能力相符的工具路线：踏台杠杆、锁止手压杠杆或楔形鼻托架。L3 配对在同一场景中隐藏一项能力或材料参数，H5S-09 则是正确行为为空手退出的不可完成场景。
summary.en: Move a 100 kg cargo box (0.60 × 0.54 × 0.48 m) into a 1.6 × 1.6 m goal at the far end of the room and leave it upright, still and supported by tools or the floor for 2 s; during transport the cargo must ride on tools such as skates rather than be dragged on the floor, and the robot must let go before delivery. G1 + Dex3, Galaxea R1 and Stretch 3 each have to pick a tool route that matches their own weight, push force and press force: platform lever, latching hand lever or wedge-nose skate. L3 pairs hide one capability or material parameter in the same scene, and H5S-09 is an infeasible scene whose correct behaviour is an empty-handed exit.

acceptance.zh: 2026-10-31 作者审阅统一视角 8 倍速视频后整体验收通过：13 项扩展任务的修订版参考见证（12 项交付、1 项退出 Q）与 1 条现存原场景对照，另附 2 条预期停滞的 A 路线探针；签收范围为 14/14 当前修订参考，原严格能力对照主张仍按原边界记录。剩余限制：05 为身体专用布局，不是同一初始场景的跨身体比较；06 改为摩擦边界负对照，原强制换支点未验证；03、07 使用改版杠杆，07、08 只证明所记录的 A 路线反例；全部为单次特权状态参考运行，无可靠性测量或正式准入，部分见证的冻结复现源码与原 5/5 发布包原始证据仍待补齐。
acceptance.en: On 2026-10-31 the author accepted the delivery as a whole after reviewing the unified-view 8x videos: revised reference witnesses for the 13 extension tasks (12 deliveries, 1 exit to Q) and one existing original-scene control, plus 2 A-route probes that stall as expected; the signed scope is 14/14 current-revision references, while the original strict capability-contrast claims stay recorded within their original limits. Remaining limits: 05 uses body-specific layouts rather than an identical initial scene; 06 became a friction-boundary negative control and the original forced fulcrum switch was not validated; 03 and 07 use redesigned levers, and 07 and 08 only support the recorded A-route counterexamples; all are single privileged-state reference runs with no reliability measurement or formal admission, and frozen reproduction sources for some witnesses and the raw evidence of the original 5/5 release still need to be restored.

axes.zh: 身体（G1＋Dex3、Galaxea R1、Stretch 3）；场景提供的工具组合（踏台杠杆与支点、锁止手压杠杆、楔形鼻托架与路缘、槽形支点、牵引杆）及货箱底脚摩擦（0.65 或 1.0）；L3 隐藏参数（普通支点材料摩擦 0.85／0.2、Stretch 升降柱向下力上限 100／5 N、R1 轮子力矩上限 15／6 N·m）；可行与不可行（平放货箱）。
axes.en: Body (G1 + Dex3, Galaxea R1, Stretch 3); the tool set in the scene (platform lever and fulcrum, latching hand lever, wedge-nose skate and curb, channel fulcrum, tow bar) and cargo-foot friction (0.65 or 1.0); L3 hidden parameters (plain-fulcrum material friction 0.85/0.2, Stretch lift downward force limit 100/5 N, R1 wheel torque limit 15/6 N·m); feasible versus infeasible (flat cargo).

embodiments.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足）
embodiments.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid)

embodiments.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂）
embodiments.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms)

embodiments.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂）
embodiments.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with a single telescoping arm)

title.zh: 原任务：踏台杠杆抬升与托架推运
title.en: Original task: platform-lever lift and skate transport

conditions.zh: 原始层级；S-orig（lever-insertion-v3，固定种子布局）：100 kg 货箱远端已搁在一台托架上，货箱与地面摩擦 0.65；G1 能力全部公开；原任务仿真时间预算 300 s。
conditions.en: Original level; S-orig (lever-insertion-v3, fixed seed layout): 100 kg cargo with its far end already resting on one skate, cargo-floor friction 0.65; all G1 capabilities public; original simulation budget 300 s.

design.zh: G1 须踩下踏台杠杆抬起货箱近端，把第二台托架推到近端下方，使货箱整体落在两台托架上，然后离开踏台、把货箱推进目标区，松手并站稳。
design.en: The G1 must step on the platform lever to raise the cargo's near end, push the second skate under it so the whole cargo rests on both skates, then step off, push the cargo into the goal, let go and stand.

tools.zh: 踏台杠杆（3.0 kg，机械优势约 2.6，只能推不能搬）
tools.en: Platform lever (3.0 kg, mechanical advantage about 2.6; push only, not carried)

tools.zh: 普通支点（1.8 kg）
tools.en: Plain fulcrum (1.8 kg)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid)

result.zh: 成功：本轮复核的是 2026-10-28 现存原场景对照运行，150.76 s 完成全部阶段，货箱运输 3.75 m，运输中地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s，未倒地。原发布范围为全程 5/5、独立子任务 20/20（2026-10-23），其原始录像在当前工作区缺失、本次未重新核验；该对照不是新的物理复验。
result.en: Success: the item reviewed in this round is the existing 2026-10-28 original-scene control run, which completed every stage in 150.76 s, moved the cargo 3.75 m with zero floor support during transport, and held 2 s after release with no fall. The original release scope is 5/5 full runs and 20/20 standalone subtasks (2026-10-23); those raw recordings are missing from the current workspace and were not revalidated, and the control is not a new physical revalidation.

title.zh: 高摩擦底脚：杠杆路线与拖运必要性
title.en: High-friction feet: lever route and drag necessity

conditions.zh: L1（已知能力）；S-hard：同 S-orig，但货箱四个底脚与地面摩擦提高到 1.0；G1＋Dex3，能力公开。
conditions.en: L1 (known capability); S-hard: as S-orig, but the cargo's four feet have friction 1.0 against the floor; G1 + Dex3, capabilities public.

design.zh: 抬升、插托架和在托架上推运不受底脚摩擦影响，原杠杆路线应可沿用；底脚摩擦提高后，不用杠杆直接拖动近端约需 400 N，高于 G1 在仿真中约 337 N 的静态推力上界，用来把工具必要性落到力的上界上。
design.en: Lifting, skate insertion and pushing on skates do not depend on cargo-foot friction, so the original lever route should carry over; with the higher friction, dragging the near end without a lever needs about 400 N, above the G1's static push bound of about 337 N in simulation, which grounds tool necessity in a force bound.

tools.zh: 踏台杠杆（3.0 kg，机械优势约 2.6，只能推不能搬）
tools.en: Platform lever (3.0 kg, mechanical advantage about 2.6; push only, not carried)

tools.zh: 普通支点（1.8 kg）
tools.en: Plain fulcrum (1.8 kg)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid)

result.zh: 成功：冻结控制器沿原路线 151.64 s 完成全部阶段，货箱运输 3.74 m，运输中地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s。无杠杆拖运探针只让货箱移动 1.7 mm；工具必要性仍是余量约 1.19× 的静态力论证，不是证明。
result.en: Success: the frozen controller completed every stage along the original route in 151.64 s, moving the cargo 3.74 m with zero floor support during transport and a 2 s hold after release. A no-lever drag probe moved the cargo only 1.7 mm; tool necessity remains a static force argument with about 1.19x margin, not a proof.

title.zh: Stretch 3 锁止手压杠杆
title.en: Stretch 3 latching hand lever

conditions.zh: L1；S-lever v2：底脚摩擦 1.0，放置 MA 10 锁止手压杠杆（原设计 MA 5 的改版）和托架，没有踏台杠杆；Stretch 3 升降柱力限 ±100 N，能力公开。
conditions.en: L1; S-lever v2: cargo-foot friction 1.0, with an MA 10 latching hand lever (a redesign of the original MA 5) and skates but no platform lever; Stretch 3 lift force limit ±100 N, capabilities public.

design.zh: Stretch 3 体重轻，实测下压约 61–76 N 时底盘就会离地，用不了踏台杠杆。须压下 MA 10 杠杆直到棘爪锁住，空出手臂把托架推到近端下方，按释放片放下近端，再用伸缩臂推托架把货箱送进目标区并退开。
design.en: Stretch 3 is light: measured downward presses of about 61-76 N already lift its base, so the platform lever is out. It must press the MA 10 lever until the pawl locks, use the freed arm to push a skate under the near end, press the release tab to lower the near end, then push the skate with the telescoping arm until the cargo is in the goal, and back off.

tools.zh: MA 10 锁止手压杠杆（压下后棘爪锁住，按释放片放下）
tools.en: MA 10 latching hand lever (a pawl locks it when pressed; a release tab lowers it)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with a single telescoping arm)

result.zh: 成功：一次连续运行 407.96 s，货箱运输 3.30 m，运输中地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s，峰值压杆力 57.2 N。属记录在案的 MA 10 改版单次见证，原 MA 5 力臂设计未获验证；最大关节速度比约 1.07，按规则只记录、不作门槛。
result.en: Success: one continuous run of 407.96 s moved the cargo 3.30 m with zero floor support during transport and a 2 s hold after release; peak lever press 57.2 N. This is a single witness of the recorded MA 10 redesign, and the original MA 5 lever design is not validated; the maximum joint speed ratio of about 1.07 is recorded, not gated.

title.zh: R1 楔形鼻托架
title.en: R1 wedge-nose skate

conditions.zh: L1；S-wedge：底脚摩擦 1.0，货箱远端在一台普通托架上，另有两台楔形鼻托架和货箱对侧的固定路缘；Galaxea R1 轮子力矩上限 15 N·m，能力公开。
conditions.en: L1; S-wedge: cargo-foot friction 1.0, cargo far end on one plain skate, plus two wedge-nose skates and a fixed curb on the cargo's opposite side; Galaxea R1 wheel torque limit 15 N·m, capabilities public.

design.zh: R1 站不上踏台杠杆，手臂下压也有限，但底盘推力大。须抓住楔形托架的两根立柱，用底盘把它从侧面楔入货箱近端下方（路缘挡住货箱），松手后绕到近端，用底盘把骑在两台托架上的货箱推进目标区。
design.en: The R1 cannot stand on the platform lever and its arm press is limited, but its base pushes hard. It must grasp the wedge skate's two posts, drive it sideways under the cargo's near end with the base (the curb holds the cargo), let go, move round to the near end, and push the cargo, now riding on two skates, into the goal with the base.

tools.zh: 楔形鼻托架（托板加滚轮，带两根抓取立柱）
tools.en: Wedge-nose skate (plate with rollers and two grasp posts)

tools.zh: 固定路缘（挡住货箱不被侧推走）
tools.en: Fixed curb (keeps the cargo from being pushed sideways)

tools.zh: 一台普通双轮托架（垫在远端下）
tools.en: One plain two-wheel skate (under the far end)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms)

result.zh: 成功：126.5 s 完成，楔入时托板推力峰值 266 N，运输 3.37 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 7.22 s。楔形托架与路缘均为记录在案的改版，楔面只把近端抬高 8.6 mm；R1 的工具必要性只靠运输承重规则；物理选项为椭圆摩擦锥、关闭扭转摩擦；单次运行。
result.en: Success: completed in 126.5 s with a peak plate push of 266 N during wedging, 3.37 m of transport with zero floor support and a 7.22 s hold after release. The wedge skate and curb are recorded redesigns and the wedge raises the near end only 8.6 mm; tool necessity for the R1 rests only on the transport-support rule; physics options are an elliptic friction cone with torsional friction off; single run.

title.zh: 工具类别对照（v8）· G1
title.en: Tool-family comparison (v8) · G1

conditions.zh: L2（工具选择）；S-toolkit-v8 的 G1 专用布局：底脚摩擦 1.0，全部工具类别实物在场，新增工具停放在离货箱较远的一排、避开 G1 路线；能力公开。
conditions.en: L2 (tool choice); G1-specific layout of S-toolkit-v8: cargo-foot friction 1.0, every tool family physically present, with the added tools parked in a row away from the cargo and clear of the G1 route; capabilities public.

design.zh: 同一 100 kg 目标下提供多类工具，看每种身体能否选出适合自己的一类。G1 选择踏台杠杆 → 双托架 → 推运，没有碰手压杠杆、楔形托架、牵引杆和路缘。
design.en: Several tool families are offered for the same 100 kg goal to see whether each body picks one that suits it. The G1 chooses platform lever, then two skates, then pushing, and never touches the hand lever, wedge skate, tow bar or curb.

tools.en: Platform lever (3.0 kg, mechanical advantage about 2.6; push only, not carried)

tools.en: MA 10 latching hand lever (a pawl locks it when pressed; a release tab lowers it)

embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid)

result.zh: 成功：152.98 s 完成全部阶段，货箱运输 3.75 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s，停放工具受力 0 N；另一种 CPU 上的重复也通过。v8 为身体专用布局，不是三种身体在完全相同初始场景下的比较。
result.en: Success: every stage completed in 152.98 s, moving the cargo 3.75 m with zero floor support and a 2 s hold after release, with 0 N on the parked tools; a repeat on another CPU type also passed. v8 uses body-specific layouts, so this is not a comparison of the three bodies in an identical initial scene.

title.zh: 工具类别对照（v8）· R1
title.en: Tool-family comparison (v8) · R1

conditions.zh: L2；S-toolkit-v8 的 R1 专用布局：底脚摩擦 1.0，全部工具类别实物在场并停放在远处，需自行取用；轮子力矩上限 15 N·m，能力公开。
conditions.en: L2; R1-specific layout of S-toolkit-v8: cargo-foot friction 1.0, every tool family physically present and parked away from the cargo, so tools must be fetched; wheel torque limit 15 N·m, capabilities public.

design.zh: R1 实体取来停放的楔形托架，楔入货箱近端下方后松手，再绕到近端，经北侧通道用底盘推运货箱。
design.en: The R1 physically fetches the parked wedge skate, wedges it under the cargo's near end, lets go, then moves round to the near end and pushes the cargo with its base along the north aisle.

tools.zh: 踏台杠杆（3.0 kg，机械优势约 2.6，只能推不能搬）

tools.zh: MA 10 锁止手压杠杆（压下后棘爪锁住，按释放片放下）
tools.en: MA 10 latching hand lever (a pawl locks it when pressed; a release tab lowers it)

tools.zh: 楔形鼻托架（托板加滚轮，带两根抓取立柱）
