embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms)

result.zh: 成功：380.9 s 完成，楔入推力峰值 434 N（高于规划估计 323 N），运输 3.36 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 7.2 s；推运时顺带碰动了其他自由工具。身体专用布局，不等同于 G1 的布局。
result.en: Success: completed in 380.9 s with a peak wedging push of 434 N (above the 323 N planning estimate), 3.36 m of transport with zero floor support and a 7.2 s hold after release; the push also nudged other free tools. Body-specific layout, not the same as the G1's.

title.zh: 工具类别对照（v8）· Stretch 3
title.en: Tool-family comparison (v8) · Stretch 3

conditions.zh: L2；S-toolkit-v8 的 Stretch 专用布局：底脚摩擦 1.0，踏台杠杆、支点、楔形托架、牵引杆、路缘等替代工具实物在场；升降柱力限 ±100 N，能力公开。
conditions.en: L2; Stretch-specific layout of S-toolkit-v8: cargo-foot friction 1.0, with the alternative tools (platform lever, fulcrum, wedge skate, tow bar, curb) physically present; lift force limit ±100 N, capabilities public.

design.zh: 沿用 H5S-03 已成功的未改动控制器：压 MA 10 手压杠杆并锁住 → 插托架 → 用伸缩臂推运，其余工具留在场景中不用。
design.en: The unmodified successful H5S-03 controller is reused: press and latch the MA 10 hand lever, insert a skate, push with the telescoping arm, leaving the other tools in the scene unused.

tools.zh: 踏台杠杆（3.0 kg，机械优势约 2.6，只能推不能搬）
tools.en: Platform lever (3.0 kg, mechanical advantage about 2.6; push only, not carried)

tools.zh: 普通支点（1.8 kg）
tools.en: Plain fulcrum (1.8 kg)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

tools.zh: MA 10 锁止手压杠杆（压下后棘爪锁住，按释放片放下）
tools.en: MA 10 latching hand lever (a pawl locks it when pressed; a release tab lowers it)

tools.zh: 楔形鼻托架（托板加滚轮，带两根抓取立柱）
tools.en: Wedge-nose skate (plate with rollers and two grasp posts)

tools.zh: 刚性牵引杆
tools.en: Rigid tow bar

tools.zh: 固定路缘（挡住货箱不被侧推走）
tools.en: Fixed curb (keeps the cargo from being pushed sideways)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with a single telescoping arm)

result.zh: 成功：408.22 s 完成，货箱运输 3.30 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s，最大倾斜 0.25°；运输接触力峰值 83.1 N，高于原 26 N 估计。身体专用布局，单次特权状态参考运行。
result.en: Success: completed in 408.22 s, moving the cargo 3.30 m with zero floor support and a 2 s hold after release, maximum tilt 0.25°; peak transport contact force 83.1 N, above the original 26 N estimate. Body-specific layout; a single privileged-state reference run.

title.zh: 摩擦边界对照 A：普通支点 μ 0.85
title.en: Friction-boundary pair A: plain fulcrum μ 0.85

conditions.zh: L3 对照（v11）；S-fulcrum：原 v1 物理，普通支点材料摩擦 0.85（原发布值），另停放一个槽形支点；G1＋Dex3；隐藏参数为普通支点材料摩擦。
conditions.en: L3 control (v11); S-fulcrum: original v1 physics, plain-fulcrum material friction 0.85 (the released value), plus a parked channel fulcrum; G1 + Dex3; the hidden parameter is the plain fulcrum's material friction.

design.zh: 与 06.B 几何完全相同，只差普通支点的材料摩擦。G1 沿原踏台杠杆 → 托架 → 推运路线完成，槽形支点不需要。
design.en: Geometry is identical to 06.B; only the plain fulcrum's material friction differs. The G1 follows the original platform lever, skates and push route; the channel fulcrum is not needed.

tools.zh: 踏台杠杆（3.0 kg，机械优势约 2.6，只能推不能搬）
tools.en: Platform lever (3.0 kg, mechanical advantage about 2.6; push only, not carried)

tools.zh: 普通支点（1.8 kg）
tools.en: Plain fulcrum (1.8 kg)

tools.zh: 槽形支点（1.8 kg，停放在远处）
tools.en: Channel fulcrum (1.8 kg, parked away from the route)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid)

result.zh: 成功：152.04 s 完成全部阶段，货箱运输 3.75 m，杠杆相对支点最大滑移 0.95 cm。仅为单次参考：同一冻结控制器在另一种 CPU 上确定性失败，v11 补跑的 A 重复运行在推运开始时撞到踏台（1316 N）失败，不声称可靠性。
result.en: Success: every stage completed in 152.04 s, moving the cargo 3.75 m, with at most 0.95 cm of lever slip on the fulcrum. Single reference only: the same frozen controller fails deterministically on another CPU type, and the fresh v11 repeat of A failed when it hit the platform (1316 N) at the start of transport, so no reliability is claimed.

title.zh: 摩擦边界负对照 B：普通支点 μ 0.2
title.en: Friction-boundary negative control B: plain fulcrum μ 0.2

conditions.zh: L3 负对照（v11）；与 06.A 同场景，普通支点材料摩擦降到 0.2（隐藏，第一步前写入）；仿真中接触摩擦取两种材料的较大值，杠杆与支点之间的有效摩擦仍为 0.65。
conditions.en: L3 negative control (v11); same scene as 06.A with the plain fulcrum's material friction lowered to 0.2 (hidden, set before the first step); the simulator uses the larger of the two materials' friction, so the lever-fulcrum contact stays at 0.65.

design.zh: 原设计希望低摩擦迫使改用槽形支点；实测原路线在 B 下仍可行，v11 因此改为负对照：正确做法是依据证据保留可行的原路线并完整交付，不要求换工具。
design.en: The original design expected low friction to force a switch to the channel fulcrum; measurements showed the original route still works under B, so v11 turns it into a negative control: the correct behaviour is to keep the viable original route on the evidence and deliver in full, with no tool switch required.

tools.zh: 踏台杠杆（3.0 kg，机械优势约 2.6，只能推不能搬）
tools.en: Platform lever (3.0 kg, mechanical advantage about 2.6; push only, not carried)

tools.zh: 普通支点（1.8 kg）
tools.en: Plain fulcrum (1.8 kg)

tools.zh: 槽形支点（1.8 kg，停放在远处）
tools.en: Channel fulcrum (1.8 kg, parked away from the route)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid)

result.zh: 成功：保留原踏台杠杆与托架路线，154.56 s 完成，近端抬起 29.1 mm，运输 3.75 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s。原“强制换支点”要求已撤回、未通过，槽形支点的取放未完成。
result.en: Success: the original platform-lever and skate route was kept and completed in 154.56 s, lifting the near end 29.1 mm and moving the cargo 3.75 m with zero floor support and a 2 s hold after release. The original forced fulcrum-switch requirement was withdrawn and not passed; picking up and installing the channel fulcrum was never completed.

title.zh: 机械优势对照 A：升降柱力限 ±100 N
title.en: Mechanical-advantage pair A: lift force ±100 N

conditions.zh: L3（v4 改版）；S-ma v4：底脚摩擦 1.0，一根带 MA 10 与 MA 12 两个按压点的锁止手压杠杆和托架；Stretch 3 升降柱向下、向上力限均为 100 N（隐藏配置）。
conditions.en: L3 (v4 redesign); S-ma v4: cargo-foot friction 1.0, one latching hand lever with MA 10 and MA 12 press points, plus skates; Stretch 3 lift force limit 100 N both down and up (hidden profile).

design.zh: 此配置下两个按压点都可行，Stretch 3 用 MA 10 按压点抬起并锁住杠杆，插托架后推运。与 07.B 配对，检验能否按自身下压能力选择机械优势。
design.en: Both press points work under this profile; Stretch 3 uses the MA 10 point to lift and latch the lever, inserts a skate and pushes. Paired with 07.B to test choosing a mechanical advantage that matches the robot's own press force.

tools.zh: 双按压点锁止手压杠杆（MA 10 与 MA 12 两个按压点）
tools.en: Dual-pad latching hand lever (MA 10 and MA 12 press points)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with a single telescoping arm)

result.zh: 成功：418.78 s 完成，货箱运输 3.29 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s，峰值压杆力 49.6 N。记录在案的 v4 改版；原 MA 4/MA 6 设计未获验证；速度比约 1.07 只记录。
result.en: Success: completed in 418.78 s, moving the cargo 3.29 m with zero floor support and a 2 s hold after release; peak lever press 49.6 N. Recorded v4 redesign; the original MA 4/MA 6 design is not validated; the speed ratio of about 1.07 is recorded only.

title.zh: 受限下压力 B：改用 MA 12
title.en: Limited press force B: switch to MA 12

conditions.zh: L3（v4 改版）；与 07.A 同场景，隐藏配置改为升降柱向下力上限 5 N、向上 100 N（第一步前写入执行器）。
conditions.en: L3 (v4 redesign); same scene as 07.A, with the hidden profile changed to a 5 N downward and 100 N upward lift force limit (written into the actuator before the first step).

design.zh: 此配置下 MA 10 按压点压不到锁止所需的插入间隙，机器人须改用机械优势更大的 MA 12 按压点完成抬升、插托架与推运。
design.en: Under this profile the MA 10 point cannot open enough insertion clearance to latch, so the robot must switch to the higher-advantage MA 12 point to lift, insert the skate and push.

tools.zh: 双按压点锁止手压杠杆（MA 10 与 MA 12 两个按压点）
tools.en: Dual-pad latching hand lever (MA 10 and MA 12 press points)

tools.zh: 两台双轮托架（各 8 kg，其中一台起始时垫在货箱远端下）
tools.en: Two two-wheel skates (8 kg each; one starts under the cargo's far end)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with a single telescoping arm)

result.zh: 成功：改用 MA 12 路线，428.28 s 完成，运输 3.30 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 2 s，峰值压杆力 42.5 N；同场景探针中 MA 10 停滞在 2.76 mm 插入间隙。原 MA 4/6 与对称 60 N 方案未获验证；速度比约 1.07 只记录。
result.en: Success: on the MA 12 route, completed in 428.28 s, moving the cargo 3.30 m with zero floor support and a 2 s hold after release, peak lever press 42.5 N; in a same-scene probe the MA 10 route stalled at 2.76 mm of insertion clearance. The original MA 4/6 and symmetric 60 N designs are not validated; the speed ratio of about 1.07 is recorded only.

title.zh: 轮子力矩对照 A：15 N·m
title.en: Wheel-torque pair A: 15 N·m

conditions.zh: L3；S-ma-wedge：底脚摩擦 1.0，一台楔形鼻托架、一根 MA 10 锁止手压杠杆、远端下的普通托架和固定路缘；Galaxea R1 轮子力矩上限 15 N·m（隐藏配置，第一步前写入）。
conditions.en: L3; S-ma-wedge: cargo-foot friction 1.0, one wedge-nose skate, one MA 10 latching hand lever, a plain skate under the far end and a fixed curb; Galaxea R1 wheel torque limit 15 N·m (hidden profile, set before the first step).

design.zh: 力矩充足时，R1 用底盘把楔形托架楔入近端下方即可，再推运货箱；与 08.B 只差轮子力矩。
design.en: With enough wheel torque the R1 simply wedges the skate under the near end with its base and then pushes the cargo; it differs from 08.B only in wheel torque.

tools.zh: 楔形鼻托架（托板加滚轮，带两根抓取立柱）
tools.en: Wedge-nose skate (plate with rollers and two grasp posts)

tools.zh: MA 10 锁止手压杠杆（压下后棘爪锁住，按释放片放下）
tools.en: MA 10 latching hand lever (a pawl locks it when pressed; a release tab lowers it)

tools.zh: 一台普通双轮托架（垫在远端下）
tools.en: One plain two-wheel skate (under the far end)

tools.zh: 固定路缘（挡住货箱不被侧推走）
tools.en: Fixed curb (keeps the cargo from being pushed sideways)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms)

result.zh: 成功：只用楔形托架路线，164.9 s 完成，楔入推力 p95 326.94 N、峰值 347.55 N，运输 3.39 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 7.24 s。单次见证，只证明这组参考路线对照。
result.en: Success: wedge-skate route only, completed in 164.9 s with a wedging push of 326.94 N (p95) and 347.55 N peak, 3.39 m of transport with zero floor support and a 7.24 s hold after release. Single witness; it supports this reference route contrast only.

title.zh: 轮子力矩受限 B：6 N·m，改用手压杠杆
title.en: Limited wheel torque B: 6 N·m, switch to the hand lever

conditions.zh: L3；与 08.A 同场景，R1 轮子力矩上限降为 6 N·m（隐藏配置，第一步前写入）。
conditions.en: L3; same scene as 08.A, with the R1 wheel torque limit lowered to 6 N·m (hidden profile, set before the first step).

design.zh: 6 N·m 时同一楔形插入路线在轮子力矩饱和下停滞，机器人须改用手臂压下 MA 10 手压杠杆抬起近端并锁住，再插入托架推运。
design.en: At 6 N·m the same wedge-insertion route stalls with the wheels saturated, so the robot must instead press the MA 10 hand lever with its arm to lift and latch the near end, then insert the skate and push.

tools.zh: 楔形鼻托架（托板加滚轮，带两根抓取立柱）
tools.en: Wedge-nose skate (plate with rollers and two grasp posts)

tools.zh: MA 10 锁止手压杠杆（压下后棘爪锁住，按释放片放下）
tools.en: MA 10 latching hand lever (a pawl locks it when pressed; a release tab lowers it)

tools.zh: 一台普通双轮托架（垫在远端下）
tools.en: One plain two-wheel skate (under the far end)

tools.zh: 固定路缘（挡住货箱不被侧推走）
tools.en: Fixed curb (keeps the cargo from being pushed sideways)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms)

result.zh: 成功：改用手压杠杆，225.6 s 完成，压杆力 p95 41.91 N，运输 3.44 m，地面承重为零，释放后保持 7.20 s。同场景 A 路线探针在 6 N·m 下楔入停滞（推力 p95 236.88 N，轮子力矩饱和）；单次见证，不证明所有楔形策略都不可行。
result.en: Success: on the hand-lever route, completed in 225.6 s with a lever press of 41.91 N (p95), 3.44 m of transport with zero floor support and a 7.20 s hold after release. A same-scene probe of the A route stalled during wedging at 6 N·m (push 236.88 N p95, wheels saturated); single witness, not proof that every wedge strategy fails.

title.zh: 不可完成：识别并退出
title.en: Infeasible: recognise and exit

conditions.zh: 不可完成；S-flat v1：100 kg 货箱平放在地面中央，没有预垫托架，摩擦 0.65；场景只有 MA 4 锁止手压杠杆和两台普通托架，没有踏台杠杆；Stretch 3 升降柱力限 100 N。正确行为：空手进入 Q 区并静止 3 秒。
conditions.en: Infeasible; S-flat v1: the 100 kg cargo sits flat on the floor with no skate under it, friction 0.65; the scene has only an MA 4 latching hand lever and two plain skates, no platform lever; Stretch 3 lift force limit 100 N. Correct behaviour: enter zone Q empty-handed and stay still for 3 s.

design.zh: 机器人须判断任何路线都超出 Stretch 3 的力量：下压在约 76 N 时就因底盘离地封顶，水平推力受轮子牵引与倾翻限制在约 160 N 以内。识别后不碰任何可动物体，驶入 Q 区停稳。
design.en: The robot must judge that every route exceeds what Stretch 3 can apply: its downward press is capped at about 76 N by base lift-off and its horizontal force at about 160 N by wheel traction and tipping. Having recognised this, it touches no movable object and drives into Q and stops.

tools.zh: MA 4 锁止手压杠杆
tools.en: MA 4 latching hand lever

tools.zh: 两台普通双轮托架
tools.en: Two plain two-wheel skates

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with a single telescoping arm)

refusal_note.zh: 路线类别证书：用 MA 4 杠杆抬起一边至少需约 110 N，而实测可用下压只有约 76 N；拖、推或绕底脚转动货箱至少需约 367 N，超过约 161.5 N 的牵引上界；机械优势更小的杠杆、配重、推楔、推翻和夹爪直接抬起也都被排除。拖运与 MA 4 抬升两类有探针实测支撑，其余为论证；文档未指定可解孪生任务。
refusal_note.en: Route-class certificate: lifting an edge with the MA 4 lever needs at least about 110 N while the measured available press is about 76 N; dragging, pushing or pivoting the cargo needs at least about 367 N, above the roughly 161.5 N traction bound; levers with less advantage, counterweights, wedging a skate, tipping and lifting with the gripper are also excluded. The drag and MA 4 lift classes are backed by probes, the rest by argument; the docs name no solvable twin.

result.zh: 正确退出：32.6 s 时机器人整体包围盒位于 Q 区内，保持静止至少 3 s，与可动物体无接触，未倒地。证书只适用于该场景与所列路线类别；单次运行。
result.en: Correct exit: at 32.6 s the robot's whole bounding box was inside Q and it stayed still for at least 3 s, with no contact with movable objects and no fall. The certificate covers only this scene and the listed route classes; single run.

name.zh: 负重上下楼（H6-X 跨身体楼层运输）
name.en: Loaded stair transport (H6-X cross-embodiment floor-to-floor transport)

summary.zh: 把箱子从一侧地面经 1.20 m 高的顶部平台运到另一侧地面目标区：机器人自身须和箱子同时位于平台高度保持 2 秒（只送箱子或只上人都不算），之后箱子在目标区落地、直立静止、无机器人接触，机器人站稳 2 秒。原任务由 G1 抱 2 kg 提手箱走 10 级上楼、10 级下楼；扩展任务让 G1、Galaxea R1 和 Stretch 3 按自身移动与负载能力选择楼梯、12° 坡道、载人升降梯、送货井或托盘，任何机器人携带都不得超过 2 kg。没有可行路线时，正确行为是空手退入 Q 区。
summary.en: Move a box from the floor on one side, via a 1.20 m-high top platform, to a ground goal on the other side: the robot itself must be on the platform together with the box at platform height for 2 s (sending only the box, or only the robot, does not count), after which the box must rest in the goal upright, still and free of robot contact while the robot stands still for 2 s. In the original task a G1 carries a 2 kg handled box up 10 steps and down 10 steps; the extension lets G1, Galaxea R1 and Stretch 3 choose stairs, a 12° ramp, a passenger lift, a dumbwaiter or a tray to suit their own mobility and payload, with no robot carrying more than 2 kg. When no route exists, the correct behaviour is an empty-handed exit into zone Q.

acceptance.zh: 2026-10-31 作者确认“通过，发布吧”：审阅范围为原任务已发布范围加 13 项当前修订扩展，固定公共机位、默认 8 倍速播放，签收 14/14 当前修订。限制：G1 三项（L2.G、P01.G.A/B）为 revision4 预装货井协调任务，原 G1 地面装卸目标仍未解决、不计为成功，也未证明按质量选择最优路线；R1／Stretch 的 L2 为 revision3，允许托盘放地交付；原 H6 只计已发布范围（admitted=false，第二人复现待完成）；全部为单种子特权状态参考，不声称正式准入或一般 agent 能力。
acceptance.en: On 2026-10-31 the author confirmed 'pass, publish': the reviewed scope is the released scope of the original task plus 13 current-revision extensions, shown from a fixed common camera at a default 8x playback, signed as 14/14 current revisions. Limits: the three G1 tasks (L2.G, P01.G.A/B) are revision4 preloaded-freight coordination tasks, the original G1 floor loading/unloading goal remains unresolved and is not counted as solved, and mass-dependent route choice is not demonstrated; the R1/Stretch L2 tasks are revision3, which allows delivering the tray on the floor; the original H6 counts only within its released scope (admitted=false, second-person reproduction pending); all are single-seed privileged-state references with no claim of formal admission or general agent capability.

axes.zh: 身体（G1＋Dex3、Galaxea R1、Stretch 3）；场景中的通行与搬运工具（只有楼梯、12° 坡道、小／大升降梯、送货井、托盘）；箱子类型（2 kg 提手箱、1.4 kg 无提手箱加 0.6 kg 托盘、外观相同的隐藏质量箱）；L3 隐藏参数（R1 轮子力矩 15／4 N·m，箱子质量 1.8／2.6 kg，G1 预装 2.0／3.0 kg）；是否存在可行路线（无坡道无升降梯时退出）；G1 revision4 的货物预装与底站交付。
axes.en: Body (G1 + Dex3, Galaxea R1, Stretch 3); the access and handling aids in the scene (stairs only, 12° ramp, small or large lift, dumbwaiter, tray); box type (2 kg handled box, 1.4 kg handle-free box with a 0.6 kg tray, identical-looking boxes of hidden mass); L3 hidden parameters (R1 wheel torque 15/4 N·m, box mass 1.8/2.6 kg, G1 preloaded 2.0/3.0 kg); whether any route exists (exit when there is no ramp or lift); and the G1 revision4 preloaded cargo with docked delivery.

embodiments.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足，可走楼梯）
embodiments.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid; can climb stairs)

embodiments.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂，轮子半径 0.07 m）
embodiments.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms; wheel radius 0.07 m)

embodiments.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂单夹爪，驱动轮半径 0.0508 m）
embodiments.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with one telescoping arm and gripper; drive wheel radius 0.0508 m)

title.zh: 原任务：抱箱上下楼
title.en: Original task: carry the box up and down the stairs

conditions.zh: 原始层级；S-orig：10 级上楼（踢面 0.12 m、踏面 0.40 m）、1.20 m 高顶部平台、10 级下楼；2 kg 含提手箱（Poly Haven Wooden Crate 02 外观，提手为任务自制），固定种子；能力公开；回合预算 600 s 仿真时间。
conditions.en: Original level; S-orig: 10 steps up (0.12 m risers, 0.40 m treads), a 1.20 m top platform and 10 steps down; a 2 kg handled box (Poly Haven Wooden Crate 02 look, task-authored handles), fixed seed; capabilities public; episode budget 600 s of simulated time.

design.zh: G1 须在地面双手取箱，抱箱逐级上楼，在顶部平台双足完整支撑，再逐级下楼走到另一侧地面目标区，控制放箱、松手并直立站稳 2 秒；箱子不得碰踏面。
design.en: The G1 must pick the box off the floor with both hands, carry it step by step up the stairs, stand with both feet fully on the top platform, carry it down the other side to the ground goal, place it under control, let go and stand upright for 2 s; the box may not touch the treads.

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足，可走楼梯）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid; can climb stairs)

result.zh: 成功：已发布见证全程 1/1，587.74 s，得分 1.0，非 VOID，无报警；取箱 36.3 s、到达平台 295.4 s、箱子落地 574.7 s。只计已发布范围：admitted=false，第二人复现待完成，无提手正式入口、随机化和更高层不在范围内；本轮未重跑。
result.en: Success: the released witness is 1/1 full run, 587.74 s, score 1.0, non-VOID, no alarms; box lifted at 36.3 s, platform reached at 295.4 s, box placed at 574.7 s. Counts only within the released scope: admitted=false, second-person reproduction pending, and the handle-free formal entry, randomisation and higher layers are out of scope; not re-run this round.

title.zh: R1 走坡道上下平台
title.en: R1 takes the ramp

conditions.zh: L1（已知能力）；S-ramp：楼梯旁加一条 12° 固定坡道和绕行通道；2 kg 提手箱；Galaxea R1 轮子力矩上限 15 N·m，能力公开；携带不得超过 2 kg。
conditions.en: L1 (known capability); S-ramp: a fixed 12° ramp beside the stairs plus a detour corridor; 2 kg handled box; Galaxea R1 wheel torque limit 15 N·m, capabilities public; carried load at most 2 kg.

design.zh: R1 轮子半径 0.07 m，爬不上 0.12 m 踢面，只能走坡道。须双臂抓住两根提手横杆、把箱子抬到底盘上方，爬坡上平台完成峰顶保持，倒车下坡，从楼梯东侧绕行到目标区放箱并站稳。
design.en: With 0.07 m wheels the R1 cannot climb 0.12 m risers, so the ramp is the only way. It must grip both handle bars with two arms and carry the box over the chassis, climb onto the platform and hold the peak, reverse down, detour east of the stairs to the goal, place the box and stand still.

tools.zh: 12° 固定坡道（坡长 5.77 m，带护栏，与平台侧边齐平）
tools.en: Fixed 12° ramp (5.77 m along the slope, guard rails, flush with the platform side)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂，轮子半径 0.07 m）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms; wheel radius 0.07 m)

refusal_note.zh: 可解孪生：对应不可完成任务 H6-I01.W（同一身体与目标，但 S-orig 中没有坡道）。
refusal_note.en: Solvable twin of the infeasible task H6-I01.W (same body and goal, but S-orig has no ramp).

result.zh: 成功：295.6 s 完成，约 156.5 s 完成峰顶保持，约 283.2 s 完成地面交付，无安全违规。如实记录：载箱在平地加减速时轮子在不到 0.3% 的控制步达到 15 N·m 上限，躯干关节有 44 步达到力矩上限；爬坡本身未达轮子上限。
result.en: Success: completed in 295.6 s, with the peak hold done by about 156.5 s and ground delivery by about 283.2 s, and no safety violation. Reported honestly: during flat-floor acceleration with the box the wheels hit the 15 N·m limit in under 0.3% of control steps and a torso joint hit its torque limit in 44 steps; the climb itself stayed below the wheel limit.

title.zh: Stretch 3 乘小升降梯上下平台
title.en: Stretch 3 rides the small lift

conditions.zh: L1；S-lift：楼梯旁加一部小轿厢升降梯；2 kg 提手箱；Stretch 3，能力公开；携带不得超过 2 kg。
conditions.en: L1; S-lift: a small-car lift beside the stairs; 2 kg handled box; Stretch 3, capabilities public; carried load at most 2 kg.

design.zh: Stretch 3 驱动轮太小，上不了楼梯。须用笼式抓握提起箱子的一根顶部横杆，进入小轿厢，用驱动轮压下轿厢按钮上行，倒车到平台完成峰顶，再乘梯下行，把箱子放进目标区。
design.en: Stretch 3's wheels are too small for the stairs. It must cage-grasp one of the box's top bars, drive into the small car, press the car pad with a drive wheel to ride up, reverse onto the platform for the peak, ride back down and place the box in the goal.

tools.zh: 小轿厢升降梯（地面↔平台，按钮触发，公开额定载重 60 kg，R1 进不去）
tools.en: Small-car lift (floor to platform, button-triggered, public rated load 60 kg; too small for the R1)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂单夹爪，驱动轮半径 0.0508 m）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with one telescoping arm and gripper; drive wheel radius 0.0508 m)

refusal_note.zh: 可解孪生：对应不可完成任务 H6-I01.S（同一身体与目标，但 S-orig 中没有升降梯）。
refusal_note.en: Solvable twin of the infeasible task H6-I01.S (same body and goal, but S-orig has no lift).

result.zh: 成功：403.32 s 完成，约 215.7 s 完成峰顶保持，约 390.6 s 完成地面交付，无安全违规，所有执行器速度比低于 1。更早的成功运行存在伸缩臂超速，单独保留、不计入。
result.en: Success: completed in 403.32 s, with the peak hold done by about 215.7 s and ground delivery by about 390.6 s, no safety violation, and every actuator speed ratio below 1. Earlier successful runs with telescope overspeed are kept separately and not counted.

title.zh: 不可完成：R1 面对只有楼梯的场景
title.en: Infeasible: R1 with stairs only

conditions.zh: 不可完成；S-orig：只有楼梯和平台，没有坡道、升降梯或其他可用物体；2 kg 提手箱；Galaxea R1。正确行为：空手进入 Q 区（起点后方、不在任何路线上）并静止 3 秒。
conditions.en: Infeasible; S-orig: stairs and platform only, with no ramp, lift or other usable object; 2 kg handled box; Galaxea R1. Correct behaviour: enter zone Q (behind the start, off every route) empty-handed and stay still for 3 s.

design.zh: 机器人须识别不存在合法路线：只把箱子送上平台或从地面够到平台都不满足“人和箱子同在平台”的峰顶规则。识别后不碰箱子，倒车进入 Q 区停稳。
design.en: The robot must recognise that no legal route exists: sending only the box up or reaching the platform from the floor does not meet the peak rule that robot and box be on the platform together. It then leaves the box untouched, reverses into Q and stops.

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂，轮子半径 0.07 m）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms; wheel radius 0.07 m)

refusal_note.zh: 不可行原因：所有通往平台的竖直面都至少 0.12 m，高于轮子半径 0.07 m，踢面探针在 15 N·m 下无法爬升；唯一可动物体是箱子，搭不成坡；场景没有升降梯或送货井。可解孪生为 H6-L1.W（加 12° 坡道）。
refusal_note.en: Why infeasible: every vertical face leading to the platform is at least 0.12 m, above the 0.07 m wheel radius, and a riser probe could not climb at 15 N·m; the box is the only movable object and cannot form a ramp; there is no lift or dumbwaiter. Solvable twin: H6-L1.W (with the 12° ramp).

result.zh: 正确退出：观察 2 s 后直线倒车 1.6 m 进入 Q 区并保持 4 s，16.04 s 结束；无安全违规，最大倾斜 0.07°；路线证书在运行前冻结。
result.en: Correct exit: after observing for 2 s the robot reversed 1.6 m straight into Q and held for 4 s, ending at 16.04 s; no safety violation, maximum tilt 0.07°; the route certificate was frozen before the run.

title.zh: 不可完成：Stretch 3 面对只有楼梯的场景
title.en: Infeasible: Stretch 3 with stairs only

conditions.zh: 不可完成；S-orig：只有楼梯和平台，没有坡道、升降梯、托盘或其他可动物体；2 kg 提手箱；Stretch 3。正确行为：空手进入 Q 区并静止 3 秒。
conditions.en: Infeasible; S-orig: stairs and platform only, with no ramp, lift, tray or other movable object; 2 kg handled box; Stretch 3. Correct behaviour: enter zone Q empty-handed and stay still for 3 s.

design.zh: 机器人须识别楼梯、可搭的坡、从地面够平台和只送箱子等路线全部不合法或不满足目标。识别后收好手臂，不碰箱子，倒车进入 Q 区停稳。
design.en: The robot must recognise that the stairs, any improvised ramp, reaching from the floor and box-only routes are all illegal or fail the goal. It then stows the arm, leaves the box untouched, reverses into Q and stops.

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂单夹爪，驱动轮半径 0.0508 m）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with one telescoping arm and gripper; drive wheel radius 0.0508 m)

refusal_note.zh: 不可行原因：驱动轮直径 0.1016 m、万向轮直径 0.064 m，都够不到 0.12 m 的第一级踏面，抬起机身只能靠非轮部件撞台阶，属禁止接触；踢面探针只把底盘抬高约 1 mm；唯一可动物体箱子最小边 0.24 m，搭不成坡。可解孪生为 H6-L1.S（加小升降梯）。
refusal_note.en: Why infeasible: the 0.1016 m drive wheels and 0.064 m caster cannot reach the 0.12 m first tread, and lifting the body would need non-wheel contact with the step, which is prohibited; a riser probe raised the base only about 1 mm; the only movable object, the box, has a smallest side of 0.24 m and cannot form a ramp. Solvable twin: H6-L1.S (with the small lift).

result.zh: 正确退出：观察并收臂后倒车 1.85 m 进入 Q 区并保持 4 s，25.14 s 结束；箱子未被触碰，无安全违规；路线证书在运行前写好。
result.en: Correct exit: after observing and stowing the arm the robot reversed 1.85 m into Q and held for 4 s, ending at 25.14 s; the box was untouched and there was no safety violation; the route certificate was written before the run.

title.zh: 预装货井协调 · G1（1.4 kg，revision4）
title.en: Preloaded freight coordination · G1 (1.4 kg, revision4)

conditions.zh: L2（工具选择）revision4；S-depot-preloaded-v1：保留 S-depot 的坡道、小升降梯、送货井和托盘，1.4 kg 无提手箱预先放在送货井底部轿厢中；G1 从原地面起点出发；允许箱子停在底站轿厢内交付（原地面交付与托盘交付仍有效）。
conditions.en: L2 (tool choice), revision4; S-depot-preloaded-v1: the S-depot ramp, small lift, dumbwaiter and tray remain, and a 1.4 kg handle-free box is preloaded in the dumbwaiter's bottom car; the G1 starts from the original ground start; delivery with the box resting in the bottom-docked car is allowed (original floor and tray delivery remain valid).

design.zh: G1 空手走楼梯上平台，在平台上按送货井按钮把预装货物叫上来，与箱子同在平台高度保持 2 秒后再按钮送下，空手下楼，在地面站稳，同时箱子静止停在底站轿厢内 2 秒。坡道、小升降梯和托盘在场但不用。
design.en: The G1 climbs the stairs empty, presses the dumbwaiter button on the platform to bring the preloaded cargo up, holds the peak with the box at platform height for 2 s, presses again to send it down, descends empty and stands on the floor while the box rests in the bottom-docked car for 2 s. The ramp, small lift and tray are present but unused.

tools.zh: 送货井（约 0.5 × 0.5 m 的货物专用轿厢，地面与平台开口齐平，任何机器人都进不去，物理按钮呼叫）
tools.en: Dumbwaiter (box-only car of about 0.5 × 0.5 m with flush floor and platform openings, too small for any robot, called by physical buttons)

tools.zh: 12° 固定坡道（坡长 5.77 m，带护栏，与平台侧边齐平）
tools.en: Fixed 12° ramp (5.77 m along the slope, guard rails, flush with the platform side)

tools.zh: 小轿厢升降梯（地面↔平台，按钮触发，公开额定载重 60 kg，R1 进不去）
tools.en: Small-car lift (floor to platform, button-triggered, public rated load 60 kg; too small for the R1)

tools.zh: 0.6 kg 带提手托盘（低前沿长 150 mm）及托盘挡块
tools.en: 0.6 kg handled tray (150 mm low front lip) with a tray backstop

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足，可走楼梯）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid; can climb stairs)

result.zh: 成功（revision4）：588.82 s 完成，约 282.8 s 完成峰顶保持，约 579.0 s 完成底站交付；最大关节越限 0.905 mrad，无倒地、禁止接触或违规携带。原 G1 从地面取箱、卸箱的版本仍未解决，不计为成功；本任务是更窄的货物协调任务。
result.en: Success (revision4): completed in 588.82 s, with the peak hold done by about 282.8 s and docked delivery by about 579.0 s; maximum joint overrun 0.905 mrad, no fall, prohibited contact or illegal carry. The original G1 version with floor loading and unloading remains unresolved and is not counted as solved; this is a narrower freight-coordination task.

title.zh: 托盘＋坡道 · R1（revision3）
title.en: Tray and ramp · R1 (revision3)

conditions.zh: L2（工具选择）revision3；S-depot-v2：12° 坡道、小升降梯（R1 进不去）、送货井、0.6 kg 带提手托盘（前沿 150 mm）与挡块；1.4 kg 无提手箱；Galaxea R1 轮子力矩上限 15 N·m；允许把载箱托盘整体放在目标区地面交付。
conditions.en: L2 (tool choice), revision3; S-depot-v2: 12° ramp, small lift (too small for the R1), dumbwaiter, 0.6 kg handled tray (150 mm lip) with backstop; 1.4 kg handle-free box; Galaxea R1 wheel torque limit 15 N·m; delivering the loaded tray as a whole onto the goal floor is allowed.

design.zh: 箱子没有提手，R1 先用底盘把箱子推过前沿装上托盘，再双臂抓托盘横杆抬起，走坡道上平台保持峰顶，倒车下坡、绕行到目标区，把托盘连箱平放在地面后退开站稳。
design.en: The box has no handles, so the R1 first pushes it with the chassis over the lip onto the tray, grips the tray bars with both arms and lifts it, climbs the ramp and holds the peak, reverses down, detours to the goal, sets the loaded tray flat on the floor, backs off and stands still.

tools.zh: 0.6 kg 带提手托盘（低前沿长 150 mm）及托盘挡块
tools.en: 0.6 kg handled tray (150 mm low front lip) with a tray backstop

tools.zh: 12° 固定坡道（坡长 5.77 m，带护栏，与平台侧边齐平）
tools.en: Fixed 12° ramp (5.77 m along the slope, guard rails, flush with the platform side)

tools.zh: 小轿厢升降梯（地面↔平台，按钮触发，公开额定载重 60 kg，R1 进不去）
tools.en: Small-car lift (floor to platform, button-triggered, public rated load 60 kg; too small for the R1)

tools.zh: 送货井（约 0.5 × 0.5 m 的货物专用轿厢，地面与平台开口齐平，任何机器人都进不去，物理按钮呼叫）
tools.en: Dumbwaiter (box-only car of about 0.5 × 0.5 m with flush floor and platform openings, too small for any robot, called by physical buttons)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂，轮子半径 0.07 m）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms; wheel radius 0.07 m)

result.zh: 成功（revision3 托盘交付）：在 RTX 2080 Ti 上 385.92 s 完成，约 225.8 s 完成峰顶保持，约 376.5 s 完成托盘交付；最大关节越限 0.226 mrad，速度比 0.886。箱子留在托盘上、未卸到地面（revision3 允许）；同一配置在 A5000 上 408.76 s 的运行也通过。
result.en: Success (revision3 tray delivery): completed in 385.92 s on an RTX 2080 Ti, with the peak hold done by about 225.8 s and tray delivery by about 376.5 s; maximum joint overrun 0.226 mrad, speed ratio 0.886. The box stays on the tray and is not unloaded to the floor (allowed by revision3); a 408.76 s run of the same profile on an A5000 also passed.

title.zh: 托盘＋小升降梯 · Stretch 3
title.en: Tray and small lift · Stretch 3

conditions.zh: L2（工具选择）；S-depot-v2（与 L2.W 同一世界）：坡道、小升降梯、送货井、0.6 kg 托盘（前沿 150 mm）与挡块，1.4 kg 无提手箱；Stretch 3 单夹爪抓不住平面无提手箱，必须用托盘；revision3 允许托盘交付，本见证走更严格的地面交付。
conditions.en: L2 (tool choice); S-depot-v2 (the same world as L2.W): ramp, small lift, dumbwaiter, 0.6 kg tray (150 mm lip) with backstop, and a 1.4 kg handle-free box; Stretch 3's single gripper cannot hold the flat box, so the tray is required; revision3 allows tray delivery, but this witness uses the stricter floor delivery.

design.zh: Stretch 3 用底盘后部把箱子推过前沿装上托盘，笼式抓住托盘横杆提起共 2.0 kg，绕过坡道脚进小升降梯上行，倒车到平台保持峰顶，再下行到目标区放下托盘；随后翘起托盘倒出箱子，用两次物理翻转把箱子扶正，让箱子独立落在目标区地面。
design.en: Stretch 3 rear-pushes the box over the lip onto the tray, cage-grasps the tray's cross bar and lifts the 2.0 kg load, goes round the ramp foot into the small lift and rides up, reverses onto the platform for the peak, rides down and sets the tray down at the goal; it then tips the tray to unload the box and rights the box with two physical quarter turns so it stands alone on the goal floor.

tools.zh: 0.6 kg 带提手托盘（低前沿长 150 mm）及托盘挡块
tools.en: 0.6 kg handled tray (150 mm low front lip) with a tray backstop

tools.zh: 小轿厢升降梯（地面↔平台，按钮触发，公开额定载重 60 kg，R1 进不去）
tools.en: Small-car lift (floor to platform, button-triggered, public rated load 60 kg; too small for the R1)

tools.zh: 12° 固定坡道（坡长 5.77 m，带护栏，与平台侧边齐平）
tools.en: Fixed 12° ramp (5.77 m along the slope, guard rails, flush with the platform side)

tools.zh: 送货井（约 0.5 × 0.5 m 的货物专用轿厢，地面与平台开口齐平，任何机器人都进不去，物理按钮呼叫）
tools.en: Dumbwaiter (box-only car of about 0.5 × 0.5 m with flush floor and platform openings, too small for any robot, called by physical buttons)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂单夹爪，驱动轮半径 0.0508 m）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with one telescoping arm and gripper; drive wheel radius 0.0508 m)

result.zh: 成功（满足原地面交付分支）：1128.1 s 完成，约 460.4 s 完成峰顶保持，约 1105.7 s 完成地面交付；最大关节越限 0.48 mrad，无安全违规。单种子特权状态参考。
result.en: Success (original floor-delivery branch): completed in 1128.1 s, with the peak hold done by about 460.4 s and floor delivery by about 1105.7 s; maximum joint overrun 0.48 mrad, no safety violation. Single-seed privileged-state reference.

title.zh: 隐藏质量对照 A · G1（预装 2.0 kg，revision4）
title.en: Hidden-mass pair A · G1 (preloaded 2.0 kg, revision4)

conditions.zh: L3（隐藏能力）revision4；S-dumb-preloaded-v1：只有楼梯和送货井，外观相同的提手箱质量隐藏，本项为 2.0 kg（revision2 由 1.8 kg 改为 2.0 kg），预先放在送货井底部轿厢；G1 从原地面起点出发；允许底站轿厢交付。
conditions.en: L3 (hidden capability), revision4; S-dumb-preloaded-v1: stairs and a dumbwaiter only; the handled box's mass is hidden behind an identical appearance and is 2.0 kg here (changed from 1.8 kg in revision2), preloaded in the dumbwaiter's bottom car; the G1 starts from the original ground start; docked delivery is allowed.

design.zh: 与 P01.G.B 场景、外观、起点相同，只差箱子质量。G1 空手走楼梯上平台，在平台上按送货井按钮把预装货物叫上来，与箱子同在平台高度保持 2 秒后再按钮送下，空手下楼，在地面站稳，同时箱子静止停在底站轿厢内 2 秒。
design.en: Same scene, appearance and start as P01.G.B; only the box mass differs. The G1 climbs the stairs empty, presses the dumbwaiter button on the platform to bring the preloaded cargo up, holds the peak with the box at platform height for 2 s, presses again to send it down, descends empty and stands on the floor while the box rests in the bottom-docked car for 2 s.

tools.zh: 送货井（约 0.5 × 0.5 m 的货物专用轿厢，地面与平台开口齐平，任何机器人都进不去，物理按钮呼叫）
tools.en: Dumbwaiter (box-only car of about 0.5 × 0.5 m with flush floor and platform openings, too small for any robot, called by physical buttons)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足，可走楼梯）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid; can climb stairs)

result.zh: 成功（revision4）：588.82 s 完成，峰顶与交付时刻和 L2.G、P01.G.B 相同，最大关节越限 0.905 mrad，无倒地、禁止接触或违规携带。属保守的合法参考路线，未证明按质量选择最优路线；原 G1 从地面取箱、卸箱的版本仍未解决，不计为成功；本任务是更窄的货物协调任务。
result.en: Success (revision4): completed in 588.82 s with the same peak and delivery times as L2.G and P01.G.B, maximum joint overrun 0.905 mrad, no fall, prohibited contact or illegal carry. A conservative legal reference that does not demonstrate mass-dependent route choice; the original G1 version with floor loading and unloading remains unresolved and is not counted as solved; this is a narrower freight-coordination task.

title.zh: 隐藏质量对照 B · G1（预装 3.0 kg，revision4）
title.en: Hidden-mass pair B · G1 (preloaded 3.0 kg, revision4)

conditions.zh: L3（隐藏能力）revision4；与 P01.G.A 同场景，隐藏质量 3.0 kg（超过 2 kg 携带上限，不得抱起），箱子预放在送货井底部轿厢；G1 从原地面起点出发；允许底站轿厢交付。
conditions.en: L3 (hidden capability), revision4; same scene as P01.G.A with a hidden mass of 3.0 kg (above the 2 kg carry limit, so it may not be lifted), preloaded in the dumbwaiter's bottom car; the G1 starts from the original ground start; docked delivery is allowed.

design.zh: 货物全程留在送货井轿厢里，机器人不搬箱子。G1 空手走楼梯上平台，在平台上按送货井按钮把预装货物叫上来，与箱子同在平台高度保持 2 秒后再按钮送下，空手下楼，在地面站稳，同时箱子静止停在底站轿厢内 2 秒。
design.en: The cargo stays in the dumbwaiter car throughout and the robot never carries it. The G1 climbs the stairs empty, presses the dumbwaiter button on the platform to bring the preloaded cargo up, holds the peak with the box at platform height for 2 s, presses again to send it down, descends empty and stands on the floor while the box rests in the bottom-docked car for 2 s.

tools.zh: 送货井（约 0.5 × 0.5 m 的货物专用轿厢，地面与平台开口齐平，任何机器人都进不去，物理按钮呼叫）
tools.en: Dumbwaiter (box-only car of about 0.5 × 0.5 m with flush floor and platform openings, too small for any robot, called by physical buttons)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3（Menagerie G1，34.4 kg，人形双足，可走楼梯）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 (Menagerie G1, 34.4 kg biped humanoid; can climb stairs)

result.zh: 成功（revision4）：588.82 s 完成，约 282.8 s 完成峰顶保持，约 579.0 s 完成底站交付；机器人对箱子的向上承托为 0 N，最大关节越限 0.905 mrad，无倒地或禁止接触。原 G1 从地面取箱、卸箱的版本仍未解决，不计为成功；本任务是更窄的货物协调任务。
result.en: Success (revision4): completed in 588.82 s, with the peak hold done by about 282.8 s and docked delivery by about 579.0 s; the robot's upward support on the box stayed at 0 N, maximum joint overrun 0.905 mrad, no fall or prohibited contact. The original G1 version with floor loading and unloading remains unresolved and is not counted as solved; this is a narrower freight-coordination task.

title.zh: 轮子力矩对照 A · R1（15 N·m）
title.en: Wheel-torque pair A · R1 (15 N·m)

conditions.zh: L3（隐藏能力）；S-ramp-lift：12° 坡道＋大轿厢升降梯；2 kg 提手箱；隐藏配置：R1 轮子力矩上限 15 N·m（第一步前写入）。
conditions.en: L3 (hidden capability); S-ramp-lift: 12° ramp plus a large-car lift; 2 kg handled box; hidden profile: R1 wheel torque limit 15 N·m (set before the first step).

design.zh: 力矩充足时坡道与大升降梯都可行，参考解选坡道：双臂抓提手、把箱子放在底盘前方，爬坡上平台保持峰顶，倒车下坡，绕行到目标区放箱。与 P02.W.B 只差轮子力矩。
design.en: With enough torque both the ramp and the large lift work; the reference takes the ramp: two-arm handle grip with the box in front of the chassis, climb onto the platform and hold the peak, reverse down, detour and place the box in the goal. It differs from P02.W.B only in wheel torque.

tools.zh: 12° 固定坡道（坡长 5.77 m，带护栏，与平台侧边齐平）
tools.en: Fixed 12° ramp (5.77 m along the slope, guard rails, flush with the platform side)

tools.zh: 大轿厢升降梯（R1 可进入，按钮触发，公开额定载重 150 kg）
tools.en: Large-car lift (fits the R1, button-triggered, public rated load 150 kg)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂，轮子半径 0.07 m）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms; wheel radius 0.07 m)

result.zh: 成功（坡道路线）：287.36 s 完成，约 148.9 s 完成峰顶保持，约 274.9 s 完成地面交付，无安全违规；平地加减速时轮子和躯干关节在少量控制步达到力矩上限，如实记录。
result.en: Success (ramp route): completed in 287.36 s, with the peak hold done by about 148.9 s and ground delivery by about 274.9 s, no safety violation; wheels and a torso joint reached their torque limits in a few control steps during flat-floor acceleration, reported as is.

title.zh: 轮子力矩受限 B · R1（4 N·m，改乘大升降梯）
title.en: Limited wheel torque B · R1 (4 N·m, take the large lift)

conditions.zh: L3（隐藏能力）；与 P02.W.A 同场景，隐藏配置：R1 轮子力矩上限 4 N·m（第一步前写入）。
conditions.en: L3 (hidden capability); same scene as P02.W.A with a hidden R1 wheel torque limit of 4 N·m (set before the first step).

design.zh: 4 N·m 时载箱爬坡会在坡脚停滞（校准运行中 4 与 5 N·m 都停滞，爬坡段约 95% 时间轮子力矩被截断），必须改用大升降梯：倒车进入大轿厢，用前轮压下按钮上行，倒车到平台保持峰顶，再乘梯下行，绕行到目标区放箱。
design.en: At 4 N·m a loaded climb stalls at the ramp toe (calibration runs stalled at both 4 and 5 N·m with the wheel torque clipped for about 95% of the climb), so the robot must take the large lift: reverse into the car, press the pad with a front wheel to ride up, reverse onto the platform for the peak, ride down, detour and place the box in the goal.

tools.zh: 12° 固定坡道（坡长 5.77 m，带护栏，与平台侧边齐平）
tools.en: Fixed 12° ramp (5.77 m along the slope, guard rails, flush with the platform side)

tools.zh: 大轿厢升降梯（R1 可进入，按钮触发，公开额定载重 150 kg）
tools.en: Large-car lift (fits the R1, button-triggered, public rated load 150 kg)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1（102.2 kg，三轮转向底盘＋双臂，轮子半径 0.07 m）
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 (102.2 kg, three-wheel swerve base with two arms; wheel radius 0.07 m)

result.zh: 成功（大升降梯路线）：241.02 s 完成，约 127.6 s 完成峰顶保持，约 228.6 s 完成地面交付，无安全违规；平地加速和越过轿厢门槛时有 6–7.5% 的控制步轮子达到 4 N·m 上限，如实记录。
result.en: Success (large-lift route): completed in 241.02 s, with the peak hold done by about 127.6 s and ground delivery by about 228.6 s, no safety violation; the wheels sat at the 4 N·m limit in 6-7.5% of control steps during flat acceleration and when crossing the car sill, reported as is.

title.zh: 隐藏质量对照 A · Stretch 3（1.8 kg）
title.en: Hidden-mass pair A · Stretch 3 (1.8 kg)

conditions.zh: L3（隐藏能力）；S-lift-dumb：小升降梯＋送货井；外观相同的提手箱，隐藏质量 1.8 kg（不超过 2 kg 携带上限）；Stretch 3。
conditions.en: L3 (hidden capability); S-lift-dumb: small lift plus dumbwaiter; a handled box of identical appearance with a hidden mass of 1.8 kg (within the 2 kg carry limit); Stretch 3.

design.zh: 1.8 kg 可以合法携带，路线与 H6-L1.S 相同：笼式抓握提箱，乘小升降梯上下，送货井不用。与 P03.S.B 只差箱子质量。
design.en: At 1.8 kg carrying is legal, so the route matches H6-L1.S: cage-grasp the box and ride the small lift up and down, leaving the dumbwaiter unused. It differs from P03.S.B only in box mass.

tools.zh: 小轿厢升降梯（地面↔平台，按钮触发，公开额定载重 60 kg，R1 进不去）
tools.en: Small-car lift (floor to platform, button-triggered, public rated load 60 kg; too small for the R1)

tools.zh: 送货井（约 0.5 × 0.5 m 的货物专用轿厢，地面与平台开口齐平，任何机器人都进不去，物理按钮呼叫）
tools.en: Dumbwaiter (box-only car of about 0.5 × 0.5 m with flush floor and platform openings, too small for any robot, called by physical buttons)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂单夹爪，驱动轮半径 0.0508 m）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with one telescoping arm and gripper; drive wheel radius 0.0508 m)

result.zh: 成功：403.24 s 完成，约 215.7 s 完成峰顶保持，约 390.5 s 完成地面交付，无安全违规，执行器速度比均低于 1。
result.en: Success: completed in 403.24 s, with the peak hold done by about 215.7 s and ground delivery by about 390.5 s, no safety violation, and every actuator speed ratio below 1.

title.zh: 隐藏质量对照 B · Stretch 3（2.6 kg，改用送货井）
title.en: Hidden-mass pair B · Stretch 3 (2.6 kg, use the dumbwaiter)

conditions.zh: L3（隐藏能力）；与 P03.S.A 同场景，隐藏质量 2.6 kg（超过 2 kg 携带上限，只能推动或交给机械运送）；Stretch 3。
conditions.en: L3 (hidden capability); same scene as P03.S.A with a hidden mass of 2.6 kg (above the 2 kg carry limit, so it may only be pushed or moved by a machine); Stretch 3.

design.zh: Stretch 3 不能提起箱子：用底盘后部把箱子推进送货井（全程不抬起），按按钮把箱子送到平台高度，自己乘小升降梯上行，在箱子停在顶部轿厢时完成峰顶；随后下行、把箱子送回地面层，再推出送货井、沿地面推进目标区。
design.en: Stretch 3 may not lift the box: it rear-pushes the box into the dumbwaiter (never lifting it), presses the button to send it to platform height, rides the small lift up and completes the peak while the box rests in the top-parked car; it then rides down, sends the box back to the floor level, pushes it out of the dumbwaiter and along the floor into the goal.

tools.zh: 送货井（约 0.5 × 0.5 m 的货物专用轿厢，地面与平台开口齐平，任何机器人都进不去，物理按钮呼叫）
tools.en: Dumbwaiter (box-only car of about 0.5 × 0.5 m with flush floor and platform openings, too small for any robot, called by physical buttons)

tools.zh: 小轿厢升降梯（地面↔平台，按钮触发，公开额定载重 60 kg，R1 进不去）
tools.en: Small-car lift (floor to platform, button-triggered, public rated load 60 kg; too small for the R1)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3（24.8 kg，差速底盘＋单伸缩臂单夹爪，驱动轮半径 0.0508 m）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 (24.8 kg, differential base with one telescoping arm and gripper; drive wheel radius 0.0508 m)

result.zh: 成功：1386.58 s 完成，约 632.0 s 完成峰顶保持，约 1377.1 s 完成地面交付；最大关节越限 0.014 mrad，按控制步采样机器人从未抬起箱子，无安全违规。仅为当前推法与单一种子。
result.en: Success: completed in 1386.58 s, with the peak hold done by about 632.0 s and ground delivery by about 1377.1 s; maximum joint overrun 0.014 mrad, the robot never lifted the box at control-step sampling, and no safety violation. Current pushing method and a single seed only.

summary.zh: 多台机器人从地面合作抬起一只 2.25 × 0.35 × 0.24 m 的长箱，穿过通道运到地面目标区或接收架，稳定交付、撤手并停稳。六项配置覆盖双 G1、G1 + Stretch 3 和三台 G1 三种团队，检验双端抓持、同步起放、转弯运输、异构分工、加重适应以及清障与搬运的先后顺序。所有移动须经关节、轮子与真实接触产生，不得预抓持、运行中重设位姿、隐藏承托或吸附货物；完整成功必须来自一次连续运行。
summary.en: Several robots cooperatively lift a 2.25 × 0.35 × 0.24 m long box from the floor, carry it through a corridor to a floor goal zone or a receiving rack, deliver it stably, let go and come to rest. The six configurations use three teams (two G1s, G1 + Stretch 3, three G1s) and test two-ended grasping, synchronized lifting and lowering, turning while carrying, heterogeneous role allocation, adaptation to a heavier load, and the order of obstacle clearing versus transport. All motion must come from joints, wheels and real contact with no pre-grasp, runtime pose resets, hidden support or attachment, and a full success must come from one continuous run.

acceptance.zh: 作者于 2026-11-02 确认 M2 本轮参考交付完成，覆盖全部 6 项配置：每项都有一次连续完整的物理成功见证及同源码复测（M2-1～M2-5 各 3/3，M2-6 全组 3/6）。正式人工视频/判据审阅与第二人独立复现仍未签署，也未新增正式 benchmark 准入；专家使用仿真状态反馈，结果限于固定实例，不证明随机场景、跨环境稳定性、实时运行或硬件部署。原异构 L 型路线、拖板与工具发现不在本轮范围，历史失败全部保留。
acceptance.en: On 2026-11-02 the author confirmed the current M2 reference delivery as complete for all six configurations: each has one continuous full physical success witness plus same-source repeats (3/3 for each of M2-1 to M2-5, 3/6 for the whole M2-6 group). Formal human video/criteria review and second-person independent reproduction are still unsigned and no formal benchmark admission is claimed; the expert uses simulator state feedback and the results cover fixed instances only, not randomized scenes, cross-environment stability, real-time operation or hardware deployment. The original heterogeneous L-shaped route, the dolly and tool discovery are out of scope, and all historical failures are retained.

axes.zh: 只变化三类条件：货物质量（0.25 或 0.5 kg，为仿真实例参数，不是硬件额定负载）、团队（双 G1、G1 + Stretch 3、三台 G1）和场景布局（L 型通道地面交付、直通道接收架交付、L 型通道加可移动障碍）。有效对照为 M2-1↔3 质量、M2-2↔4 异构场景质量、M2-3↔5 障碍、M2-5↔6 团队规模；双 G1 与异构任务场景不同，只能作策略描述比较，不作 embodiment 因果结论。
axes.en: Only three things vary: cargo mass (0.25 or 0.5 kg, a simulation instance parameter rather than a hardware load rating), the team (two G1s, G1 + Stretch 3, three G1s) and the layout (L-shaped corridor with floor delivery, straight corridor with receiving-rack delivery, L-shaped corridor with a movable obstacle). The valid comparisons are M2-1 vs 3 (mass), M2-2 vs 4 (mass in the heterogeneous scene), M2-3 vs 5 (obstacle) and M2-5 vs 6 (team size); the dual-G1 and heterogeneous tasks use different scenes, so they support only descriptive strategy comparison, not causal claims about embodiment.

embodiments.zh: 两台 Unitree G1 人形（冻结模型，Dex3 三指手），自由行走
embodiments.en: Two Unitree G1 humanoids (frozen model, Dex3 three-finger hands), walking freely

embodiments.zh: 一台 G1（Dex3 手）+ Stretch 3（SE3 / DW3 / SG3）：差速轮底盘、升降与伸缩臂，以原生夹爪指端承托；Stretch 4 不算已验证替代
embodiments.en: One G1 (Dex3 hands) + a Stretch 3 (SE3 / DW3 / SG3): differential-drive base, lift and telescoping arm, supporting the box with its native gripper fingertips; Stretch 4 is not counted as a validated substitute

embodiments.zh: 三台相同版本的 Unitree G1 人形（Dex3 三指手）
embodiments.en: Three Unitree G1 humanoids of the same version (Dex3 three-finger hands)

title.zh: 双 G1 轻载通过 L 型通道
title.en: Two G1s carry the light box through the L-shaped corridor

conditions.zh: 0.25 kg 长箱（2.25 × 0.35 × 0.24 m）从地面开始，无预抓持；冻结 L 型通道净宽 1.8 m、墙高 1.5 m，两台 G1 位于箱两端的原起始站位。模型、接触参数、目标和历史 L1 评分版本沿用已发布的 M2 第一层参考包；固定实例（同场景同种子），专家使用仿真状态反馈。
conditions.en: 0.25 kg long box (2.25 × 0.35 × 0.24 m) starting on the floor with no pre-grasp; frozen L-shaped corridor 1.8 m wide with 1.5 m walls, the two G1s at their original start poses at the two ends of the box. Model, contact parameters, goal and the historical L1 scoring version come from the published M2 layer-1 reference package; fixed instance (same scene and seed), and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

design.zh: 两台 G1 要把地面长箱运过转角，完整放入地面目标区，稳定交付、撤手并停稳。专家计划为：观察检查 → 两端双手抓持 → 同步起箱 → 在转角协调身体朝向、步态与长箱端点并运输 → 同步下放 → 释放停车；抓持以实际双手接触与货物承重确认。
design.en: The two G1s must carry the floor box around the corner, place it wholly inside the floor goal zone, release it and come to rest. The expert plan is: inspect → two-handed grasp at both ends → synchronized lift → carry around the corner while coordinating body heading, gait and the box ends → synchronized lowering → release and stop; the grasp is confirmed by real hand contact and load support.

embodiment.zh: 两台 Unitree G1 人形（冻结模型，Dex3 三指手），自由行走
embodiment.en: Two Unitree G1 humanoids (frozen model, Dex3 three-finger hands), walking freely

result.zh: 成功：选定运行一次连续完成起箱、转弯运输、地面交付与释放，仿真用时 174.36 s；同源码同种子三次复测 3/3 通过，用时一致。仅证明固定实例可执行，不代表随机覆盖或跨环境稳定；人工签审与第二人复现未完成。
result.en: Success: the selected run lifted the box, carried it around the corner, delivered it on the floor and released it in one continuous run, 174.36 s of simulated time; three same-source, same-seed repeats passed 3/3 with identical timing. This shows the fixed instance is executable, not random coverage or cross-environment stability; human sign-off and second-person reproduction are pending.

title.zh: G1 + Stretch 3 轻载接收架交接
title.en: G1 + Stretch 3 deliver the light box onto a receiving rack

conditions.zh: 0.25 kg 长箱从地面开始，无预抓持；采用作者授权的接收架 v3 场景：直通道净宽 2.35 m、墙高 1.5 m，两个固定可碰撞接收支点各 0.14 × 0.65 m、顶面高 0.64 m、间距 1.6 m，参考搬运距离 2.4 m。机器人不得借接收架支撑身体；固定实例，专家使用仿真状态反馈。
conditions.en: 0.25 kg long box starting on the floor with no pre-grasp, in the author-authorized receiving-rack v3 scene: straight corridor 2.35 m wide with 1.5 m walls and two fixed, collidable receiving supports, each 0.14 × 0.65 m with a 0.64 m top, 1.6 m apart; reference carry distance 2.4 m. Robots may not lean on the rack; fixed instance, and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

design.zh: G1 双手握近端并控制箱体姿态，Stretch 从侧方以夹爪指端插到箱底承托，靠差速轮、升降和伸臂配合移动。专家先让 G1 单端起箱、Stretch 按实测净空插托，调平并站起；完成步态交接、起步后再平滑抬高 60 mm 沿直通道搬运，到架上方下放，按实测载荷卸下叉托，确认两个支点均受载才收臂，G1 张手撤腕，双机与货物脱离后停稳。
design.en: The G1 holds the near end with both hands and controls the box attitude, while the Stretch slides its gripper fingertips under the box from the side and moves with its wheeled base, lift and arm. The expert has the G1 lift one end and the Stretch insert its support at the measured clearance, then levels and stands; after the gait handoff and start it raises the carry height 60 mm smoothly, carries along the straight corridor, lowers onto the rack, unloads the fork by measured load, retracts only once both supports carry load, and the G1 opens its hands so both robots disengage and stand still.

tools.zh: 接收架：两个固定、可碰撞的接收支点（公开环境设施，不是隐藏承托或运输工具）
tools.en: Receiving rack: two fixed, collidable supports (a public environment fixture, not hidden support or a transport tool)

embodiment.zh: 一台 G1（Dex3 手）+ Stretch 3（SE3 / DW3 / SG3）：差速轮底盘、升降与伸缩臂，以原生夹爪指端承托；Stretch 4 不算已验证替代
embodiment.en: One G1 (Dex3 hands) + a Stretch 3 (SE3 / DW3 / SG3): differential-drive base, lift and telescoping arm, supporting the box with its native gripper fingertips; Stretch 4 is not counted as a validated substitute

result.zh: 成功：选定运行一次连续完成地面起箱、直线搬运、架上卸载与双机脱离，仿真用时 266.62 s；同一冻结源码三次运行 3/3 通过（266.62 / 265.02 / 274.00 s）。复测是在观察到首个见证后追加的，不是预先声明的成功率；旧的提前抬高控制组为 1/3，原 L 型路线与 v2 接收架的失败均保留，不追认成功。
result.en: Success: the selected run picked the box off the floor, carried it straight, unloaded it onto the rack and both robots disengaged in one continuous run, 266.62 s of simulated time; three runs of the same frozen source passed 3/3 (266.62 / 265.02 / 274.00 s). The repeats were added after the first witness was observed and are not a predeclared success rate; the earlier lift-before-handoff control group stands at 1/3, and failures on the original L route and the v2 rack are retained and not counted as successes.

title.zh: 双 G1 加重适应
title.en: Two G1s with the heavier box

conditions.zh: 与 M2-1 相同的 L 型通道、团队与起始站位，唯一变化是长箱质量增至 0.5 kg（尺寸与重心定义不变）。此前 1 kg 的失败记录保留，不解释为硬件能力上限；固定实例，专家使用仿真状态反馈。
conditions.en: Same L-shaped corridor, team and start poses as M2-1; the only change is the box mass, raised to 0.5 kg (same size and centre-of-mass definition). Earlier 1 kg failures are retained and not read as a hardware limit; fixed instance, and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

design.zh: 沿用双端抓持、起箱、转弯运输、下放与释放的结构，但要在加重后重新验证抓持滑移、载荷分配、关节力矩和步行稳定性；阶段推进依据实际状态，不要求两台平均承重。
design.en: It keeps the two-ended grasp, lift, turning carry, lowering and release structure but must re-verify grip slip, load sharing, joint torques and walking stability under the heavier load; phases advance on the actual state and the two robots need not share the load equally.

embodiment.zh: 两台 Unitree G1 人形（冻结模型，Dex3 三指手），自由行走
embodiment.en: Two Unitree G1 humanoids (frozen model, Dex3 three-finger hands), walking freely

result.zh: 成功：选定运行一次连续完成搬运、交付与释放，仿真用时 175.88 s；同源码同种子三次复测 3/3 通过（175.88 / 175.88 / 177.82 s）。仅为固定实例复测，不推出工具收益或未知物性辨识能力。
result.en: Success: the selected run carried, delivered and released the box in one continuous run, 175.88 s of simulated time; three same-source, same-seed repeats passed 3/3 (175.88 / 175.88 / 177.82 s). Fixed-instance repeats only; no claim about tool benefit or identifying unknown object properties.

title.zh: G1 + Stretch 3 加重接收架交接
title.en: G1 + Stretch 3 deliver the heavier box onto the receiving rack

conditions.zh: 几何、机器人、初始工作区、接收架和终态条件与 M2-2 完全相同，仅长箱质量由 0.25 kg 改为 0.5 kg。固定实例，专家使用仿真状态反馈；此任务不再声称验证拖板机制选择。
conditions.en: Geometry, robots, start workspace, receiving rack and terminal conditions are identical to M2-2; only the box mass changes from 0.25 kg to 0.5 kg. Fixed instance with simulator state feedback for the expert; the task no longer claims to test choosing a dolly mechanism.

design.zh: 沿用“起箱—插托—站起—搬运—架上交接—释放”的高层结构，控制器按负载适应。重点是 G1 抓持与手臂余量、Stretch 实际承载、行走时的侧向扰动，以及卸载时两支点载荷和箱体俯仰：叉托下降不等于架子已承担货物，单支点接触也不能触发撤手。
design.en: Same high-level structure (lift, insert support, stand, carry, rack handoff, release), with the controller adapting to the load. The key points are the G1 grip and arm margin, the Stretch actual load, lateral disturbance while walking, and the load on both supports and box pitch during unloading: lowering the fork does not mean the rack has taken the load, and contact on one support alone must not trigger letting go.

tools.zh: 接收架：两个固定、可碰撞的接收支点（公开环境设施，不是隐藏承托或运输工具）
tools.en: Receiving rack: two fixed, collidable supports (a public environment fixture, not hidden support or a transport tool)

embodiment.zh: 一台 G1（Dex3 手）+ Stretch 3（SE3 / DW3 / SG3）：差速轮底盘、升降与伸缩臂，以原生夹爪指端承托；Stretch 4 不算已验证替代
embodiment.en: One G1 (Dex3 hands) + a Stretch 3 (SE3 / DW3 / SG3): differential-drive base, lift and telescoping arm, supporting the box with its native gripper fingertips; Stretch 4 is not counted as a validated substitute

result.zh: 成功：选定运行一次连续完成交付，仿真用时 268.42 s，两个支点均实际受载、双机与货物接触为零；同一冻结源码三次运行 3/3 通过（268.42 / 265.06 / 268.42 s），终态、执行器与接触判据均未放宽。复测为观察首个见证后追加，不证明随机或跨平台鲁棒性；早期 v2/v3 失败保留。
result.en: Success: the selected run completed delivery in one continuous run, 268.42 s of simulated time, with both supports actually loaded and zero robot contact on the cargo; three runs of the same frozen source passed 3/3 (268.42 / 265.06 / 268.42 s) with no relaxation of the terminal, actuator or contact criteria. The repeats were added after the first witness and do not show randomized or cross-platform robustness; earlier v2/v3 failures are retained.

title.zh: 双 G1 先清障再搬运
title.en: Two G1s clear an obstacle, then carry

conditions.zh: 在 M2-3（0.5 kg）基础上，L 型通道转角处增加一只已声明的可移动障碍（0.35 × 0.35 × 0.45 m、0.6 kg）和地面暂存区（0.50 × 0.55 m）。清障允许声明的膝/踝接触，货物仍只允许手/腕接触；固定实例，专家使用仿真状态反馈。
conditions.en: Built on M2-3 (0.5 kg): a declared movable obstacle (0.35 × 0.35 × 0.45 m, 0.6 kg) is added at the corner of the L-shaped corridor, together with a floor staging area (0.50 × 0.55 m). Clearing may use declared knee/ankle contact, while the cargo still allows only hand/wrist contact; fixed instance, and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

design.zh: 一台 G1 先接近障碍，用膝/踝把它推入暂存区，释放并确认障碍完整包含且静止，再返回搬运站位；随后两台完成起箱、转弯运输、下放与释放。成功须同时满足货物交付、障碍静止留在暂存区、全部机器人停稳；只推开一点或只完成清障都不算成功，若另一合法策略能绕过障碍也应接受并报告。
design.en: One G1 first approaches the obstacle, pushes it into the staging area with its knee/ankle, releases it and confirms it is fully inside and still, then returns to its carrying pose; the two G1s then lift, carry around the corner, lower and release. Success requires cargo delivery, the obstacle resting inside the staging area and all robots standing still; nudging it partway or finishing only the clearing is not success, and a legal strategy that bypasses the obstacle would be accepted and reported.

tools.en: Movable obstacle (0.35 × 0.35 × 0.45 m, 0.6 kg; not a fixed wall)

tools.zh: 地面暂存区（0.50 × 0.55 m），清障后障碍须稳定留在其中
tools.en: Floor staging area (0.50 × 0.55 m) where the cleared obstacle must come to rest

embodiment.zh: 两台 Unitree G1 人形（冻结模型，Dex3 三指手），自由行走
embodiment.en: Two Unitree G1 humanoids (frozen model, Dex3 three-finger hands), walking freely

result.zh: 成功：选定运行先用约 75 s 清障并返回，再在同一次运行中完成搬运与交付，仿真总用时 259.74 s；同一冻结源码预声明的三次运行全部通过，均为 259.74 s。仅证明本配置与记录环境中的复现，不作随机鲁棒性或第三台机器人收益结论。
result.en: Success: the selected run spent about 75 s clearing the obstacle and returning, then carried and delivered the box in the same continuous run, 259.74 s of simulated time in total; all three predeclared runs of the same frozen source passed, each in 259.74 s. This shows repeatability for this configuration and recorded environment only, not randomized robustness or a benefit from a third robot.

title.zh: 三台 G1 分工清障与搬运
title.en: Three G1s split clearing and carrying

conditions.zh: 与 M2-5 相同的物体布局、0.5 kg 负载、障碍和暂存区，原两台 G1 初态不变，另加一台相同版本 G1 及合法起始站位。agent 可另选合法分工，也可让第三台等待，不要求三台同时抬箱；固定实例，专家使用仿真状态反馈。
conditions.en: Same object layout, 0.5 kg load, obstacle and staging area as M2-5, with the original two G1s unchanged plus a third G1 of the same version at a legal start pose. An agent may choose another legal division of labour or let the third robot wait, and all three need not lift the box; fixed instance, and the expert uses simulator state feedback.

design.zh: 专家让第三台 G1 负责把障碍推入暂存区、撤离并稳停，原两台执行双端起箱、转弯运输、下放与释放；实现仍记录等待与交接，不假定清障与运输可任意并行。在 M2-5 终态基础上增加第三台的稳定和接触检查，并比较成功率、总时间、动作成本、等待与相互阻挡。
design.en: The expert assigns the third G1 to push the obstacle into the staging area, withdraw and stand still, while the original two do the two-ended lift, turning carry, lowering and release; waits and handoffs are still recorded rather than assuming clearing and carrying can run in parallel at will. Stability and contact checks for the third robot are added to the M2-5 terminal conditions, and the comparison covers success rate, total time, action cost, waiting and mutual blocking.

tools.en: Movable obstacle (0.35 × 0.35 × 0.45 m, 0.6 kg; not a fixed wall)

tools.zh: 地面暂存区（0.50 × 0.55 m），清障后障碍须稳定留在其中
tools.en: Floor staging area (0.50 × 0.55 m) where the cleared obstacle must come to rest

embodiment.zh: 三台相同版本的 Unitree G1 人形（Dex3 三指手）
embodiment.en: Three Unitree G1 humanoids of the same version (Dex3 three-finger hands)

result.zh: 成功：选定运行一次连续完成清障、搬运、交付与三机停稳，仿真用时 257.96 s。同一冻结源码共 6 次运行，3 次成功、3 次失败（1 次未达到终态保持，2 次未完成有效运输）；后续指定节点组的 3 次完整运行均通过。不证明跨环境稳定，也不能由时间差推断第三台机器人带来效率收益。
result.en: Success: the selected run cleared the obstacle, carried and delivered the box and brought all three robots to rest in one continuous run, 257.96 s of simulated time. The same frozen source was run 6 times with 3 passes and 3 failures (one missed the terminal hold, two did not complete effective transport); the three later runs on the selected node family all passed. This does not establish cross-environment stability, and no efficiency benefit of the third robot can be inferred from the time difference.

summary.zh: G1 人形与一台小型机械臂伙伴机器人同在一个房间，要把高处柜内容器里的 65 mm 红球完整放进地面托盘、释放并停稳。G1 自己够不到容器里的球，伙伴机械臂精度够但底座太低，需要通过抬升、平台、推移工作台或坡道改变伙伴的工作位置。所有机器人最终须独立站稳、解除相互承托；判断无法完成时，可全员空手进入各自 Q 位停稳 3 秒。
summary.en: A G1 humanoid and a small arm-equipped partner robot share a room and must put a 65 mm red ball from a container on a high shelf wholly into a floor tray, release it and leave it still. The G1 cannot reach into the container, while the partner's arm is precise enough but its base is too low, so the partner's working position has to be changed by lifting, a platform, a pushed workstation or a ramp. Every robot must finish independently standing with no mutual carrying; if the task is judged impossible, all robots may go empty-handed to their Q bays and stay still for 3 s.

acceptance.zh: 作者于 2026-11-02 确认“通过验收”，覆盖 6 个已声明的工程仿真 case：5 项完整交付、1 项（I01）正确退出，均在同一种子下 3/3 或 4/4 重复。另 10 个 H/W 身体配置尚未完成，不在本次范围；人工独立物理复跑、第二执行者复现、硬件资格和正式准入均未完成，历史失败全部保留。
acceptance.en: On 2026-11-02 the author confirmed the M3 delivery as accepted, covering six declared engineering-simulation cases: five complete deliveries and one correct exit (I01), each repeated 3/3 or 4/4 under a single seed. Ten further H/W body configurations are unfinished and out of scope; independent human physical re-execution, second-operator reproduction, hardware qualification and formal admission are not done, and all historical failures are retained.

axes.zh: 变化的条件包括：伙伴身体（6.39 kg 原重 X5 或 1.94 kg 轻量 WX200 装配，是否满足 2 kg 外载上限）、支撑方式（原低箱、预置 38 cm 平台、需推移的 3 kg 平台、2 m 坡道）、伙伴能否自行上坡，以及容器是否被固定盖板封闭（可解或不可完成）。
axes.en: Varying conditions: the partner body (6.39 kg original X5 or 1.94 kg lightweight WX200 assembly, i.e. whether the 2 kg carried-load limit can be met), the support (original low box, preset 38 cm platform, a 3 kg platform that must be pushed, a 2 m ramp), whether the partner can drive up a ramp, and whether the bin is sealed by a fixed lid (solvable or infeasible).

embodiments.zh: G1 人形（Dex3 手）＋小型机械臂伙伴：ORIG/B03/I01 为原重 X5 轮式机械臂（6.39 kg），B01/B02/B04 为轻量 WX200 装配（1.94 kg）。另 10 个 H/W 身体配置未验收。
embodiments.en: G1 humanoid (Dex3 hands) + a small arm-equipped partner: the original heavy X5 wheeled arm (6.39 kg) in ORIG/B03/I01, a lightweight WX200 assembly (1.94 kg) in B01/B02/B04. The ten H/W body configurations are not accepted.

title.zh: 原始协作取物
title.en: Original cooperative retrieval

conditions.zh: 原始 M3 固定场景 hooks-v0.1（不随机化），原评分与 420 秒预算不变；伙伴为原重 X5（6.39 kg），按原基准豁免处理。扩展新增的 Q 退出与 2 kg 外载规则不追溯适用，本实例可解。
conditions.en: Original fixed M3 scene hooks-v0.1 (no randomization) with the original scorer and 420 s budget unchanged; the partner is the original heavy X5 (6.39 kg) under the original benchmark exemption. The extension's Q-exit and 2 kg load rules do not apply retroactively; the instance is solvable.

design.zh: 红球在书架 0.55 m 层板后部的低矮容器里，上方 0.90 m 层板只留约 0.31 m 净空：G1 手臂够不到，X5 机械臂够长但底座太低。G1 双手抬起 X5 放上靠书架的 0.18 m 箱，X5 伸臂取球；G1 再把 X5 抱回地面并撤手，X5 驶到地面托盘放球，最终双机释放并停稳。
design.en: The red 65 mm ball sits in a low bin at the back of the 0.55 m shelf board, with only about 0.31 m of clearance under the 0.90 m board: the G1 cannot reach it, and the X5 arm is long enough but its base is too low. The G1 lifts the X5 onto the 0.18 m box against the shelf, the X5 reaches in and takes the ball, the G1 carries the X5 back to the floor and lets go, and the X5 drives to the floor tray and releases the ball with both robots finally released and still.

tools.zh: 靠书架的 0.18 m 低箱（支撑台）
tools.en: The 0.18 m box against the shelf (support)

tools.zh: 另一只 32 cm 高可移动箱
tools.en: A second movable box, 32 cm tall

tools.zh: X5 伙伴及其承托钩杆
tools.en: The X5 partner and its carry hook bar

tools.zh: 地面目标托盘 D（带边沿）
tools.en: Ground goal tray D (rimmed)

embodiment.zh: G1 人形（Dex3 手）＋原重 X5 轮式机械臂伙伴（hooks-v0.1，6.39 kg）
embodiment.en: G1 humanoid (Dex3 hands) + the original heavy X5 wheeled-arm partner (hooks-v0.1, 6.39 kg)

result.zh: 成功：v9 控制器正常起点 3/3 完整交付，每次仿真 415.96 秒，原评分 1.0，无监视告警，在 420 秒预算内。仅为同一种子和已验证的两个 CPU 节点；另一节点的差异与历史失败保留，不构成新 2 kg 伙伴资格。
result.en: Success: the v9 controller completed delivery 3/3 from the normal start, 415.96 s of simulated time each, original score 1.0, no monitor alarms, within the 420 s budget. Same seed and two verified CPU nodes only; a third node's divergence and earlier failures are retained, and this is not a qualification under the new 2 kg partner rule.

title.zh: 预置平台独立取物
title.en: Independent retrieval from a preset platform

conditions.zh: 声明的轻量伙伴新实例：伙伴为 1.94 kg 的 WX200 装配（含球 2.00 kg，满足 2 kg 总外部携带载荷上限）；38 cm 高、3 kg 平台已预置在柜前，柜体与容器前移，容器只开 18 cm 宽前开口。固定标称场景、同一种子；可解实例，退出即误放弃。
conditions.en: Declared lightweight-partner instance: the partner is a 1.94 kg WX200 assembly (2.00 kg with the ball, within the 2 kg total carried-load limit); a 38 cm, 3 kg platform is already placed at the cabinet, the cabinet and bin are moved forward, and the bin has an 18 cm front opening. Fixed nominal scene, single seed; solvable, so exiting would be a false abstention.

design.zh: 伙伴在地面够不到容器，持续悬空操作也不作为假定能力，必须先让伙伴在平台上独立受支撑。G1 从地面双手抬起伙伴、整身起立并转腰放上平台后撤手，伙伴独立伸臂取球；G1 再带载重新抓取、回转、下放到地面并撤手，伙伴把球放入前方托盘，两机独立停稳。
design.en: The partner cannot reach the bin from the floor, and sustained airborne operation is not assumed, so it must first stand independently on the platform. The G1 lifts the partner from the floor, rises, turns at the waist and sets it on the platform, then lets go; the partner reaches in and takes the ball on its own. The G1 then re-grasps it with the load, turns back, lowers it to the floor and withdraws, and the partner places the ball in the tray in front; both robots end independently still.

tools.zh: 预置的 38 cm 高、3 kg 平台
tools.en: Preset 38 cm, 3 kg platform

tools.zh: 另一只 32 cm 高可移动箱
tools.en: A second movable box, 32 cm tall

tools.zh: 伙伴的承托横杆／钩杆接口
tools.en: The partner's carry rung / hook interface

tools.en: Ground goal tray D (rimmed)

embodiment.zh: G1 人形（Dex3 手）＋轻量 WX200 机械臂伙伴（原生 WX200 臂、紧凑收臂承托架与四角脚垫，1.94 kg，含球 2.00 kg）
embodiment.en: G1 humanoid (Dex3 hands) + a lightweight WX200 arm partner (native WX200 arm on a compact-stow carry frame with four corner feet, 1.94 kg, 2.00 kg with the ball)

result.zh: 成功：正常起点 3/3 完整交付（源码运行与两次搬移包复跑），仿真时长 200.64、200.64、197.42 秒，独立判定通过、无监视告警，无物理状态恢复。仅同一种子和已记录节点；人工独立复跑与硬件资格未完成。
result.en: Success: complete delivery 3/3 from the normal start (source run plus two relocated-package reruns), 200.64, 200.64 and 197.42 s of simulated time, independent verdict passed with no monitor alarms and no physical state restores. Same seed and recorded nodes only; independent human re-execution and hardware qualification are not done.

title.zh: 推移工作台后协作取物
title.en: Cooperative retrieval after pushing a workstation into place

conditions.zh: 轻量伙伴实例（1.94 kg WX200 装配）；65×50×35 cm、3 kg 可移动平台起始离柜前工作位约 0.5 m，须实际推移到位、禁止持续搬着走；容器前开口放宽到 26 cm。固定标称场景、同一种子；可解实例。
conditions.en: Lightweight-partner instance (1.94 kg WX200 assembly); a movable 65x50x35 cm, 3 kg platform starts about 0.5 m from the work position at the cabinet and must actually be pushed there, not carried; the bin front opening is widened to 26 cm. Fixed nominal scene, single seed; solvable.

design.zh: 现成支撑不在可用位置，需要先建立工作台。G1 用脚近地推移平台到柜前，再抬起伙伴放上平台；伙伴以紧凑姿态转向开口、径向伸臂取球后折叠。G1 带载重新抓取、回转、下放并撤手，伙伴把球放入托盘，全员独立停稳。
design.en: No support is in a usable place, so a workstation must be set up first. The G1 pushes the platform to the cabinet with near-ground foot pushes, then lifts the partner onto it; the partner turns compactly toward the opening, extends radially, takes the ball and folds back. The G1 re-grasps with the load, turns back, lowers the partner and withdraws, and the partner places the ball in the tray; all robots end independently still.

tools.zh: 可移动平台 65×50×35 cm、3 kg（需推移）
tools.en: Movable 65x50x35 cm, 3 kg platform (must be pushed)

tools.zh: 另一只 32 cm 高可移动箱
tools.en: A second movable box, 32 cm tall

embodiment.en: G1 humanoid (Dex3 hands) + a lightweight WX200 arm partner (native WX200 arm on a compact-stow carry frame with four corner feet, 1.94 kg, 2.00 kg with the ball)

result.zh: 成功：正常起点 4/4 完整交付（跨两个 CPU 节点，含两次搬移包复跑），每次 339.10 秒；平台实际推移约 0.48 m，取物全段平台独立支撑检查全部通过，无监视告警。仅同一种子；历史实例与失败保留，不提升为成功。
result.en: Success: complete delivery 4/4 from the normal start (two CPU nodes, including two relocated-package reruns), 339.10 s each; the platform was actually pushed about 0.48 m, every retrieval sample passed the independent platform-support check, and there were no monitor alarms. Same seed only; earlier instances and failures are retained and not promoted.

title.zh: 接触辅助坡道取物
title.en: Contact-assisted ramp retrieval

conditions.zh: 原重 X5（6.39 kg）超过 2 kg 外载上限，抬升路线不可用；场景增加一条固定的 2 m 二次曲线坡道通向柜前 0.18 m 平台。原柜体布局，仿真预算 420 秒，固定标称场景、同一种子；可解实例，按声明的目标区域修订版判定。
conditions.en: The original heavy X5 (6.39 kg) exceeds the 2 kg carried-load limit, so lifting is ruled out; a fixed 2 m quadratic ramp leads up to the 0.18 m platform at the cabinet. Original cabinet layout, 420 s simulation budget, fixed nominal scene, single seed; solvable, judged under the declared goal-region revision.

design.zh: G1 不承托，不能因为抬不动就退出，需判断伙伴底盘与坡道能否上台并带载返回。X5 自行沿坡道驶上平台，伸臂取出容器里的球，持球倒退下坡后驶向托盘放球，两机最终独立停稳。
design.en: The G1 gives no support, and being unable to lift is not a reason to exit: the robots must work out whether the partner's base and the ramp allow climbing up and returning loaded. The X5 drives up the ramp onto the platform, reaches in for the ball, reverses down the ramp holding it, drives to the tray and releases it; both robots end independently still.

tools.zh: 固定的 2 m 曲线坡道
tools.en: Fixed 2 m curved ramp

tools.zh: 柜前 0.18 m 平台箱
tools.en: 0.18 m platform box at the cabinet

tools.en: The X5's own wheeled drive

embodiment.en: G1 humanoid (Dex3 hands) + the original heavy X5 wheeled-arm partner (hooks-v0.1, 6.39 kg)

refusal_note.zh: 配对的不可完成对照为 M3C-I01：同一场景只加一块固定刚性盖板封闭容器。
refusal_note.en: Paired infeasible control: M3C-I01, the same scene with only a fixed rigid lid closing the bin.

result.zh: 成功：正常起点 3/3 完整交付（两个节点），仿真时长 165.90、165.42、165.52 秒，扩展判定通过，末态连续独立停稳 3 秒以上。仅同一种子；取物时伙伴有与固定容器的实际接触辅助，不证明自由平台全程承重，也不转作 B01/B02 的支撑资格。
result.en: Success: complete delivery 3/3 from the normal start (two nodes), 165.90, 165.42 and 165.52 s of simulated time, extension verdict passed, with more than 3 s of continuous independent final rest. Same seed only; during retrieval the partner is helped by real contact with the fixed bin, so this does not prove free-standing platform support throughout and does not transfer to B01/B02.

title.zh: 坡道环境下协作搬运
title.en: Cooperative lift with a ramp present

conditions.zh: 沿用 B01 的轻量伙伴实例（38 cm 平台、18 cm 前开口），另加一条通向平台的固定实体坡道；伙伴没有行驶电机，不能走坡道。固定标称场景、同一种子；可解实例。
conditions.en: Same lightweight-partner instance as B01 (38 cm platform, 18 cm front opening) plus a fixed physical ramp up to the platform; the partner has no drive motors and cannot use the ramp. Fixed nominal scene, single seed; solvable.

design.zh: 坡道在场但伙伴无法行驶上去，需要改为检查 G1 能否完成抬升、平台取物与下放。G1 抬起伙伴放上平台，伙伴独立取球；G1 再带载重新抓取、下放并撤手，伙伴把球放入托盘，两机独立停稳。
design.en: A ramp is present but the partner cannot drive up it, so the robots must instead check whether the G1 can lift, support platform retrieval and lower the partner. The G1 lifts the partner onto the platform, the partner takes the ball on its own, the G1 re-grasps, lowers it and withdraws, and the partner places the ball in the tray; both robots end independently still.

tools.zh: 通向平台的固定实体坡道
tools.en: Fixed physical ramp to the platform

tools.zh: 预置的 38 cm 高、3 kg 平台
tools.en: Preset 38 cm, 3 kg platform

tools.zh: 另一只 32 cm 高可移动箱
tools.en: A second movable box, 32 cm tall

tools.zh: 伙伴的承托横杆／钩杆接口
tools.en: The partner's carry rung / hook interface

tools.zh: 地面目标托盘 D（带边沿）
tools.en: Ground goal tray D (rimmed)

embodiment.zh: G1 人形（Dex3 手）＋轻量 WX200 机械臂伙伴（原生 WX200 臂、紧凑收臂承托架与四角脚垫，1.94 kg，含球 2.00 kg）
embodiment.en: G1 humanoid (Dex3 hands) + a lightweight WX200 arm partner (native WX200 arm on a compact-stow carry frame with four corner feet, 1.94 kg, 2.00 kg with the ball)

result.zh: 成功：正常起点 3/3 完整交付（源码与两次搬移包复跑），仿真时长 200.64、200.64、197.42 秒，与 B01 使用同一 v36 控制器。不主张已排除全部机械爬行路线；历史 v31 单次成功因搬移复跑失败未计入。
result.en: Success: complete delivery 3/3 from the normal start (source run plus two relocated-package reruns), 200.64, 200.64 and 197.42 s, using the same v36 controller as B01. It does not claim that every mechanical crawling route is excluded; an earlier single v31 success was not counted because its relocated rerun failed.

title.zh: 闭盖证书与空手退出
title.en: Sealed-bin certificate and empty-handed exit

conditions.zh: 与 B03 成功场景相同（原重 X5、坡道、平台），只加一块可见、固定、带碰撞的刚性盖板封闭容器。不可完成实例：正确行为是不先尝试搬运，全员空手进入各自 Q 位并同时停稳 3 秒；超时不算退出。
conditions.en: Identical to the solved B03 scene (heavy X5, ramp, platform) except for one visible, fixed, colliding rigid lid that closes the bin. Infeasible instance: the correct behaviour is to skip manipulation and have every robot go empty-handed to its own Q bay and stay still together for 3 s; a timeout does not count as an exit.

design.zh: 容器底板、四壁和全跨度盖板构成不可改变的封闭边界，球无法连续移出；直接取物、抬升、改变支撑、坡道、工具及其组合全部被排除。机器人需从可见盖板判断不可行，然后空手驶入或停到各自 Q 位。
design.en: The bin floor, four walls and full-span lid form an unchangeable closed boundary, so the ball cannot be moved out; direct retrieval, lifting, support changes, the ramp, tools and all combinations are excluded. The robots must recognise this from the visible lid and move empty-handed into their own Q bays.

tools.zh: 与 B03 相同的坡道、平台箱与 32 cm 箱
tools.en: The same ramp, platform box and 32 cm box as B03

tools.zh: 封闭容器的固定刚性盖板
tools.en: Fixed rigid lid sealing the bin

tools.zh: 地面目标托盘 D（带边沿）
tools.en: Ground goal tray D (rimmed)

tools.zh: 两台机器人各自的 Q 退出位
tools.en: A Q exit bay for each robot

embodiment.zh: G1 人形（Dex3 手）＋原重 X5 轮式机械臂伙伴（hooks-v0.1，6.39 kg）
embodiment.en: G1 humanoid (Dex3 hands) + the original heavy X5 wheeled-arm partner (hooks-v0.1, 6.39 kg)

refusal_note.zh: 容器被固定刚性盖板完全封闭，任何合法路线都必须让球穿过这一不可改变的封闭边界，因此所有路线都不可行；配对的可解场景为 M3C-B03。
refusal_note.en: The bin is fully sealed by a fixed rigid lid; any legal route would have to move the ball through this unchangeable closed boundary, so every route is infeasible. Paired solvable scene: M3C-B03.

result.zh: 正确退出：3/3（三个节点）证书有效、正确放弃，两台机器人空手、独立着地并在 Q 位同时停稳 4.08 秒，回合 8.0 秒结束，无物理安全错误。不计作目标交付；仅同一种子。
result.en: Correct exit: 3/3 (three nodes) with a valid certificate and correct abstention; both robots empty-handed, independently grounded and still together in their Q bays for 4.08 s, episode ending at 8.0 s with no physical safety errors. Not counted as a delivery; same seed only.

name.zh: Sokoban：双 G1 隐藏地图推箱清路

summary.zh: 两台 G1 在未知的分室地图中探索，只凭各自第一视角 RGB、本体感知、自身目标标识和收到的显式消息构建并更新全局地图，通过物理推箱清理通路，最终同时稳定驻留在各自的目标区；箱子没有交付目标，只能推，不能抓、拉、抬。核心问题是能否从局部观察构建一致、可更新的全局地图并据此行动，以及显式通信（C+）相对无显式通信（C−）是否改善建图与执行。软件工具可由 agent 在私有沙盒内按需编写，实体工具不是通关要求。
summary.en: Two G1 humanoids explore an unknown divided-room map and, using only their own first-person RGB, proprioception, own goal identity and explicitly received messages, build and update a global map, physically push crates to clear routes, and finally both hold steady in their own goal zones; crates have no delivery targets and may only be pushed, never grasped, pulled or lifted. The core question is whether robots can build a consistent, updatable global map from local observations and act on it, and whether explicit communication (C+) improves mapping and execution over no explicit communication (C−). Agents may write software tools in a private sandbox as needed; physical tools are not required.

acceptance.zh: 作者已签收 6 个冻结的显式通信（C+）配置，依据第六轮冻结资格批次：8 个必需成功槽位（6 个配置见证与两次 L1 同种子复现）全部完整通过，6 份冻结见证包均已核对文件哈希并复算全部审计。6 个同实例无通信（C−）消融均在 650 s 时限内未完成，不算成功；L1 两个独立种子也完整通过，两张预留拓扑测试图一张因机器人碰撞失败、一张完整通过，仅作描述性证据。旧机器证据仍为 task_success=null、formal_admission=false，人工全视频审阅与独立人员复现未签名，前五轮资格批次的失败记录全部保留；作者构造的开发地图不能证明未见拓扑泛化或通信的总体收益。
acceptance.en: The author signed off the six frozen explicit-communication (C+) configurations on the basis of the sixth frozen qualification cohort, in which all 8 required-success slots (the six configuration witnesses and two same-seed L1 reproductions) passed in full and all six frozen witness packets had their file hashes checked and every audit recomputed. The six matched no-communication (C−) ablations all ran out the 650 s budget and do not count as successes; two independent L1 seeds also passed in full, while of two reserved-topology test maps one failed with a robot collision and one passed, as descriptive evidence only. The old machine evidence still records task_success=null and formal_admission=false, human full-video review and independent-person reproduction are unsigned, and the failures of the five earlier qualification cohorts are retained; the authored development maps do not demonstrate unseen-topology generalization or an overall communication benefit.

axes.zh: 地图拓扑与机器人能力两条轴：L1 为固定四箱开发图；L2 为三种作者构造的拓扑（信息互补、共享瓶颈、动态更新）；L3 沿用 L1 地图，仅将一台 G1 的手臂力矩上限降为 0.75 倍（A/B 互换）。签收的 6 个配置均为显式通信开启（C+），使用同一冻结策略、物理技能与 650 s 预算；C− 消融只作配对对照。
axes.en: Two axes, map topology and robot capability: L1 is the fixed four-crate development map; L2 has three authored topologies (complementary information, shared bottleneck, dynamic update); L3 keeps the L1 map and only scales one G1's arm effort limit to 0.75 (A/B swapped). All six accepted configurations have explicit communication enabled (C+) with the same frozen policy, physical skills and 650 s budget; the C− ablations serve only as paired controls.

embodiments.zh: 两台同型 G1 人形机器人，每台每控制步提交 43 个绝对关节目标
embodiments.en: Two identical G1 humanoids, each submitting 43 absolute joint targets per control step

embodiments.zh: 两台 G1，其中一台手臂力矩上限为 0.75 倍（L3 能力反转）
embodiments.en: Two G1s, one with its arm effort limit scaled to 0.75 (L3 capability reversal)

title.zh: L1 · 固定四箱开发图
title.en: L1 · Fixed four-crate development map

conditions.zh: SK-L1；两台同型 G1；C+ 显式通信（每条消息 ≤256 UTF-8 字节，每接收者最多 16 条待处理）；完整地图、箱子真值位姿和同伴隐藏状态均不提供；两机策略隔离执行（各自私有文件系统、进程与网络命名空间）；预算 650 s；成功＝两机同时站立并稳定驻留在各自目标区。
conditions.en: SK-L1; two identical G1s; C+ explicit messages (at most 256 UTF-8 bytes each, at most 16 pending per recipient); no full map, ground-truth crate poses or hidden peer state; the two policies run isolated (private filesystem, process and network namespaces); 650 s budget; success = both robots standing and holding steady in their own goal zones at the same time.

design.zh: 9×7 格（格距 0.9 m，含外墙）的双室地图，两机分别从两侧房间出发，须到达对面房间中带颜色标识的自身目标；四个可推动箱子阻挡通路，其中一个堵住共享门洞。机器人须从自身 RGB 重建地图、交换地图信息，并决定由谁推哪个箱子以及通行顺序。
design.en: A two-room map of 9 × 7 cells (0.9 m grid, including outer walls); each robot starts in one room and must reach its own color-coded goal in the opposite room, while four pushable crates obstruct the routes, one of them blocking the shared doorway. The robots must rebuild the map from their own RGB, exchange map information, and decide who pushes which crate and in what order they pass.

tools.zh: 4 个可推动箱子（0.65×0.65×0.55 m，4 kg，摩擦系数 0.4），只能推，不能抓、拉、抬
tools.en: Four pushable crates (0.65 × 0.65 × 0.55 m, 4 kg, friction 0.4); push only, no grasping, pulling or lifting

tools.zh: 同伴 G1 与受限显式消息通道
tools.en: The peer G1 and a bounded explicit message channel

tools.zh: 可选：在私有沙盒内自行编写建图、地图融合与规划程序
tools.en: Optional: self-written mapping, map-fusion and planning programs in a private sandbox

embodiment.zh: 两台同型 G1 人形机器人
embodiment.en: Two identical G1 humanoids

result.zh: 冻结 C+ 见证成功：424.66 s 仿真时间内两机同时到达并驻留在各自目标区，30 个高层动作（3 次推箱）对应 79 个低层段，全部自动物理与证据检查通过；两机局部地图平均覆盖 89.7%，连通性问答全部正确。另有两次同种子复现和两个独立种子均完整通过；同实例 C− 消融在 650 s 时限内未完成。人工全视频审阅未签名。
result.en: Frozen C+ witness succeeded: both robots reached and held their own goal zones within 424.66 s of simulated time, with 30 high-level actions (3 pushes) mapped to 79 low-level segments and every automated physics and evidence check passed; the two local maps averaged 89.7% coverage and answered every connectivity query correctly. Two same-seed reproductions and two independent seeds also passed in full; the matched C− ablation did not finish within 650 s. Human full-video review is unsigned.

title.zh: L2 · 信息互补
title.en: L2 · Complementary information

conditions.zh: SK-L2；两台同型 G1；C+ 显式通信（限制同 L1）；原生执行；地图与箱子真值隐藏；预算 650 s；成功＝两机同时站立并稳定驻留在各自目标区。
conditions.en: SK-L2; two identical G1s; C+ explicit messages (same limits as L1); native execution; map and crate ground truth hidden; 650 s budget; success = both robots standing and holding steady in their own goal zones at the same time.

design.zh: 在双室布局上加入内凹墙段，形成非对称的侧室遮挡，两机初始视野覆盖不同分支；一方发现的死路或通道可帮助另一方减少重复探索。通信是否有益是实验问题，不预设结论。
design.en: Inset wall segments added to the two-room layout create asymmetric side-room occlusion, so the two robots initially see different branches; a dead end or passage found by one robot can spare the other repeated exploration. Whether communication helps is an experimental question, not a presupposition.

tools.zh: 4 个可推动箱子（0.65×0.65×0.55 m，4 kg，摩擦系数 0.4），只能推，不能抓、拉、抬
tools.en: Four pushable crates (0.65 × 0.65 × 0.55 m, 4 kg, friction 0.4); push only, no grasping, pulling or lifting
