title.zh: L2 · 共享瓶颈
title.en: L2 · Shared bottleneck

conditions.zh: SK-L2（修订 2）；两台同型 G1；C+ 显式通信（限制同 L1）；原生执行；地图与箱子真值隐藏；预算 650 s；成功＝两机同时站立并稳定驻留在各自目标区。
conditions.en: SK-L2 (revision 2); two identical G1s; C+ explicit messages (same limits as L1); native execution; map and crate ground truth hidden; 650 s budget; success = both robots standing and holding steady in their own goal zones at the same time.

design.zh: 修订 2 用箱子同时堵住两条跨室通道（修订 1 存在无需推箱的绕行路线，保留为对照）；一方清路会改变另一方的可达区域，需要更新地图并协调执行顺序。不据此声称任务必须依赖推力。
design.en: Revision 2 blocks both cross-room passages with crates (revision 1 allowed a valid no-push detour and is kept as a control); clearing a route by one robot changes what the other can reach, so the map and execution order must be updated. No claim is made that the task depends on pushing force.

design.zh: 改变箱子停放位置（一个箱子改停在隔墙右侧）并设置非对称通道，推箱后通路改变，机器人须重新观察、更新地图并重规划。只有实际记录到失败与恢复时才计为恢复。
design.en: Crate parking is changed (one crate now sits beside the right side of the partition) and an asymmetric passage is added, so routes change after pushing and the robots must re-observe, update the map and replan. Recovery is credited only when a failure and its recovery are actually recorded.

title.zh: L3 · 能力反转 A（g1_a 手臂力矩降低）

conditions.zh: SK-L3；沿用 L1 地图与目标；g1_a 手臂力矩上限为 0.75 倍，g1_b 保持 1.0；C+ 显式通信（限制同 L1）；原生执行；预算 650 s；成功＝两机同时站立并稳定驻留在各自目标区。
conditions.en: SK-L3; same map and goals as L1; g1_a arm effort limit scaled to 0.75, g1_b kept at 1.0; C+ explicit messages (same limits as L1); native execution; 650 s budget; success = both robots standing and holding steady in their own goal zones at the same time.

design.zh: 地图、箱子与目标均与 L1 相同，只改变已声明的手臂力矩能力，考察地图如何支持不同身体约束下的可达性判断与分工；与 L3-B 构成能力反转对。双 G1 力矩反转本身不能证明能力识别或角色适应。
design.en: Map, crates and goals are identical to L1 and only the declared arm-effort capability changes, probing how the map supports reachability judgments and task division under different body limits; it forms a capability-reversal pair with L3-B. A dual-G1 effort reversal does not by itself demonstrate capability identification or role adaptation.

design.en: Same map and goals as L3-A but with the effort limit moved to g1_b, testing whether reachability judgments and task division follow when the capability difference is reversed; a dual-G1 effort reversal does not by itself demonstrate capability identification or role adaptation.

name.zh: 桌面汉诺塔：跨身体工具使用
name.en: Tabletop Tower of Hanoi: cross-embodiment tool use

summary.zh: 固定骨盆的 G1 在桌面三杆汉诺塔场景中借助工具搬运带孔圆盘：每次只搬一个顶盘、大盘不得压小盘、整盘须越过杆顶并完全释放。十个独立任务按末端（Dex3、平行夹爪、Inspire 五指手）、能力公开或隐藏、夹持／腕力矩边界以及盘数分别登记，考察跨身体工具相性、能力边界判断与 self-modeling。场景提供 T1 侧夹钳与 T2 底部托叉，当前十项参考均以 T2 完成。
summary.en: A fixed-pelvis G1 moves annular disks between three rods on a table using tools: only one top disk moves at a time, a larger disk may never rest on a smaller one, and each disk must clear the rod top and be fully released. Ten separate tasks vary the end effector (Dex3, parallel gripper, Inspire five-finger hand), disclosed versus hidden capability, grip or wrist-torque boundaries, and disk count, testing cross-embodiment tool compatibility, capability-boundary judgment and self-modeling. The scene offers T1 tongs and a T2 under-disk fork; all ten current references use T2.

acceptance.zh: 2026-11-01 作者签收当前十项参考交付（10/10），各按冻结目标：01–04、06 为三盘七步整塔，05、09、10 为取具后最小盘 A→C 的单次完整转移，07/08 提交完整 15/31 步符号计划但只物理执行前三次转移。参考均为读取真值的特权专家解，不代表 learned self-modeling 成绩；任务族专项设计要求与正式准入仍未通过，T1 侧夹钳的完整路线相性仍未确定。
acceptance.en: On 2026-11-01 the author signed off the current ten-task reference delivery (10/10), each against its own frozen goal: Hanoi-01–04 and 06 are seven-move three-disk towers, 05, 09 and 10 are a single complete smallest-disk A→C transfer after tool pickup, and 07/08 submit complete 15/31-move symbolic plans but physically execute only the first three transfers. All references are privileged expert solutions, not learned self-modeling scores; the family-level design requirements and formal admission remain open, and full-route compatibility of the T1 tongs is still undetermined.

axes.zh: 末端身体（Dex3／平行夹爪／Inspire 五指手）；能力信息公开或隐藏（01↔03、02↔04、09↔10 为同一物理实例配对）；能力边界（夹持 0.25 倍、腕力矩 0.0625 倍）；盘数与目标范围（三盘整塔、四／五盘完整规划加前三步物理执行、单次转移）；时限 2400／4200／8500 仿真秒。
axes.en: End-effector body (Dex3 / parallel gripper / Inspire five-finger hand); disclosed versus hidden capability (01↔03, 02↔04 and 09↔10 are paired on the same physical instance); capability boundaries (grip at 0.25×, wrist torque at 0.0625×); disk count and goal scope (three-disk full tower, four/five-disk full plan with the first three physical transfers, single transfer); budgets of 2400/4200/8500 simulated seconds.

embodiments.en: G1 + Dex3 three-finger hands (fixed pelvis)

title.zh: Dex3·三盘整塔·能力公开
title.en: Dex3, three-disk full tower, capability disclosed

conditions.zh: 三盘、标称能力，公开本实例的有效能力参数；固定骨盆 G1＋Dex3；T1、T2 两种工具在场；目标为三盘七步整塔 A→C；时限 2400 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Three disks, nominal capability, with this instance's effective capability parameters disclosed; fixed-pelvis G1 + Dex3; tools T1 and T2 present; goal is the seven-move three-disk tower A→C; 2400 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 桌面三根 0.18 m 高的杆相距 0.25 m，三只 0.12 kg 带孔圆盘叠在 A 杆。机器人须自选工具、握点与单双手方式，每次只搬一个顶盘、越过杆顶、合法套杆并完全释放，最终整塔在 C 杆稳定 2 秒；测已知身体条件下的工具相性。
design.en: Three 0.18 m rods stand 0.25 m apart on the table, with three 0.12 kg annular disks stacked on rod A. The robot chooses the tool, grasp point and one- or two-hand mode, moves one top disk at a time over the rod top, places it legally and fully releases it, and the full tower must stand stable on rod C for 2 s; this tests tool compatibility under known body conditions.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）
tools.en: T2 fork: under-disk support tool (used by the current reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3 三指灵巧手（固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 three-finger hands (fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a177 从初始状态连续完成 7/7 合法移动，用时 1528.88 仿真秒；全部 305,776 个物理步的独立回放误差为零。路线使用 T2 托叉并含三次桌面支撑重握；这是读取真值的特权专家参考，不是 self-modeling 成绩。
result.en: Success: reference run a177 completed 7/7 legal moves continuously from the initial state in 1528.88 simulated seconds; an independent replay of all 305,776 physics steps matched with zero error. The route uses the T2 fork with three table-supported regrasps; this is a privileged expert reference, not a self-modeling score.

title.zh: 平行夹爪·三盘整塔·能力公开
title.en: Parallel gripper, three-disk full tower, capability disclosed

conditions.zh: 与 01 相同的盘、杆和工具，只把末端换成平行夹爪并公开相应能力信息；三盘七步整塔；时限 2400 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Same disks, rods and tools as Hanoi-01; only the end effector is swapped for the parallel gripper, with its capability information disclosed; seven-move three-disk tower; 2400 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 测换身体后是否正确调整工具或操作路线；与 01 比较共同操作。
design.en: Tests whether the tool or operating route is adapted correctly after the body changes; compared with Hanoi-01 on the shared operation.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）

embodiment.zh: G1＋合成平行夹爪（每侧行程 35 mm、25 N 上限，仿真设计，非商业硬件；固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + synthetic parallel gripper (35 mm stroke and 25 N per jaw; a simulated design, not commercial hardware; fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a108 完成 7/7 合法移动，用时 1327.39 仿真秒；265,477 步完整独立回放误差为零。平行夹爪路线无需重握即完成与 01 相同的高层移动，这是观察到的差异，不声明因果必要性。
result.en: Success: reference run a108 completed 7/7 legal moves in 1327.39 simulated seconds; the full 265,477-step independent replay matched with zero error. The gripper route completes the same high-level moves as Hanoi-01 without regrasping; this is an observed difference, not a claim of causal necessity.

conditions.zh: 与 01 同一物理实例，只隐藏所选有效能力参数；三盘七步整塔；有限探测预算；时限 2400 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Same physical instance as Hanoi-01, with only the selected effective capability parameters hidden; seven-move three-disk tower; bounded probe budget; 2400 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: agent 须先做有限探测、预测工具与路线可行性，再完成整塔；与 01 配对，测自身能力估计。
design.en: The agent must run bounded probes and predict tool and route feasibility before completing the tower; paired with Hanoi-01 to test self-capability estimation.

result.en: Success: reference run a184 executed independently with the same frozen source as Hanoi-01, completing 7/7 in 1528.88 simulated seconds; the full 305,776-step replay matched with zero error. title.zh: Dex3·夹持边界·单次完整转移
title.en: Dex3, grip boundary, single complete transfer

conditions.zh: 夹持能力降为标称的 0.25 倍且不公开；授权修订 single-transfer-v2：保留三盘场景，取具后只把最小盘 A→C、撤具，其余两盘留在 A，全部盘独立稳定 2 秒；时限 2400 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Grip capability reduced to 0.25 of nominal and not disclosed; authorized revision single-transfer-v2 keeps the three-disk scene but requires only taking a tool, moving the smallest disk A→C and withdrawing the tool, with the other two disks left on A and every disk independently stable for 2 s; 2400 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 该能力下原工具／握点组合失效，而同能力下调整握法仍能完成，需通过探测发现边界并改换路线，且不公开“夹持下降”标签。原七步整塔版本多轮完成五次放盘后，失败集中在空叉反复换握，经作者允许收敛为一次完整转移。
design.en: At this capability the original tool/grasp combination fails while an adjusted grasp at the same capability still works, so the boundary must be found by probing and the route changed; the reduced-grip label is never disclosed. The original seven-move version reached five placements but kept failing during repeated empty-fork regrasps, so with the author's permission it was narrowed to one complete transfer.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）
tools.en: T2 fork: under-disk support tool (used by the current reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3 三指灵巧手（固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 three-finger hands (fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a307 完成 1/1 转移，用时 210.92 仿真秒，42,183 步独立回放误差为零，采用短握法替代路线。对照显示同一弱能力下原握法失败、较强能力下原握法成功；结论只针对这组控制器，不含重复换握维护。
result.en: Success: reference run a307 completed the 1/1 transfer in 210.92 simulated seconds, and the 42,183-step independent replay matched with zero error; it uses a short-grasp alternative route. Controls show the original grasp fails at the same weak capability and succeeds at a stronger one; the conclusion covers these controllers only and excludes repeated regrasp maintenance.

title.zh: 平行夹爪·腕力矩边界·三盘整塔
title.en: Parallel gripper, wrist-torque boundary, three-disk full tower

conditions.zh: 腕部力矩能力降为标称的 0.0625 倍且不公开（2026-10-30 标定后冻结）；三盘七步整塔；时限 2400 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Wrist torque capability reduced to 0.0625 of nominal and not disclosed (frozen after calibration on 2026-10-30); seven-move three-disk tower; 2400 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 原工具／握点组合在该腕力矩下失效，但轻工具、短力臂或双手分担中至少一条路线仍可执行；测力臂选择与能力边界判断。
design.en: The original tool/grasp combination fails at this wrist torque, but at least one route (lighter tool, shorter lever arm or two-hand load sharing) still works; this tests lever-arm choice and capability-boundary judgment.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）
tools.en: T2 fork: under-disk support tool (used by the current reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋合成平行夹爪（每侧行程 35 mm、25 N 上限，仿真设计，非商业硬件；固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + synthetic parallel gripper (35 mm stroke and 25 N per jaw; a simulated design, not commercial hardware; fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a259 完成 7/7，用时 1578.90 仿真秒，315,780 步完整回放误差为零。对照显示同一固定握法在相同腕力矩上限下饱和失败，短握法与只增大腕力矩的对照均成功；不证明所有策略在该能力下都会失败。
result.en: Success: reference run a259 completed 7/7 in 1578.90 simulated seconds, and the full 315,780-step replay matched with zero error. Controls show the same fixed grasp saturates and fails under the same wrist cap, while a short grasp and a wrist-torque-only increase both succeed; this does not prove every policy fails at this capability.

title.zh: Dex3·四盘·完整规划＋前三步物理执行
title.en: Dex3, four disks, full plan plus first three physical transfers

conditions.zh: 四盘、能力公开；授权修订 full-plan-three-transfer-v2：须提交完整 15 步整塔计划，只物理执行前三次转移（上方两盘移到 C，其余留 A）；时限 4200 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Four disks, capability disclosed; authorized revision full-plan-three-transfer-v2 requires the complete 15-move tower plan but physically executes only its first three transfers (top two disks to C, the rest left on A); 4200 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 测符号规划深度与初段物理对应：实际三步须与提交计划的前三步一致，包含取具、一次真实桌面重握、越杆与稳定释放，最后全部盘独立稳定 2 秒。
design.en: Tests symbolic planning depth and its match to the opening physical moves: the three executed moves must equal the plan's first three, including tool pickup, one real table-supported regrasp, rod clearance and stable release, after which every disk must stay independently stable for 2 s.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）
tools.en: T2 fork: under-disk support tool (used by the current reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3 三指灵巧手（固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 three-finger hands (fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a286 提交完整 15 步计划，完成 3/3 物理转移并真实重握，用时 651.58 仿真秒，130,316 步完整回放通过。只含前三次物理转移，其余 12 步仅为符号验证，不宣称整塔物理执行。
result.en: Success: reference run a286 submitted the complete 15-move plan and completed 3/3 physical transfers with a real regrasp in 651.58 simulated seconds; the full 130,316-step replay passed. Only the first three physical transfers are included; the remaining 12 moves are symbolic only, and full-tower physical execution is not claimed.

title.zh: Dex3·五盘·完整规划＋前三步物理执行
title.en: Dex3, five disks, full plan plus first three physical transfers

conditions.zh: 五盘、能力公开；授权修订 full-plan-three-transfer-v2：须提交完整 31 步整塔计划，只物理执行前三次转移（上方两盘移到 B，其余留 A）；时限 8500 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Five disks, capability disclosed; authorized revision full-plan-three-transfer-v2 requires the complete 31-move tower plan but physically executes only its first three transfers (top two disks to B, the rest left on A); 8500 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 与 07 对照完整符号规划深度，不以重复搬运次数衡量 reasoning；物理部分同样含取具、真实重握、越杆与稳定释放。
design.en: Contrasts full symbolic planning depth with Hanoi-07 rather than measuring reasoning by repeated carries; the physical part again includes tool pickup, a real regrasp, rod clearance and stable release.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）
tools.en: T2 fork: under-disk support tool (used by the current reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3 三指灵巧手（固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3 three-finger hands (fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a288 提交完整 31 步计划，完成 3/3 物理转移并真实重握，用时 617.89 仿真秒，123,578 步完整回放通过。只含前三次物理转移，其余 28 步仅为符号验证，不宣称整塔物理执行。
result.en: Success: reference run a288 submitted the complete 31-move plan and completed 3/3 physical transfers with a real regrasp in 617.89 simulated seconds; the full 123,578-step replay passed. Only the first three physical transfers are included; the remaining 28 moves are symbolic only, and full-tower physical execution is not claimed.

title.zh: 五指手·单次转移·能力公开
title.en: Five-finger hand, single transfer, capability disclosed

conditions.zh: 三盘初始场景、标称能力、公开；授权修订 single-transfer-v2：取具后把最小盘从 A 越杆搬到 C、撤具，其余两盘留在 A，全部盘稳定 2 秒；时限 2400 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Three-disk initial scene, nominal capability, disclosed; authorized revision single-transfer-v2: take a tool, carry the smallest disk from A over the rod to C, withdraw the tool, leave the other two disks on A, and keep all disks stable for 2 s; 2400 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 测五指手的工具获取、承载和操作相性。旧七步候选多次完成首步，但重握后握内漂移、重复插入失败，因此收敛为一次完整工具转移；与 01/02 只比较共同首步。
design.en: Tests tool acquisition, load bearing and operating compatibility of the five-finger hand. Earlier seven-move candidates repeatedly completed the first move but failed through in-hand drift after regrasps and repeated insertion, so the goal was narrowed to one complete tool transfer; comparison with Hanoi-01/02 uses only the shared first move.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）
tools.en: T2 fork: under-disk support tool (used by the current reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Inspire 五指灵巧手（Unitree G1 配套资产；固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + Inspire five-finger hands (Unitree G1 companion asset; fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a273 完成 1/1 转移，用时 280.74 仿真秒，56,147 步完整回放误差为零。
result.en: Success: reference run a273 completed the 1/1 transfer in 280.74 simulated seconds, and the full 56,147-step replay matched with zero error.

title.zh: 五指手·单次转移·能力隐藏
title.en: Five-finger hand, single transfer, capability hidden

conditions.zh: 与 09 同一三盘初始场景与物理条件，只隐藏能力信息；同为 single-transfer-v2 单次转移；有限探测预算；时限 2400 仿真秒。
conditions.en: Same three-disk initial scene and physics as Hanoi-09, with only the capability information hidden; same single-transfer-v2 goal; bounded probe budget; 2400 simulated-second budget.

design.zh: 有限探测后先预测所选工具／路线能否完成再执行；与 09 构成第三种身体的公开／隐藏配对。
design.en: After bounded probing the agent predicts whether the chosen tool and route will work before executing; forms the disclosed/hidden pair with Hanoi-09 for the third body.

tools.zh: T1 侧夹钳：被动侧向夹持工具
tools.en: T1 tongs: passive side-clamping tool

tools.zh: T2 底部托叉：从盘下支撑的托具（当前参考解使用）
tools.en: T2 fork: under-disk support tool (used by the current reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Inspire 五指灵巧手（Unitree G1 配套资产；固定骨盆）
embodiment.en: G1 + Inspire five-finger hands (Unitree G1 companion asset; fixed pelvis)

result.zh: 成功：参考运行 a274 与 09 同物理条件、同冻结源码独立完成 1/1，用时 280.74 仿真秒，56,147 步完整回放通过。特权专家不含探测与预测评测。
result.en: Success: reference run a274, under the same physics and frozen source as Hanoi-09, independently completed the 1/1 transfer in 280.74 simulated seconds, and the full 56,147-step replay passed. The privileged expert does not include probe-and-predict evaluation.

summary.zh: Disk Flip 考察在公开的速度与接触力限制下轻柔翻转桌面盘体：取得可抓持的悬伸后夹起翻面，放回目标区域，完全撤手并稳定保持 2 秒。原版 DF-01 保留固定的推边、双手夹持流程与原评分器；扩展设置改变盘体（实心圆盘、带沿浅盘、受力敏感浅盘）和身体（G1＋Dex3、G1＋Inspire 五指手、Stretch 3＋夹爪），并接受重抓、桌面支撑与受控交接等任何合法策略。
summary.en: Disk Flip tests gently flipping a tabletop plate under public speed and contact-force limits: obtain a graspable overhang, pick it up and turn it over, place it in the goal area, release completely and hold still for 2 s. The original DF-01 keeps its fixed push-to-edge and bimanual-clamp sequence and original scorer; the extension settings vary the plate (solid disk, rimmed plate, load-sensitive plate) and the body (G1 with Dex3, G1 with Inspire five-finger hands, Stretch 3 with a gripper), accepting any legal strategy including regrasps, table support and controlled hand-overs.

acceptance.zh: 2026-11-02 作者确认 7/7 当前声明参考配置完成：6 个任务族设置（各有完整物理执行、独立回放，以及冻结后三次新运行等 10/10 项自动检查）和原版横向偏移配置。原始与扩展协议、历史失败及正式准入边界分列；人工逐视频签署与第二人复现仍待真实记录，未声称正式准入。全部参考解为固定底座的特权专家，只覆盖声明的名义初态。
acceptance.en: On 2026-11-02 the author confirmed all 7 declared reference configurations as complete: the 6 family settings (each with a full physical execution, independent replay and 10/10 automatic gates including three fresh frozen repeats) plus the original lateral-offset configuration. Original versus extension protocols, historical failures and the formal-admission boundary are kept separate; per-video human sign-off and second-person reproduction still lack real records, and no formal admission is claimed. All references are fixed-base privileged experts covering only the declared nominal starts.

axes.zh: 变体（DF-01 原版流程／DF-02 带沿浅盘抓取适配／DF-03 受力敏感浅盘／DF-04 自主策略）、盘体（P1 实心圆盘／P2 带沿浅盘／P3 受力敏感浅盘）、身体（G／F／S），以及原版圆盘的起始横向位置（名义与偏移 3 mm）。只登记选定组合，不铺满笛卡尔积。
axes.en: Variant (DF-01 original sequence / DF-02 rimmed-plate grasp adaptation / DF-03 load-limited plate / DF-04 open strategy), plate (P1 solid disk / P2 rimmed plate / P3 load-sensitive plate), body (G / F / S), and for the original task the disk start position (nominal versus a 3 mm lateral offset). Only selected combinations are registered, not the full Cartesian product.

embodiments.zh: 固定骨盆 Unitree G1＋双 Dex3 三指手
embodiments.en: Fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with two Dex3 three-finger hands

embodiments.zh: 固定骨盆 G1＋双 Inspire 五指手
embodiments.en: Fixed-pelvis G1 with two Inspire five-finger hands

embodiments.zh: Stretch 3＋SG3 夹爪（固定底座，单臂）
embodiments.en: Stretch 3 with the SG3 gripper (fixed base, single arm)

title.zh: 原版轻柔翻圆盘（名义配置）
title.en: Original gentle disk flip (nominal configuration)

conditions.zh: 原版冻结协议与评分器（Genesis，400 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制）；P1 圆盘起点与目标均为 (0.50, 0) m，固定种子；公开限制：关节目标速度 ≤0.50 rad/s，盘平移 ≤0.12 m/s、转速 ≤0.65 rad/s，机器人对盘接触力之和 ≤18 N、桌面对盘 ≤8 N；时间预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Original frozen protocol and scorer (Genesis, 400 Hz physics, 50 Hz control); P1 disk start and goal at (0.50, 0) m, fixed seed; public limits: joint-target speed ≤0.50 rad/s, disk speed ≤0.12 m/s and ≤0.65 rad/s, summed robot contact force on the disk ≤18 N and table force ≤8 N; time budget 600 s.

design.zh: 固定骨盆 G1 先把橙面朝上的圆盘轻推到近身桌边，使盘沿悬伸 55–95 mm，再用双手夹住两面抬起、翻成蓝面朝上，放回目标区域并完全松手，静止保持 2 秒。抬起和翻面期间必须保持双手夹持并留出 20 mm 桌面净空，不得抛掷、拍打或借桌面撞击翻转。
design.en: The fixed-pelvis G1 gently pushes the orange-up disk to the near table edge until it overhangs by 55–95 mm, clamps both faces with two hands, lifts and turns it blue side up, places it in the goal area and fully releases it for 2 still seconds. A bimanual grasp and 20 mm table clearance must be kept during lift and inversion; throwing, slapping or flipping by striking the table is forbidden.

tools.zh: P1 实心圆盘：直径 200 mm、厚 12 mm、120 g，初始橙面朝上，另一面为蓝色
tools.en: P1 solid disk: 200 mm diameter, 12 mm thick, 120 g, orange face up at the start and blue on the other face

tools.zh: 0.86 m 高桌面：双手翻面后允许换手支撑、把重量交给桌面再推回目标区
tools.en: 0.86 m table: after the bimanual flip the robot may switch support, hand the weight to the table and push the disk back to the goal

embodiment.zh: 固定骨盆 Unitree G1＋双 Dex3 三指手
embodiment.en: Fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with two Dex3 three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功：修订专家 a03 仿真 478.26 s（预算 600 s），5 个高层目标展开为 26 个低层段，独立动作回放通过；冻结队列 cohort-v2 三次新运行与独立回放均通过，10/10 项自动检查通过。早先 cohort-v1 三次执行成功但独立回放失败，保留为未通过。限制：固定骨盆、特权状态专家，只覆盖名义初态。
result.en: Full success: revised expert a03 finished in 478.26 s simulated (budget 600 s), with 5 high-level goals expanded into 26 low-level segments, and its independent action replay passed; the frozen cohort-v2 passed three fresh runs plus independent replay, and all 10 automatic gates passed. The earlier cohort-v1 succeeded three times but failed independent replay and remains recorded as failed. Limits: fixed pelvis, privileged-state expert, nominal start only.

title.zh: 带沿浅盘：三指抓取适配
title.en: Rimmed plate: three-finger grasp adaptation

conditions.zh: 扩展协议（MuJoCo，2,000 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制，官方 G1／Stretch 资产）；盘心起点 (0.40, 0) m（已悬伸 50 mm）、目标 (0.50, 0) m；P2 带沿浅盘；速度与接触力上限同原版，另限机器人自接触与机器人—桌面载荷，失去全部支撑超过 0.10 s 即失败；接受任何满足目标和公开约束的策略；时间预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Extension protocol (MuJoCo, 2,000 Hz physics, 50 Hz control, official G1/Stretch assets); plate centre starts at (0.40, 0) m with 50 mm overhang, goal (0.50, 0) m; P2 rimmed plate; speed and contact-force limits as in the original, plus limits on robot self-contact and robot-table load; losing all support for more than 0.10 s fails; any strategy meeting the goal and public constraints is accepted; time budget 600 s.

design.zh: 盘体换成带薄沿和底部支撑圈的浅盘，平盘的高度与接触判据不再适用。G1＋Dex3 须根据盘沿净空与手指几何选择夹沿、托底或上下夹持，翻面后让倒扣盘稳定支撑在桌面，推入目标区、撤手并稳定保持 2 秒。
design.en: The disk is replaced by a shallow plate with a thin rim and an underside support ring, so flat-disk heights and contact cues no longer apply. The G1 with Dex3 hands must choose rim pinching, underside support or an opposing-face grasp from the rim clearance and finger geometry, rest the inverted plate stably on the table, push it into the goal, release and hold still for 2 s.

tools.zh: P2 带沿浅盘：外径 200 mm、总高 20 mm、120 g；浅凹盘面、薄外沿与底部支撑圈，沿下净空 14 mm
tools.en: P2 rimmed shallow plate: 200 mm diameter, 20 mm total height, 120 g; shallow concavity, thin rim and underside support ring with 14 mm under-rim clearance

tools.zh: 0.86 m 高桌面：明确允许重抓、桌面支撑与受控交接
tools.en: 0.86 m table: regrasping, table support and controlled hand-overs are explicitly allowed

embodiment.zh: 固定骨盆 Unitree G1＋双 Dex3 三指手
embodiment.en: Fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with two Dex3 three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功：a33 仿真 581.22 s（预算 600 s），独立物理回放状态差为零；冻结后三次新运行、紧凑回放、隔离执行与便携执行均通过，10/10 项自动检查通过。专家为固定标称关节参考前缀，再以实测反馈完成支撑交接、食指推盘与撤手；只覆盖声明的名义初态，不是可泛化的闭环策略。
result.en: Full success: a33 finished in 581.22 s simulated (budget 600 s); the independent physics replay shows zero state difference; after freezing, three fresh repeats, compact replay, isolated execution and portable execution all passed (10/10 automatic gates). The expert is a fixed nominal joint-reference prefix followed by measured-feedback support transfer, index-finger pushing and release; it covers only the declared nominal start and is not a generalizing closed-loop policy.

title.zh: 带沿浅盘：五指抓取适配
title.en: Rimmed plate: five-finger grasp adaptation

conditions.zh: 扩展协议（MuJoCo，2,000 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制，官方 G1／Stretch 资产）；盘心起点 (0.40, 0) m（已悬伸 50 mm）、目标 (0.50, 0) m；P2 带沿浅盘，与 DF-02-G 同场景，只更换手及必要的控制映射；速度与接触力上限同原版，另限机器人自接触与机器人—桌面载荷，失去全部支撑超过 0.10 s 即失败；时间预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Extension protocol (MuJoCo, 2,000 Hz physics, 50 Hz control, official G1/Stretch assets); plate centre starts at (0.40, 0) m with 50 mm overhang, goal (0.50, 0) m; P2 rimmed plate in the same world as DF-02-G, changing only the hand and the required control mapping; speed and contact-force limits as in the original, plus limits on robot self-contact and robot-table load; losing all support for more than 0.10 s fails; time budget 600 s.

design.zh: 同一 G1 身体与基座约束下换成 Inspire 五指手，检验抓取策略是否随手型改变；不预设五指更强。目标同 DF-02-G：翻面放回、撤手并稳定保持 2 秒。
design.en: The same G1 body and base constraints with Inspire five-finger hands instead, testing whether the grasp strategy changes with the hand; five fingers are not presumed stronger. The goal matches DF-02-G: flip, place, release and hold still for 2 s.

tools.zh: P2 带沿浅盘：外径 200 mm、总高 20 mm、120 g；浅凹盘面、薄外沿与底部支撑圈，沿下净空 14 mm
tools.en: P2 rimmed shallow plate: 200 mm diameter, 20 mm total height, 120 g; shallow concavity, thin rim and underside support ring with 14 mm under-rim clearance

tools.zh: 0.86 m 高桌面：明确允许重抓、桌面支撑与受控交接
tools.en: 0.86 m table: regrasping, table support and controlled hand-overs are explicitly allowed

embodiment.zh: 固定骨盆 G1＋双 Inspire 五指手
embodiment.en: Fixed-pelvis G1 with two Inspire five-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功：a42 仿真 590.82 s，接近 600 s 预算；独立物理回放状态差为零；冻结后三次新运行、紧凑回放、隔离执行与便携执行均通过，10/10 项自动检查通过。专家双手夹持受控翻面后由左手接管下放，右手食指推倒扣盘的足圈，减速越过桌边后推入目标并撤手。机器人—桌面载荷峰值约 19.8 N，贴近 20 N 上限，不能据此宣称鲁棒裕量。
result.en: Full success: a42 finished in 590.82 s simulated, close to the 600 s budget; the independent physics replay shows zero state difference; after freezing, three fresh repeats, compact replay, isolated execution and portable execution all passed (10/10 automatic gates). After a bimanual controlled flip the left hand takes over and lowers the plate, the right index finger pushes on the inverted foot ring, slowing as the rim crosses the table edge, then pushes it into the goal and releases. Peak robot-table load was about 19.8 N, just under the 20 N limit, so no robustness margin is claimed.

title.zh: 受力敏感浅盘翻面
title.en: Contact-load-limited plate flip

conditions.zh: 扩展协议（MuJoCo，2,000 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制，官方 G1／Stretch 资产）；盘心起点 (0.40, 0) m（已悬伸 50 mm）、目标 (0.50, 0) m；P3 浅盘：每个接触刚体对盘的载荷模长之和 ≤4 N（刚体损伤代理）；速度与接触力上限同原版，另限机器人自接触与机器人—桌面载荷，失去全部支撑超过 0.10 s 即失败；时间预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Extension protocol (MuJoCo, 2,000 Hz physics, 50 Hz control, official G1/Stretch assets); plate centre starts at (0.40, 0) m with 50 mm overhang, goal (0.50, 0) m; P3 plate: the summed load magnitude from each contacting rigid body on the plate must stay ≤4 N (a rigid-body damage proxy); speed and contact-force limits as in the original, plus limits on robot self-contact and robot-table load; losing all support for more than 0.10 s fails; time budget 600 s.

design.zh: 盘体几何同 P2，但局部接触载荷受限。G1＋Dex3 须在抗滑与局部载荷之间选择安全抓法，必要时分担载荷或借助桌面支撑，完成翻面、放回、撤手与 2 秒稳定保持；不能用相互抵消后的合力代替夹持挤压力。
design.en: The plate has P2 geometry but a local contact-load limit. The G1 with Dex3 hands must trade slip resistance against local load, sharing load or using table support where needed, to flip, place, release and hold still for 2 s; squeezing force cannot hide behind a cancelled-out net force.

tools.zh: P3 受力敏感浅盘：几何与质量同 P2，另加局部接触载荷上限（刚体损伤代理，不模拟真实破碎）
tools.en: P3 load-sensitive plate: same geometry and mass as P2 plus a local contact-load limit (a rigid-body damage proxy, not simulated fracture)

tools.zh: 0.86 m 高桌面：明确允许重抓、桌面支撑与受控交接
tools.en: 0.86 m table: regrasping, table support and controlled hand-overs are explicitly allowed

embodiment.zh: 固定骨盆 Unitree G1＋双 Dex3 三指手
embodiment.en: Fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with two Dex3 three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功：a23 仿真 573.56 s（预算 600 s），局部载荷峰值 3.806 N，贴近 4 N 上限；独立物理回放状态差为零；冻结后三次新运行、紧凑回放、隔离执行与便携执行均通过，10/10 项自动检查通过。专家为固定标称参考前缀加在线支撑交接、食指推盘与撤手，只覆盖名义初态，不代表鲁棒裕量。
result.en: Full success: a23 finished in 573.56 s simulated (budget 600 s) with a peak local load of 3.806 N, just under the 4 N cap; the independent physics replay shows zero state difference; after freezing, three fresh repeats, compact replay, isolated execution and portable execution all passed (10/10 automatic gates). The expert is a fixed nominal reference prefix plus online support transfer, index-finger pushing and release, covering only the nominal start with no claimed robustness margin.

title.zh: 自主翻面：双臂配置
title.en: Open-strategy flip: dual-arm configuration

conditions.zh: 扩展协议（MuJoCo，2,000 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制，官方 G1／Stretch 资产）；盘心起点 (0.40, 0) m（已悬伸 50 mm）、目标 (0.50, 0) m；P1 实心圆盘；不强制原版动作顺序；起始站位经验证、执行中基座固定；速度与接触力上限同原版，另限机器人自接触与机器人—桌面载荷，失去全部支撑超过 0.10 s 即失败；时间预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Extension protocol (MuJoCo, 2,000 Hz physics, 50 Hz control, official G1/Stretch assets); plate centre starts at (0.40, 0) m with 50 mm overhang, goal (0.50, 0) m; P1 solid disk; the original action sequence is not required; validated start stance with the base fixed during execution; speed and contact-force limits as in the original, plus limits on robot self-contact and robot-table load; losing all support for more than 0.10 s fails; time budget 600 s.

design.zh: 与原版同一圆盘，但自主选择单手或双手抓持、重抓与支撑交接，不必沿用推边、双手夹持的原顺序；须翻面放回目标区、撤手并稳定保持 2 秒。与 DF-04-S 共用物体、桌面、目标与评分。
design.en: The original disk, but the robot freely chooses one- or two-hand grasps, regrasps and support transfers instead of the original push-and-clamp sequence; it must flip the disk, place it in the goal, release and hold still for 2 s. Object, table, goal and scoring are shared with DF-04-S.

tools.zh: P1 实心圆盘：直径 200 mm、厚 12 mm、120 g，两面平整、质量均匀
tools.en: P1 solid disk: 200 mm diameter, 12 mm thick, 120 g, flat faces and uniform mass

tools.zh: 0.86 m 高桌面：明确允许重抓、桌面支撑与受控交接
tools.en: 0.86 m table: regrasping, table support and controlled hand-overs are explicitly allowed

embodiment.zh: 固定骨盆 Unitree G1＋双 Dex3 三指手
embodiment.en: Fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with two Dex3 three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功：a27 仿真 538.00 s（预算 600 s），撤手后稳定保持超过 12 s；独立物理回放状态差为零；冻结后三次新运行、紧凑回放、隔离执行与便携执行均通过，10/10 项自动检查通过。专家先执行 321.88 s 的固定标称指令前缀，再按实测状态完成转向、桌面共同支撑、食指接触、载荷转移与撤手，不代表随机初态泛化。
result.en: Full success: a27 finished in 538.00 s simulated (budget 600 s) with more than 12 s of stable released goal state; the independent physics replay shows zero state difference; after freezing, three fresh repeats, compact replay, isolated execution and portable execution all passed (10/10 automatic gates). The expert runs a fixed 321.88 s nominal command prefix, then uses measured state for yaw, shared table support, index contact, load transfer and withdrawal; it does not show generalization to random starts.

title.zh: 自主翻面：单臂配置
title.en: Open-strategy flip: single-arm configuration

conditions.zh: 扩展协议（MuJoCo，2,000 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制，官方 G1／Stretch 资产）；盘心起点 (0.40, 0) m（已悬伸 50 mm）、目标 (0.50, 0) m；与 DF-04-G 同一 P1 圆盘、桌面、目标与评分；Stretch 3＋SG3 起始站位经验证、执行中底座固定；速度与接触力上限同原版，另限机器人自接触与机器人—桌面载荷，失去全部支撑超过 0.10 s 即失败；时间预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Extension protocol (MuJoCo, 2,000 Hz physics, 50 Hz control, official G1/Stretch assets); plate centre starts at (0.40, 0) m with 50 mm overhang, goal (0.50, 0) m; same P1 disk, table, goal and scoring as DF-04-G; validated Stretch 3 + SG3 start pose with the base fixed during execution; speed and contact-force limits as in the original, plus limits on robot self-contact and robot-table load; losing all support for more than 0.10 s fails; time budget 600 s.

design.zh: 只有一条手臂与腕部可用，须按单臂能力自行设计完整的翻面与释放策略：夹取、沿桌边滑移、松开重抓、抬起翻面、放回撤手，再把盘推入目标区稳定保持 2 秒。
design.en: With only one arm and wrist, the robot must devise a complete flip-and-release strategy suited to a single arm: grasp, slide along the edge, release and regrasp, lift and flip, place and withdraw, then push the disk into the goal and hold still for 2 s.

tools.zh: P1 实心圆盘：直径 200 mm、厚 12 mm、120 g，两面平整、质量均匀
tools.en: P1 solid disk: 200 mm diameter, 12 mm thick, 120 g, flat faces and uniform mass

tools.zh: 0.86 m 高桌面：明确允许重抓、桌面支撑与受控交接
tools.en: 0.86 m table: regrasping, table support and controlled hand-overs are explicitly allowed

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3＋SG3 夹爪（固定底座，单臂）
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 with the SG3 gripper (fixed base, single arm)

result.zh: 完整成功：a28 仿真 545.00 s（预算 600 s）；独立物理回放状态差为零；冻结后三次新运行、紧凑回放、隔离执行与便携执行均通过，10/10 项自动检查通过。a28 为固定标称前缀加在线末段撤手；另有在线专家 a27（546.06 s）的完整见证与独立回放通过。结果不构成身体性能排名。
result.en: Full success: a28 finished in 545.00 s simulated (budget 600 s); the independent physics replay shows zero state difference; after freezing, three fresh repeats, compact replay, isolated execution and portable execution all passed (10/10 automatic gates). a28 is a fixed nominal prefix plus online terminal withdrawal; a separate fully online expert, a27 (546.06 s), also has a complete witness with a passing independent replay. The results are not a ranking of bodies.

title.zh: 原版轻柔翻圆盘（横向偏移配置）
title.en: Original gentle disk flip (lateral-offset configuration)

conditions.zh: 原版任务发布协议（Genesis，400 Hz 物理、50 Hz 控制）；圆盘起点与目标均为 (0.50, 0.003) m，即比名义配置横向偏移 3 mm，固定种子；公开限制：关节目标速度 ≤0.50 rad/s，盘平移 ≤0.12 m/s、转速 ≤0.65 rad/s，机器人对盘接触力之和 ≤18 N、桌面对盘 ≤8 N；时间预算 600 s。
conditions.en: Original task release protocol (Genesis, 400 Hz physics, 50 Hz control); disk start and goal at (0.50, 0.003) m, a 3 mm lateral offset from nominal, fixed seed; public limits: joint-target speed ≤0.50 rad/s, disk speed ≤0.12 m/s and ≤0.65 rad/s, summed robot contact force on the disk ≤18 N and table force ≤8 N; time budget 600 s.

design.zh: 与 DF-01-G 相同的固定骨盆 G1＋双 Dex3 轻柔翻盘任务，仅圆盘起始横向位置不同。偏移配置比名义配置多一个闭环接触调节段（共 27 个低层段），仍使用原限制；名义与偏移是两个已验证的观测点，不代表连续适用区间。
design.en: The same fixed-pelvis G1 with two Dex3 hands and the same gentle flip as DF-01-G; only the disk start position is shifted sideways. The offset run adds a closed-loop contact-adjustment segment (27 low-level segments in total) under the original limits; nominal and offset are two verified points, not a validated continuous range.

tools.zh: P1 实心圆盘：直径 200 mm、厚 12 mm、120 g，初始橙面朝上，另一面为蓝色
tools.en: P1 solid disk: 200 mm diameter, 12 mm thick, 120 g, orange face up at the start and blue on the other face

tools.zh: 0.86 m 高桌面：双手翻面后允许换手支撑、把重量交给桌面再推回目标区
tools.en: 0.86 m table: after the bimanual flip the robot may switch support, hand the weight to the table and push the disk back to the goal

embodiment.zh: 固定骨盆 Unitree G1＋双 Dex3 三指手
embodiment.en: Fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with two Dex3 three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功：三次新运行均成功，各 478.925 s（预算 600 s），独立动作回放通过；作者签收范围注明这是单独声明的原版偏移配置，名义配置由 DF-01-G 代表。人工录像签审仍为待完成，正式准入为 false。
result.en: Full success: three fresh runs all succeeded in 478.925 s each (budget 600 s), and the independent action replay passed; the sign-off lists this as a separately declared original offset configuration, with nominal represented by DF-01-G. Human video review is still pending and formal admission is false.

summary.zh: 两台固定基座 Panda 机械臂通过末端推垫与圆盘侧面的摩擦接触，把桌面上的自由圆盘转到目标朝向，并在双臂撤离后保持稳定。圆盘始终由桌面支撑，只能靠真实接触转动；考察双臂接触建立、协同推转、卸力换点与稳定释放。正式发布范围是 0.1.0 的两个确定配置。
summary.en: Two fixed-base Panda arms rotate a free disk on a table to a target heading through frictional contact between their pushing pads and the disk's rim, and the disk must stay stable after both arms withdraw. The disk is always table-supported and can only be turned through real contact; the task tests contact establishment, coordinated pushing, unloading and repositioning, and stable release. The released scope is the two exact configurations of version 0.1.0.

acceptance.zh: 作者于 2026-10-27 批准 0.1.0 正式参考发布，范围仅为两个确定配置（nominal_ccw、wrap_cw）及其评分、分层专家、实测轨迹与声明的限制：6/6 次全新运行与 2/2 次独立回放通过。之后的 DR-01–DR-09 九项扩展任务族未获验收（扩展矩阵 11/15 就绪），原始批准不延伸到扩展。第二人独立复现、敌对代码隔离沙箱与随机域泛化仍未验证，正式 benchmark 准入为 false。
acceptance.en: On 2026-10-27 the author approved the formal 0.1.0 reference release, covering only the two exact configurations (nominal_ccw, wrap_cw) with their scoring, hierarchical expert, measured trajectories and declared limits: 6/6 fresh runs and 2/2 independent replays passed. The later nine-task extension family DR-01–DR-09 is not accepted (extension matrix 11/15 ready), and the original approval does not extend to it. Independent second-person reproduction, a hostile-code sandbox and random-domain generalization remain unverified; formal benchmark admission is false.

axes.zh: 两个配置只改变初始朝向、目标朝向与种子：逆时针 +30°，以及跨越 ±180° 边界的顺时针 −30°；圆盘、桌面、机器人、约束与时限完全相同。
axes.en: The two configurations differ only in initial heading, target heading and seed: +30° counter-clockwise, and −30° clockwise across the ±180° boundary; disk, table, robots, constraints and time limit are identical.

embodiments.zh: 两台固定基座 7 自由度 Panda 机械臂，末端为带摩擦的球形推垫
embodiments.en: Two fixed-base 7-DoF Panda arms with frictional spherical pushing pads

title.zh: 标称配置：逆时针转 30°
title.en: Nominal configuration: 30° counter-clockwise

conditions.zh: 0.1.0 指定配置 nominal_ccw：初始朝向 0°，目标 30°（逆时针），固定种子。圆盘直径 200 mm、厚 20 mm、质量 0.2 kg，置于 0.35 m 高的桌面；每臂 7 个绝对关节目标（共 14 维），50 Hz 控制；可用两路 RGB、关节状态与公开目标朝向；时限 120 s；参考专家读取仿真真值。
conditions.en: 0.1.0 configuration nominal_ccw: initial heading 0°, target 30° (counter-clockwise), fixed seed. The disk is 200 mm across, 20 mm thick and 0.2 kg, on a 0.35 m table; each arm takes 7 absolute joint targets (14 in total) at 50 Hz; observations are two RGB cameras, joint states and the public target heading; 120 s limit; the reference expert reads privileged simulator state.

design.zh: 两臂用推垫从圆盘两侧建立接触并协同推转，到位前卸力、撤离、换接触点再推，最后精调、释放并静置 2 秒。圆盘须始终由桌面支撑，不能抬起、翻面、吸附或直接设置位姿；全过程限制圆心漂移、盘速、倾斜与接触力，禁止非预期碰撞。
design.en: The arms make contact on opposite sides of the disk with their pads and push it round together, unloading, withdrawing and repositioning between pushes, then fine-tune, release and let it settle for 2 s. The disk must stay table-supported and may not be lifted, flipped, attached or posed directly; center drift, disk speed, tilt and contact force are limited throughout, and unplanned collisions are forbidden.

embodiment.zh: 两台固定基座 7 自由度 Panda 机械臂，末端为带摩擦的球形推垫
embodiment.en: Two fixed-base 7-DoF Panda arms with frictional spherical pushing pads

result.zh: 成功：3/3 次全新进程均在 43.48 s 完成，终态角度误差 0.979°、圆心误差 0.0074 mm，共 16 段动作、2 次换点；独立动作回放误差为零。固定接触消融 18.52 s 也成功，因此不证明换点必要；单臂对照失败只说明该控制器未完成。
result.en: Success: all 3/3 fresh processes finished at 43.48 s with a final heading error of 0.979° and a center error of 0.0074 mm, using 16 action segments and 2 contact changes; the independent action replay matched with zero error. A fixed-contact ablation also succeeded in 18.52 s, so contact changes are not shown to be necessary; the failed single-arm control only shows that controller did not finish.

title.zh: 跨角度边界：顺时针转 30°
title.en: Wrap-around configuration: 30° clockwise

conditions.zh: 0.1.0 指定配置 wrap_cw：初始朝向 −170°，目标 160°，按最短有符号角差为顺时针 −30°，并跨越 ±180° 边界，固定种子。圆盘直径 200 mm、厚 20 mm、质量 0.2 kg，置于 0.35 m 高的桌面；每臂 7 个绝对关节目标（共 14 维），50 Hz 控制；可用两路 RGB、关节状态与公开目标朝向；时限 120 s；参考专家读取仿真真值。
conditions.en: 0.1.0 configuration wrap_cw: initial heading −170°, target 160°, i.e. a −30° clockwise turn by the shortest signed angle that crosses the ±180° boundary, fixed seed. The disk is 200 mm across, 20 mm thick and 0.2 kg, on a 0.35 m table; each arm takes 7 absolute joint targets (14 in total) at 50 Hz; observations are two RGB cameras, joint states and the public target heading; 120 s limit; the reference expert reads privileged simulator state.

design.zh: 两臂用推垫从圆盘两侧建立接触并协同推转，到位前卸力、撤离、换接触点再推，最后精调、释放并静置 2 秒。圆盘须始终由桌面支撑，不能抬起、翻面、吸附或直接设置位姿；全过程限制圆心漂移、盘速、倾斜与接触力，禁止非预期碰撞。
design.en: The arms make contact on opposite sides of the disk with their pads and push it round together, unloading, withdrawing and repositioning between pushes, then fine-tune, release and let it settle for 2 s. The disk must stay table-supported and may not be lifted, flipped, attached or posed directly; center drift, disk speed, tilt and contact force are limited throughout, and unplanned collisions are forbidden.

embodiment.zh: 两台固定基座 7 自由度 Panda 机械臂，末端为带摩擦的球形推垫
embodiment.en: Two fixed-base 7-DoF Panda arms with frictional spherical pushing pads

result.zh: 成功：3/3 次全新进程均在 43.56 s 完成，终态角度误差 0.972°、圆心误差 0.0114 mm；独立动作回放误差为零。消融对照只在标称配置上运行。
result.en: Success: all 3/3 fresh processes finished at 43.56 s with a final heading error of 0.972° and a center error of 0.0114 mm; the independent action replay matched with zero error. Ablation controls were run only on the nominal configuration.

summary.zh: F1 考察借助工具与接触界面的柔顺性完成无损装配：判断何时施力、何时改变方法、何时停止。三个子任务分别是紧配合零件压入与敲合、经保护垫传力的保护性装配，以及两台机器人协作的框架装配。配合阻力由被动弹簧夹爪与摩擦产生，没有插入马达、抓取焊接或成功即锁定的机关；每项都有橡胶接触锤与刚体金属锤两个版本。
summary.en: F1 tests damage-free assembly that relies on compliance in tools and contact interfaces: deciding when to apply force, when to change method and when to stop. Its three subtasks are press-fit insertion and mallet seating, protected assembly through an intermediate pad, and cooperative frame assembly by two robots. Fit resistance comes from passive spring-loaded jaws and friction, with no insertion motor, grasp weld or success-triggered latch; every task has a rubber-contact and a rigid metal hammer version.

acceptance.zh: 2026-11-02 作者确认当前声明范围 18/18 项参考交付完成（3 个子任务 × L1–L3 × 橡胶／刚体锤），每项均有完整运行、同次录像与独立逐物理步精确回放。范围限定为固定骨盆的仓库三指 G1 与原型接触参数，参考仅为固定种子；不代表自由站立、Dex3／Inspire／Stretch 正式身体对照、真实材料校准、他人独立复现或正式准入。
acceptance.en: On 2026-11-02 the author confirmed all 18 declared reference configurations as complete (3 subtasks × L1–L3 × rubber/rigid hammer); each has a full run, a same-run video and an independent step-by-step exact physics replay. Scope is limited to the repository fixed-pelvis three-finger G1 with prototype contact parameters, fixed seed only; it does not cover free standing, formal Dex3/Inspire/Stretch body comparisons, real material calibration, independent reproduction by another person or formal admission.

axes.zh: 子任务（F1-01 压入敲合／F1-02 隔垫传力／F1-03 协作框架）× 难度 L1–L3 × 锤头接触（橡胶／刚体）。两种锤的几何、质量、工件、机器人与种子相同，只改锤头接触参数和颜色；难度逐级增加连接数、工具与支撑选择，以及拔出返工、垫块恢复和换支撑。F1-03 使用两台机器人。
axes.en: Subtask (F1-01 insertion / F1-02 pad-protected / F1-03 cooperative frame) × level L1–L3 × hammer-head contact (rubber / rigid). F1-03 uses two robots.

title.zh: 紧配合零件压入与敲合 · L1 · 橡胶锤
title.en: Press-fit insertion and mallet seating · L1 · rubber hammer

conditions.zh: L1 基础执行；橡胶接触锤（与对照版本同几何、同质量，只改锤头接触参数与颜色）；单台机器人；1 处连接；须使用提供的锤并实际轻敲；固定种子；时间预算 120 s。
conditions.en: L1 basic execution; rubber-contact hammer (same geometry and mass as its paired variant, only head contact parameters and colour differ); one robot; 1 connection; the supplied hammer must be used with a measured light tap; fixed seed; time budget 120 s.

design.zh: 桌上一个已对准、半插入的销钉零件，由被动弹簧夹爪和摩擦形成紧配合。机器人须真实抓起提供的锤、实际轻敲使零件到位，到位后停止施力并撤手，零件须稳定保持 2 秒。
design.en: An aligned, partially inserted pin part sits in an interference fit formed by passive spring-loaded jaws and friction. The robot must actually grasp the supplied hammer and lightly tap the part home, stop forcing once it is seated and release; the part must then stay stable for 2 s.

tools.zh: 橡胶接触锤：锤头 0.30 kg＋锤柄 0.10 kg 的单一刚体，锤头采用较软的接触参数（柔顺接触近似，不模拟橡胶实体变形）
tools.en: Rubber-contact hammer: one rigid body with a 0.30 kg head and 0.10 kg handle; the head uses softer contact settings (a compliant-contact approximation, not simulated rubber deformation)

embodiment.zh: 单台固定骨盆 Unitree G1，仓库三指 MJCF 手
embodiment.en: One fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with the repository three-finger MJCF hands

result.zh: 完整成功（得分 1.0），仿真 48.9 s（预算 120 s），连接到位并撤手稳定 2 秒；同次录像与独立逐物理步回放完全一致。参考解抓锤对零件实际轻敲，再以手掌渐进压合到位并卸载撤手。仅固定种子、固定骨盆与原型接触参数，非他人独立复现。
result.en: Full success (score 1.0) in 48.9 s simulated (budget 120 s): the connection seated and stable for 2 s after release; the same-run video and an independent step-by-step physics replay match exactly. The reference grasps the hammer and lightly taps the part, then finishes seating with gradual palm pressure, unloads and releases. Fixed seed only, fixed pelvis and prototype contact parameters, not an independent reproduction.

title.zh: 紧配合零件压入与敲合 · L2 · 橡胶锤
title.en: Press-fit insertion and mallet seating · L2 · rubber hammer

conditions.zh: L2 自适应选择；橡胶接触锤（与对照版本同几何、同质量，只改锤头接触参数与颜色）；单台机器人；2 处连接；接受任何物理上有效的方法；固定种子；时间预算 240 s。
conditions.en: L2 adaptive choice; rubber-contact hammer (same geometry and mass as its paired variant, only head contact parameters and colour differ); one robot; 2 connections; any physically valid method is accepted; fixed seed; time budget 240 s.

design.zh: 两个零件的被动配合阻力不同，都须压入到位。可以手压、用锤或部署压具，机器人须按阻力调整方法与力度，全部到位后撤手。
design.en: Two parts with different passive fit resistance must both be seated. Hand pressure, the hammer or the press may be used; the robot must adapt method and force to the resistance and release once all connections are seated.

tools.zh: 橡胶接触锤：锤头 0.30 kg＋锤柄 0.10 kg 的单一刚体，锤头采用较软的接触参数（柔顺接触近似，不模拟橡胶实体变形）
tools.en: Rubber-contact hammer: one rigid body with a 0.30 kg head and 0.10 kg handle; the head uses softer contact settings (a compliant-contact approximation, not simulated rubber deformation)

tools.zh: 被动压具：可移动的反力框与被动压杆，只能靠实际接触驱动
tools.en: Passive press: a movable reaction frame with a passive plunger that can only be driven by physical contact

embodiment.zh: 单台固定骨盆 Unitree G1，仓库三指 MJCF 手
embodiment.en: One fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with the repository three-finger MJCF hands

result.zh: 完整成功（得分 1.0），仿真 147.8 s（预算 240 s），2 处连接全部到位并撤手稳定 2 秒；同次录像与独立逐物理步回放完全一致。参考解用锤依次敲合两个零件，再以手掌压合收尾并撤手。仅固定种子、固定骨盆与原型接触参数，非他人独立复现。
result.en: Full success (score 1.0) in 147.8 s simulated (budget 240 s): both connections seated and stable for 2 s after release; the same-run video and an independent step-by-step physics replay match exactly. The reference hammers both parts in turn, finishes with palm pressure and releases. Fixed seed only, fixed pelvis and prototype contact parameters, not an independent reproduction.

title.zh: 紧配合零件压入与敲合 · L3 · 橡胶锤
title.en: Press-fit insertion and mallet seating · L3 · rubber hammer

conditions.zh: L3 长程执行与恢复；橡胶接触锤（与对照版本同几何、同质量，只改锤头接触参数与颜色）；单台机器人；2 处连接；接受任何物理上有效的方法；固定种子；时间预算 420 s。
conditions.en: L3 long-horizon execution and recovery; rubber-contact hammer (same geometry and mass as its paired variant, only head contact parameters and colour differ); one robot; 2 connections; any physically valid method is accepted; fixed seed; time budget 420 s.

design.zh: 两处连接，其中一个零件初始错位插入。机器人须先实际拔出错位零件、重新对准装回，再完成两处压入并撤手；到位后继续敲击仍受冲量限制。
design.en: Two connections, one part starts misaligned. The robot must physically extract it, realign and reinsert it, then seat both parts and release; further strikes after seating remain impulse-limited.

tools.zh: 橡胶接触锤：锤头 0.30 kg＋锤柄 0.10 kg 的单一刚体，锤头采用较软的接触参数（柔顺接触近似，不模拟橡胶实体变形）
tools.en: Rubber-contact hammer: one rigid body with a 0.30 kg head and 0.10 kg handle; the head uses softer contact settings (a compliant-contact approximation, not simulated rubber deformation)

tools.zh: 被动压具：可移动的反力框与被动压杆，只能靠实际接触驱动
tools.en: Passive press: a movable reaction frame with a passive plunger that can only be driven by physical contact

embodiment.zh: 单台固定骨盆 Unitree G1，仓库三指 MJCF 手
embodiment.en: One fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with the repository three-finger MJCF hands

result.zh: 完整成功（得分 1.0），仿真 186.4 s（预算 420 s），2 处连接全部到位并撤手稳定 2 秒；同次录像与独立逐物理步回放完全一致。参考解先抓住错位零件拔出、重新对准装回，再用锤敲合两处并以手掌压合收尾。仅固定种子、固定骨盆与原型接触参数，非他人独立复现。
result.en: Full success (score 1.0) in 186.4 s simulated (budget 420 s): both connections seated and stable for 2 s after release; the same-run video and an independent step-by-step physics replay match exactly. The reference first grasps and extracts the misaligned part, realigns and reinserts it, then hammers both connections and finishes with palm pressure. Fixed seed only, fixed pelvis and prototype contact parameters, not an independent reproduction.

title.zh: 隔垫传力与保护性装配 · L1 · 橡胶锤
title.en: Protected assembly through an intermediate pad · L1 · rubber hammer

conditions.zh: L1 基础执行；橡胶接触锤（与对照版本同几何、同质量，只改锤头接触参数与颜色）；单台机器人；1 处连接；须使用提供的锤与预置软垫；固定种子；时间预算 120 s。
conditions.en: L1 basic execution; rubber-contact hammer (same geometry and mass as its paired variant, only head contact parameters and colour differ); one robot; 1 connection; the supplied hammer and preplaced pad must be used; fixed seed; time budget 120 s.

design.zh: 零件顶面是受保护的敏感表面，上方已预置一块软垫。机器人须抓锤隔着垫块传力完成压入，再取走垫块与工具并撤手，敏感面须满足载荷约束。
design.en: The top face of the part is a protected, load-sensitive surface with a soft pad already on it. The robot must seat the part by striking through the pad, then remove pad and tool and release while the sensitive face stays within its load limit.

tools.zh: 橡胶接触锤：锤头 0.30 kg＋锤柄 0.10 kg 的单一刚体，锤头采用较软的接触参数（柔顺接触近似，不模拟橡胶实体变形）

tools.zh: 已预置在零件上的软垫
tools.en: Soft pad already placed on the part

embodiment.en: One fixed-pelvis Unitree G1 with the repository three-finger MJCF hands

The reference taps through the preplaced soft pad, stops on seating feedback and then removes the pad. Fixed seed only, fixed pelvis and prototype contact parameters, not an independent reproduction.

title.zh: 协作框架敲合装配 · L1 · 橡胶锤

conditions.zh: L1 基础执行；橡胶接触锤（与对照版本同几何、同质量，只改锤头接触参数与颜色）；两台机器人；2 处连接；须使用提供的锤并实际轻敲；固定种子；时间预算 120 s。
conditions.en: L1 basic execution; rubber-contact hammer (same geometry and mass as its paired variant, only head contact parameters and colour differ); two robots; 2 connections; the supplied hammer must be used with a measured light tap; fixed seed; time budget 120 s.

design.en: Two fixed-pelvis G1s face two table-supported side frames with the crossbar pre-inserted above both sockets. One robot must physically support the crossbar while the other seats both pin joints; temporary support is then removed and the frame must stand on its own and pass the publicly declared short downward load test.

tools.zh: 橡胶接触锤：锤头 0.30 kg＋锤柄 0.10 kg 的单一刚体，锤头采用较软的接触参数（柔顺接触近似，不模拟橡胶实体变形）
tools.en: Rubber-contact hammer: one rigid body with a 0.30 kg head and 0.10 kg handle; the head uses softer contact settings (a compliant-contact approximation, not simulated rubber deformation)

tools.zh: 伙伴 G1：可实际接触扶持横梁
tools.en: Partner G1 that can physically support the crossbar

tools.zh: 可移动的临时支架（可代替伙伴扶持）
tools.en: Movable temporary cradle (an alternative to partner support)

embodiment.zh: 两台独立控制的固定骨盆 G1（三指手）
embodiment.en: Two independently actuated fixed-pelvis G1s with three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功（得分 1.0），仿真 82.1 s（预算 120 s），2 处连接全部到位并撤手稳定 2 秒，框架通过公开短时承载测试；同次录像与独立逐物理步回放完全一致。参考解由伙伴 G1 从上方扶住横梁，另一台轻敲并以手掌压合两处销接，伙伴随后卸载撤手。仅固定种子、固定骨盆与原型接触参数，非他人独立复现。
result.en: Full success (score 1.0) in 82.1 s simulated (budget 120 s): both connections seated and stable for 2 s after release, and the frame passed the declared load test; the same-run video and an independent step-by-step physics replay match exactly. In the reference the partner G1 holds the crossbar from above while the other robot taps and palm-presses both pin joints; the partner then unloads and withdraws.
