tools.zh: 被动压具：可移动的反力框与被动压杆，只能靠实际接触驱动
tools.en: Passive press: a movable reaction frame with a passive plunger that can only be driven by physical contact

embodiment.zh: 两台独立控制的固定骨盆 G1（三指手）
embodiment.en: Two independently actuated fixed-pelvis G1s with three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功（得分 1.0），仿真 345.4 s（预算 420 s），4 处连接全部到位并撤手稳定 2 秒，框架通过公开短时承载测试；同次录像与独立逐物理步回放完全一致。参考解依次装配两根横梁，伙伴在两根横梁之间切换支撑，并把第二根横梁实测拔出后重新装回。仅固定种子、固定骨盆与原型接触参数，非他人独立复现。
result.en: Full success (score 1.0) in 345.4 s simulated (budget 420 s): all 4 connections seated and stable for 2 s after release, and the frame passed the declared load test; the same-run video and an independent step-by-step physics replay match exactly. The reference assembles both crossbars, the partner switches support between them, and the second crossbar is measurably extracted and reinstalled. Fixed seed only, fixed pelvis and prototype contact parameters, not an independent reproduction.

title.zh: 协作框架敲合装配 · L3 · 刚体锤
title.en: Cooperative frame seating and assembly · L3 · rigid hammer

conditions.zh: L3 长程执行与恢复；刚体金属锤（与对照版本同几何、同质量，只改锤头接触参数与颜色）；两台机器人；4 处连接；接受任何物理上有效的方法；固定种子；时间预算 420 s。
conditions.en: L3 long-horizon execution and recovery; rigid metal hammer (same geometry and mass as its paired variant, only head contact parameters and colour differ); two robots; 4 connections; any physically valid method is accepted; fixed seed; time budget 420 s.

design.zh: 两根横梁、四处连接。装配中须切换支撑，并对横梁实际拆出后重新装回；拆装与换支撑按实测轨迹判定，只记录阶段名称不能通过。最后撤掉全部支撑与工具，框架通过承载测试。
design.en: Two crossbars and four connections. Support must be switched during assembly and a crossbar must actually be extracted and reinstalled; extraction and support changes are judged from the measured trajectory, not from phase labels. Finally all supports and tools are removed and the frame must pass the load test.

tools.zh: 刚体金属锤：与橡胶锤几何、质量相同，锤头为硬接触参数
tools.en: Rigid metal hammer: same geometry and mass as the rubber hammer, with hard head contact settings

tools.zh: 伙伴 G1：可实际接触扶持横梁
tools.en: Partner G1 that can physically support the crossbar

tools.zh: 可移动的临时支架（可代替伙伴扶持）
tools.en: Movable temporary cradle (an alternative to partner support)

tools.zh: 被动压具：可移动的反力框与被动压杆，只能靠实际接触驱动
tools.en: Passive press: a movable reaction frame with a passive plunger that can only be driven by physical contact

embodiment.zh: 两台独立控制的固定骨盆 G1（三指手）
embodiment.en: Two independently actuated fixed-pelvis G1s with three-finger hands

result.zh: 完整成功（得分 1.0），仿真 378.2 s（预算 420 s），4 处连接全部到位并撤手稳定 2 秒，框架通过公开短时承载测试；同次录像与独立逐物理步回放完全一致。参考解依次装配两根横梁，伙伴在两根横梁之间切换支撑，并把第二根横梁实测拔出后重新装回。仅固定种子、固定骨盆与原型接触参数，非他人独立复现。
result.en: Full success (score 1.0) in 378.2 s simulated (budget 420 s): all 4 connections seated and stable for 2 s after release, and the frame passed the declared load test; the same-run video and an independent step-by-step physics replay match exactly. The reference assembles both crossbars, the partner switches support between them, and the second crossbar is measurably extracted and reinstalled. Fixed seed only, fixed pelvis and prototype contact parameters, not an independent reproduction.

name.zh: 易碎烧瓶搬运：按身体选工具与能力自建模
name.en: Fragile flask transport: body-specific tool choice and self-modeling

summary.zh: 把三只易碎烧瓶从桌 A 完好送到桌 B 标记区，松手后由桌 B 直接支撑并稳定；不给流程、不指定工具。同一目标与工具库（T1 运输盒、T2 防震套、T3 推车、T4 车载托架、T5 领圈）下，G1＋Dex3（固定或行走）、G1＋Inspire 五指手、Galaxea R1 与 Stretch 3 需按自身能力选择直接搬运或工具。L1 能力全公开，L2 工具相容性不公开，L3 隐藏部分物理量并提供试验瓶，另有两个全路线不可行的退出对照。
summary.en: Deliver three fragile flasks intact from table A to the marked area on table B, released and stable with table B supporting them; no procedure or tool is prescribed. With the same goal and tool library (T1 carrier, T2 sleeve, T3 cart, T4 base racks, T5 collar), G1 + Dex3 (fixed or walking), G1 + Inspire five-finger hands, Galaxea R1 and Stretch 3 must choose direct carrying or tools according to their own abilities. L1 discloses everything, L2 hides tool compatibility, L3 hides physical quantities and supplies a test flask, and two controls are infeasible on every route and require exiting.

acceptance.zh: 18/18 项按当前授权修订目标签收，包括 0.1.0 原版（2026-10-27 批准发布）和两项正确退出对照。其中 B.G、L3-3.S 为整批预装运输，C.S 为分段计时，L3-1.G 为调整布局并改用共轴 T5，L3-4.G 只是推车探测与安全返回子任务，不是原始三瓶运输；这些原目标（逐瓶装载与时间预算区分、L3-3“名义破损／慢速完好”前提、L3-4 运到 B）仍未确立。全部为读取真值的专家参考，正式 benchmark 准入仍为 false。
acceptance.en: All 18/18 cases are signed off against their currently authorized revised targets, including the 0.1.0 original (release approved 2026-10-27) and the two correct-exit controls. B.G and L3-3.S are prepacked shipments, C.S uses a phase budget, L3-1.G uses a revised layout with a coaxial T5, and L3-4.G is only a cart-probe and safe-return component, not the original three-flask transport; those original goals (per-flask loading with time-budget separation, the L3-3 nominal-break/slow-success premise, L3-4 delivery to B) remain unestablished. All are privileged expert references, and formal benchmark admission remains false.

axes.zh: 身体（G 固定／行走、F、W、S）；难度层 L1–L3（能力卡与工具相容性公开程度；隐藏物理量：湿滑瓶面、老化缓冲座、推车能否越槛）；路线场景（短程平地、约 4–8 m 带 90° 转弯和 4 mm 地缝的长程、台阶平台不可达）；在场工具组合与公开时间预算。
axes.en: Body (G fixed/walking, F, W, S); difficulty layer L1–L3 (how much of the capability card and tool compatibility is public; hidden quantities: wet flask surface, aged cushion seats, cart passability over a threshold); route scenario (short flat route, a roughly 4–8 m route with a 90° turn and a 4 mm seam, unreachable step platform); which tools are present and the public time budget.

embodiments.zh: G1＋Dex3（固定骨盆：ORIG、A.G、L3-1.G；可行走：B.G、L3-4.G）
embodiments.en: G1 + Dex3 (fixed pelvis for ORIG, A.G and L3-1.G; walking for B.G and L3-4.G)

embodiments.zh: G1＋Inspire DFQ 五指手（固定骨盆）
embodiments.en: G1 + Inspire DFQ five-finger hands (fixed pelvis)

embodiments.zh: Galaxea R1 v2.1 轮式双臂
embodiments.en: Galaxea R1 v2.1 wheeled dual-arm robot

embodiments.zh: Stretch 3（移动底盘＋单伸缩臂）
embodiments.en: Stretch 3 (mobile base with one telescoping arm)

title.zh: 原版：固定骨盆 G1 运输三瓶
title.en: Original: fixed-pelvis G1 three-flask transport

conditions.zh: L1 基础层，冻结的 0.1.0 原版；固定骨盆 G1＋Dex3；两桌各 0.62×0.50×0.74 m、间隙 0.12 m，三只 0.12 kg 原版烧瓶（无颈环）；只提供 T1；能力公开；沿用 0.1.0 损伤规则；预算 900 s。
conditions.en: L1 baseline, the frozen 0.1.0 original; fixed-pelvis G1 + Dex3; two 0.62×0.50×0.74 m tables with a 0.12 m gap and three 0.12 kg original flasks (no neck ring); only T1 is provided; capabilities public; 0.1.0 damage rule; 900 s budget.

design.zh: 把三只烧瓶从桌 A 完好送到桌 B 标记区：离开盒子、由桌 B 直接支撑、松手后稳定 2 秒；装箱可选，本身不计分。参考专家先把运输盒搬近、装入三瓶、双手抓把手搬运，放稳后逐个卸货并松手。
design.en: Deliver all three flasks intact from table A to the marked area on table B: out of the carrier, directly supported by table B and stable for 2 s after release; packing is optional and earns nothing by itself. The reference expert pulls the carrier closer, loads the flasks, carries it by both handles, sets it down and unloads the flasks one by one.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒：三座、双侧开放把手、0.425 kg
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier: three seats, two open handles, 0.425 kg

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3，固定骨盆
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3, fixed pelvis

result.zh: 成功：0.1.0 发布验证中三瓶全新运行 3/3（552.11–567.04 s）、单瓶 1/1、独立动作回放 2/2 全部通过，2026-10-27 获作者批准正式发布。见证录像为 multi-1（552.11 s）的独立动作回放；这是读取真值的设计者参考，随机场景成功率与隔离沙盒未验证。
result.en: Success: the 0.1.0 release validation passed three fresh three-flask runs 3/3 (552.11–567.04 s), a single-flask run 1/1 and independent action replays 2/2, and the author approved the formal release on 2026-10-27. The witness video is the independent action replay of multi-1 (552.11 s); this is a privileged designer reference, and randomized success rates and an isolated sandbox are not verified.

title.zh: 换五指手：Inspire 直接逐瓶搬运
title.en: Five-finger hand: Inspire direct per-flask transfer

conditions.zh: L1；固定骨盆 G1＋Inspire DFQ 五指手；与 ORIG 同一世界与道具，烧瓶换为带 27 mm 颈环的扩展瓶；能力与工具规格全部公开；FT v0.2 压碎／冲击损伤规则；时限 900 s。
conditions.en: L1; fixed-pelvis G1 + Inspire DFQ five-finger hands; same world and props as ORIG, with the extension flask that has a 27 mm neck ring; capabilities and tool specs fully public; FT v0.2 crush/impact damage rule; 900 s limit.

design.zh: 只换末端，考察五指手的抓取方式与握力控制。参考解不用工具：右手五指包握瓶颈、拇指与食指勾在颈环下方，抬起后转腰越过运输盒，逐瓶放入桌 B 目标区并松手。
design.en: Only the end effector changes, testing the five-finger grasp choice and grip-force control. The reference uses no tool: the right hand wraps the neck with five fingers, thumb and index hooked under the ring, lifts, sweeps the waist over the carrier and places each flask in the table-B target before releasing.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（在场，参考解未使用）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (present, unused by the reference)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Inspire DFQ 五指手，固定骨盆
embodiment.en: G1 + Inspire DFQ five-finger hands, fixed pelvis

result.zh: 成功：一次 169.16 s 的连续运行中，153.8 s 时三瓶完好、直立、在目标区内由桌 B 支撑并稳定。仅一次见证；Inspire 能否用 T1 把手搬运未由此证明。
result.en: Success: in one continuous 169.16 s run, all three flasks were intact, upright, inside the target, supported by table B and stable at 153.8 s. Single witness only; it does not establish that the Inspire hand can carry T1 by its handles.

title.zh: R1 轮式双臂短距转运
title.en: R1 wheeled dual-arm short transfer

conditions.zh: L1；Galaxea R1 轮式双臂；两桌相距 1.5 m、平地；只有 T1 可见；能力与工具公开；FT v0.2 损伤规则；时限 900 s。
conditions.en: L1; Galaxea R1 wheeled dual-arm robot; tables 1.5 m apart on flat floor; only T1 visible; capabilities and tools public; FT v0.2 damage rule; 900 s limit.

design.zh: 考察底盘移动中保持载荷稳定，双臂持 T1 或逐瓶搬运均合法。参考解不用 T1：两臂分别在颈环下方侧向夹瓶，分两趟直接运送三瓶。
design.en: Tests keeping the load steady while the base moves; carrying T1 with both arms or moving flasks individually are both legal. The reference skips T1: each arm side-grasps a flask under its neck ring, delivering the three flasks directly in two trips.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（在场，参考解未使用）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (present, unused by the reference)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 v2.1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 v2.1 wheeled dual-arm robot

result.zh: 成功：387.87 s 时三瓶全部交付并稳定，一直保持到记录结束（401.6 s）；无跌倒。
result.en: Success: all three flasks were delivered and stable at 387.87 s and stayed so until the recording ended (401.6 s); no fall.

title.zh: Stretch 单臂逐瓶转运
title.en: Stretch single-arm per-flask transfer

conditions.zh: L1；Stretch 3 单伸缩臂；两桌之间 1.5 m 通道；T1、三个 T2 与 T4-S 可见，能力卡写明单臂；FT v0.2 损伤规则；时限 420 s。
conditions.en: L1; Stretch 3 with one telescoping arm; a 1.5 m lane between the tables; T1, three T2 and T4-S visible, and the capability card states a single arm; FT v0.2 damage rule; 420 s limit.

design.zh: 考察单臂下的任务分解：逐瓶搬运、装 T2 分批或先装 T4-S 统一转运均可。参考解逐瓶夹住瓶颈、沿通道运到桌 B 目标槽，工具均未使用。
design.en: Tests task decomposition with one arm: per-flask carries, batches in T2 or loading T4-S for one trip are all allowed. The reference pinches each flask by the neck and drives it along the lane to its table-B slot, using no tool.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（在场，参考解未使用）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (present, unused by the reference)

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3 单伸缩臂
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 single telescoping arm

result.zh: 成功：三瓶全部放入目标区，自 161.6 s 起稳定满 2 s，记录共 168.22 s。
result.en: Success: all three flasks placed in the target and stable for 2 s from 161.6 s; recording length 168.22 s.

title.zh: 平坦短程·固定骨盆 G1（工具发现）
title.en: Flat short route, fixed-pelvis G1 (tool discovery)

conditions.zh: L2-A；固定骨盆 G1＋Dex3；沿用 ORIG 布局，扩展瓶；T1、T2、T3、T4-W、T4-S、T5 全部在场，几何与接口公开、相容性不公开；FT v0.2 损伤规则；时限 900 s。
conditions.en: L2-A; fixed-pelvis G1 + Dex3; ORIG layout with extension flasks; T1, T2, T3, T4-W, T4-S and T5 all present, with geometry and interfaces public but compatibility undisclosed; FT v0.2 damage rule; 900 s limit.

design.zh: 判断直接搬运是否优于装箱，即不滥用工具。固定骨盆单臂够不到从桌 A 到目标区的整段路程，参考解不用工具而在桌 B 中转：右手送到中转点、左手再放入目标区，共六次颈部抓取。
design.en: Tests whether direct carrying beats packing, i.e. not overusing tools. One arm of the fixed-pelvis G1 cannot reach the whole way from table A to the target, so the tool-free reference relays on table B: the right hand stages each flask and the left hand places it in the target, six neck grasps in total.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（未使用）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (unused)

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve

tools.zh: T3 推车
tools.en: T3 cart

tools.zh: T4-W 车载托架（R1 接口）
tools.en: T4-W base rack (R1 interface)

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

tools.zh: T5 马蹄形领圈：从颈环下方托起烧瓶
tools.en: T5 horseshoe collar: lifts a flask under its neck ring

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3，固定骨盆
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3, fixed pelvis

result.zh: 成功：448.45 s 时三瓶经右手中转、左手交付，全部完好并稳定在目标区；左手每次回到预抓姿态都靠关节运动完成，没有状态重置。
result.en: Success: at 448.45 s all three flasks, relayed right hand to left hand, were intact and stable in the target; every return of the left hand to its pre-grasp pose was done by joint motion, with no state reset.

title.zh: 平坦短程·Stretch（工具发现）
title.en: Flat short route, Stretch (tool discovery)

conditions.zh: L2-A；Stretch 3；两桌间距按单次转身可达标定；T1、三个 T2、T4-S、T4-W、T3、T5 全部在场，相容性不公开；FT v0.2 损伤规则；时限 360 s。
conditions.en: L2-A; Stretch 3; table spacing calibrated so one turn reaches both; T1, three T2, T4-S, T4-W, T3 and T5 all present with compatibility undisclosed; FT v0.2 damage rule; 360 s limit.

design.zh: 同样考察是否需要工具。参考解每次夹住一只瓶颈，原地转 180° 直接放入桌 B 目标槽，再转回取下一瓶。
design.en: Again tests whether a tool is needed. The reference pinches one flask neck at a time, turns 180° in place, places it directly in its table-B slot and turns back for the next.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（未使用）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (unused)

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

tools.zh: T4-W 车载托架（R1 接口）
tools.en: T4-W base rack (R1 interface)

tools.zh: T3 推车
tools.en: T3 cart

tools.zh: T5 马蹄形领圈：从颈环下方托起烧瓶
tools.en: T5 horseshoe collar: lifts a flask under its neck ring

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3 单伸缩臂
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 single telescoping arm

result.zh: 成功：三瓶全部交付，自 140.4 s 起稳定满 2 s，记录共 155.46 s。
result.en: Success: all three flasks delivered and stable for 2 s from 140.4 s; recording length 155.46 s.

title.zh: 长程转运·行走 G1（整批预装修订版）
title.en: Long route, walking G1 (prepacked-shipment revision)

conditions.zh: L2-B；可行走 G1＋Dex3（GR00T 下肢控制）；带 90° 转弯和 4 mm 地缝的 L 形路线；作者授权修订：三瓶初始已装在 T1 座内，全程整托运输，总上限 600 s，取代原逐瓶装卸与时间预算区分要求；其余工具在场。
conditions.en: L2-B; walking G1 + Dex3 (GR00T leg control); an L-shaped route with a 90° turn and a 4 mm floor seam; author-approved revision: the three flasks start seated in T1 and travel as one packed shipment, with a 600 s cap, replacing the original per-flask loading and time-budget separation; the other tools are present.

design.zh: 双手抓 T1 把手走完全程，把整个运输盒放进桌 B 标记区并松手：盒体由桌 B 直接支撑，三瓶完好、直立地留在座内并稳定 2 秒。修订版 T1 改用短金属立柱把手，原瓶、座位弹簧阻尼与损伤阈值不变。
design.en: Carry T1 by both handles along the whole route, set the entire carrier inside the table-B marked area and release it: the carrier rests directly on table B and the three flasks stay intact and upright in their seats, stable for 2 s. The revised T1 uses short metal post handles; flasks, seat springs/dampers and damage thresholds are unchanged.

tools.zh: T1 运输盒（预装三瓶，短金属立柱把手）
tools.en: T1 carrier (prepacked with three flasks, short metal post handles)

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

tools.zh: T3 推车
tools.en: T3 cart

tools.zh: T4-W 车载托架（R1 接口）
tools.en: T4-W base rack (R1 interface)

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3，可行走
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3, walking

result.zh: 成功（修订目标）：143.9 s 走完全程并越过地缝，整个运输盒在原 B 标记区内松手、直接支撑并稳定 2 s，三瓶完整直立。原“从桌 A 装瓶并以时间预算区分工具路线”的目标仍未确立。
result.en: Success (revised goal): at 143.9 s, after the full route and the seam, the whole carrier was released inside the original table-B marker, directly supported and stable for 2 s, with all three flasks intact and upright. The original goal of loading from table A with a time budget that separates tool routes remains unestablished.

title.zh: 长程转运·R1（T1 双臂搬运）
title.en: Long route, R1 (two-arm T1 carry)

conditions.zh: L2-B；Galaxea R1；带 90° 转弯和 4 mm 地缝的长路线；T1、T2、T4-W、T3、T5 在场，相容性不公开；运行前冻结的公开时间预算 560 s，使逐瓶往返放不进预算；FT v0.2 损伤规则。
conditions.en: L2-B; Galaxea R1; a long route with a 90° turn and a 4 mm floor seam; T1, T2, T4-W, T3 and T5 present with compatibility undisclosed; a public 560 s time budget frozen before the run so that per-flask round trips do not fit; FT v0.2 damage rule.

design.zh: 把路线风险与时间约束对应到自己的运输方式，而不是固定用某个工具。参考解把三瓶装入 T1，双臂抬盒越过地缝和转弯，放到桌 B 旁后逐瓶卸到目标区。
design.en: Map route risk and the time limit onto a transport method instead of defaulting to one tool. The reference loads the three flasks into T1, carries it with both arms over the seam and around the turn, sets it beside table B and unloads each flask into the target.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒：三座、双侧开放把手
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier: three seats, two open handles

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve

tools.zh: T4-W 车载托架（R1 接口）
tools.en: T4-W base rack (R1 interface)

tools.zh: T3 推车
tools.en: T3 cart

tools.zh: T5 马蹄形领圈：从颈环下方托起烧瓶
tools.en: T5 horseshoe collar: lifts a flask under its neck ring

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 v2.1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 v2.1 wheeled dual-arm robot

result.zh: 成功：437.935 s 时三瓶完好、直立、松手并稳定在桌 B，在 560 s 预算内；实测逐瓶手持基线需 662.70 s。时间比较只针对所声明的控制器。
result.en: Success: at 437.935 s all three flasks were intact, upright, released and stable on table B, within the 560 s budget; the measured per-flask hand baseline takes 662.70 s. The timing comparison concerns the declared controllers only.

title.zh: 长程转运·Stretch（托架加手持一趟运完）
title.en: Long route, Stretch (rack plus hand carry in one trip)

conditions.zh: L2-B；Stretch 3；8 m 路线含 90° 转弯和 4 mm 地缝；T1、三个 T2、T4-S 在场；运行前冻结的公开时间预算 240 s，逐瓶往返放不进预算；FT v0.2 损伤规则。
conditions.en: L2-B; Stretch 3; an 8 m route with a 90° turn and a 4 mm floor seam; T1, three T2 and T4-S present; a public 240 s budget frozen before the run, which per-flask round trips cannot meet; FT v0.2 damage rule.

design.zh: 单臂身体须选择一趟运完的方式。参考解把两只瓶放入 T4-S 托架内侧和中间座位、第三只手持，一趟驶过地缝与转弯，先放下手中一瓶，再从托架逐个卸到目标区。
design.en: A one-armed body must find a one-trip method. The reference seats two flasks in the inner and middle T4-S rack seats and holds the third, drives once over the seam and around the turn, places the held flask, then unloads the other two from the rack into the target.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒：三座、双侧开放把手
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier: three seats, two open handles

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3 单伸缩臂
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 single telescoping arm

result.zh: 成功：208.49 s 时三瓶完好、由桌 B 直接支撑、松手并稳定，在 240 s 预算内；最快逐瓶手持基线为 283.34 s。
result.en: Success: at 208.49 s all three flasks were intact, directly supported by table B, released and stable, within the 240 s budget; the fastest per-flask hand baseline is 283.34 s.

title.zh: 托架接口不匹配·R1
title.en: Rack interface mismatch, R1

conditions.zh: L2-C；Galaxea R1；L2-B 长路线（90° 转弯、4 mm 地缝）；只提供与 R1 底盘不配的 T4-S 托架，另有 T1、T2、T3、T5；相容性不公开、接口几何可观察；公开时间预算 560 s；FT v0.2 损伤规则。
conditions.en: L2-C; Galaxea R1; the L2-B long route (90° turn, 4 mm seam); the only rack is T4-S, which does not fit the R1 base, alongside T1, T2, T3 and T5; compatibility undisclosed but interface geometry observable; public 560 s budget; FT v0.2 damage rule.

design.zh: 通过检查或低风险试放发现 T4-S 装不上，改用其他方式。参考解先到工具桌检查 T4-S，判定不配后改用 T1 双臂搬运，并卸货到目标区。
design.en: Discover by inspection or a low-risk trial that T4-S does not mount, then switch methods. The reference inspects T4-S at the tool table, rejects it, and instead carries the flasks in T1 with both arms and unloads them into the target.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒：三座、双侧开放把手
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier: three seats, two open handles

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

tools.zh: T3 推车
tools.en: T3 cart

tools.zh: T5 马蹄形领圈：从颈环下方托起烧瓶
tools.en: T5 horseshoe collar: lifts a flask under its neck ring

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 v2.1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 v2.1 wheeled dual-arm robot

result.zh: 成功：461.670 s 时三瓶完好、松手并稳定在桌 B，在 560 s 预算内；逐瓶手持基线需 662.70 s。时间比较只针对所声明的控制器。
result.en: Success: at 461.670 s all three flasks were intact, released and stable on table B, within the 560 s budget; the per-flask hand baseline takes 662.70 s. The timing comparison concerns the declared controllers only.

title.zh: 双把手盒单臂不可用·Stretch（分段计时修订版）
title.en: Two-handle carrier unusable with one arm, Stretch (phase-budget revision)

conditions.zh: L2-C；Stretch 3；8 m 长路线（90° 转弯、4 mm 地缝）；T1、三个 T2、T4-S 在场；作者授权修订 phase-budget-v2：先有不超过 60 s 的空盒检查（不得触碰评分瓶），撤手后立即开始不超过 240 s 的运输计时，全程连续、上限 300 s。
conditions.en: L2-C; Stretch 3; the 8 m long route (90° turn, 4 mm seam); T1, three T2 and T4-S present; author-approved revision phase-budget-v2: an empty-carrier inspection of at most 60 s (scored flasks untouched), then a transport clock of at most 240 s starting right after the probe is released and withdrawn; one continuous episode capped at 300 s.

design.zh: 单臂提 T1 一侧把手时盒体会倾斜，须用空盒试提发现不相容，不能靠先摔瓶发现。参考解空盒试提约 3 cm、测得倾斜后放弃 T1，改用 T4-S 两座加手持一瓶一趟运完。
design.en: Lifting T1 by one handle with one arm tilts the carrier; the agent must find this incompatibility with an empty-carrier trial lift, not by dropping a flask. The reference trial-lifts the empty carrier about 3 cm, measures the tilt, rejects T1, and delivers in one trip with two flasks in T4-S seats and one in hand.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒：三座、双侧开放把手
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier: three seats, two open handles

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3 单伸缩臂
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 single telescoping arm

result.zh: 成功（修订目标）：检查 33.64 s、运输 205.105 s，全程 238.745 s，三瓶完好交付，运输阶段对逐瓶手持基线的比较通过。原整局计时规则仍未满足。
result.en: Success (revised goal): inspection 33.64 s and transport 205.105 s, 238.745 s in total, with all three flasks delivered intact; the transport-phase comparison against the per-flask hand baseline passes. The original whole-episode timing rule remains unmet.

title.zh: 湿滑烧瓶抓取标定·G1（共轴 T5 修订版）
title.en: Slippery-flask grasp calibration, G1 (coaxial T5 revision)

conditions.zh: L3；固定骨盆 G1＋Dex3；隐藏：烧瓶与手指垫摩擦均为 0.05（湿滑），只靠摩擦夹住瓶颈所需握力会超过压碎限；提供不计分试验瓶；授权修订 coaxial-plain-release-v12：桌高 0.74→0.64 m、三只瓶起点调到可达位置、T5 改为保留马蹄口并加共轴光柄的 0.12 kg 领圈，B 目标区与损伤规则不变；时限 900 s。
conditions.en: L3; fixed-pelvis G1 + Dex3; hidden: flask and finger-pad friction both 0.05 (wet), so a friction-only neck pinch would need more grip than the crush limit allows; an unscored test flask is provided; authorized revision coaxial-plain-release-v12: tables lowered from 0.74 to 0.64 m, flask starts moved to reachable positions, and T5 rebuilt as a 0.12 kg collar that keeps the horseshoe mouth and adds a coaxial plain stem, with the table-B goal and damage rules unchanged; 900 s limit.

design.zh: 先用试验瓶实测名义颈部夹持失效，再改用 T5 领圈从颈环下方托起，把三瓶逐个运到桌 B、退出领圈并独立落桌。设计预期三指 Dex3 需改用工具，与五指手的 L3-1.F 形成身体差异对照。
design.en: First measure on the test flask that the nominal neck pinch fails, then switch to the T5 collar that lifts under the neck ring, carrying each flask to table B, withdrawing the collar and leaving it standing on its own. The design expects the three-finger Dex3 to switch to the tool, in contrast with the five-finger L3-1.F.

tools.zh: T5 共轴领圈（修订版，0.12 kg）
tools.en: T5 coaxial collar (revised, 0.12 kg)

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve

tools.zh: T3 推车
tools.en: T3 cart

tools.zh: T4-W 车载托架（R1 接口）
tools.en: T4-W base rack (R1 interface)

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

tools.zh: 不计分试验瓶（公开自身峰值冲量与是否破损）
tools.en: Unscored test flask (reports its own peak impulse and breakage)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3，固定骨盆
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3, fixed pelvis

result.zh: 成功（修订目标）：413.04 s 时三瓶完好直立、完全退出领圈、由桌 B 直接支撑并稳定 2 s。原跨手接力及 reach-layout-v2 版本未完成；前一版 v11 因包含区设置错误被拒，记录保留。
result.en: Success (revised goal): at 413.04 s all three flasks were intact, upright, fully clear of the collar, directly supported by table B and stable for 2 s. The original cross-hand relay and the reach-layout-v2 version were not completed; the previous v11 run was rejected for a wrong containment setting and is retained.

title.zh: 湿滑烧瓶抓取标定·Inspire 五指手
title.en: Slippery-flask grasp calibration, Inspire five-finger hand

conditions.zh: L3；固定骨盆 G1＋Inspire DFQ；隐藏：烧瓶与手指垫摩擦均为 0.05（湿滑）；ORIG 世界加不计分试验瓶；T1 在场；FT v0.2 损伤规则；时限 900 s。
conditions.en: L3; fixed-pelvis G1 + Inspire DFQ; hidden: flask and finger-pad friction both 0.05 (wet); ORIG world plus an unscored test flask; T1 present; FT v0.2 damage rule; 900 s limit.

design.zh: 先用试验瓶探测：名义力度的摩擦捏颈会滑脱，改为手指勾在颈环下方即可低力提起；据此不用 T5，以颈环勾握逐瓶交付三瓶。
design.en: Probe with the test flask first: a nominal-force friction pinch slips, while hooking fingers under the neck ring lifts it with low force; the reference therefore skips T5 and delivers the three flasks one by one with the ring hook.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（在场，参考解未使用）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (present, unused by the reference)

tools.zh: 不计分试验瓶（公开自身峰值冲量与是否破损）
tools.en: Unscored test flask (reports its own peak impulse and breakage)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Inspire DFQ 五指手，固定骨盆
embodiment.en: G1 + Inspire DFQ five-finger hands, fixed pelvis

result.zh: 成功：湿滑颈部捏持探针失败、颈环勾握探针提起 25.3 mm；230.32 s 时三瓶完好交付并松手，记录共 239.78 s。另有一条名义捏持失败的诊断运行，证明隐藏条件确实生效。
result.en: Success: the wet-neck pinch probe failed and the ring-hook probe lifted 25.3 mm; all three flasks were delivered intact and released at 230.32 s, recording length 239.78 s. A separate diagnostic run shows the nominal pinch failing, confirming the hidden condition is active.

title.zh: 运输盒缓冲老化·R1
title.en: Aged carrier cushioning, R1

conditions.zh: L3；Galaxea R1；L2-B 长路线（90° 转弯、4 mm 地缝）；隐藏：T1 座位弹簧阻尼老化、落座会触底，T2、T4-W 正常；T1、T2、T4-W、T3、T5 与不计分试验瓶在场；时限 1500 s。
conditions.en: L3; Galaxea R1; the L2-B long route (90° turn, 4 mm seam); hidden: T1's seat springs and dampers are aged and bottom out on seating, while T2 and T4-W are normal; T1, T2, T4-W, T3, T5 and an unscored test flask present; 1500 s limit.

design.zh: R1 最自然的选择是 T1。参考解先把试验瓶放入 T1 座位并抬盒短程试运，测得座位触底后放弃 T1，改为双臂手持分两趟直接运送三瓶。
design.en: T1 is R1's most natural choice. The reference first seats the test flask in T1 and lifts the carrier briefly; on measuring seat bottoming it abandons T1 and carries the three flasks by hand with both arms in two trips.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（座位已老化）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (aged seats)

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve

tools.zh: T4-W 车载托架（R1 接口）
tools.en: T4-W base rack (R1 interface)

tools.zh: T3 推车
tools.en: T3 cart

tools.zh: T5 马蹄形领圈：从颈环下方托起烧瓶
tools.en: T5 horseshoe collar: lifts a flask under its neck ring

tools.zh: 不计分试验瓶（公开自身峰值冲量与是否破损）
tools.en: Unscored test flask (reports its own peak impulse and breakage)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 v2.1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 v2.1 wheeled dual-arm robot

result.zh: 成功：探测后于 542.08 s 三瓶完好交付，记录共 556.18 s。配对诊断：4 cm 载盒落座时健康座完好、老化座破损；更轻的 2 mm 落座可能存活，诊断只覆盖该名义协议。
result.en: Success: after the probe, all three flasks were delivered intact at 542.08 s; recording length 556.18 s. Paired diagnostic: in a 4 cm loaded-carrier landing, healthy seats survive and aged seats break; a gentler 2 mm landing may survive, so the diagnostic covers only that nominal protocol.

title.zh: 老化托架整批运输评估·Stretch（替代修订版）
title.en: Aged-rack packed shipment assessment, Stretch (replacement revision)

conditions.zh: L3；Stretch 3；作者授权替代版 packed-rack-assessment-v2：三瓶初始已装在老化的 T4-S v2 托架座内（座位刚度、阻尼与行程不公开），不含从桌 A 装载；4 m L 形路线含 90° 转弯和 4 mm 地缝；上限 600 s。
conditions.en: L3; Stretch 3; author-approved replacement packed-rack-assessment-v2: the three flasks start seated in an aged T4-S v2 rack (seat stiffness, damping and travel hidden), with no loading from table A; a 4 m L-shaped route with a 90° turn and a 4 mm seam; 600 s cap.

design.zh: 先以 0.12 m/s 驶过地缝并实测冲击，再按公开规则选择后续速度（0.25 或 0.08 m/s），整批运到桌 B 后逐瓶卸到目标区并松手稳定。原“名义速度破损、慢速完好”设计经六次老化标定未能成立，已撤回。
design.en: First cross the seam at 0.12 m/s and measure the impact, then choose the onward speed (0.25 or 0.08 m/s) by a public rule, carry the shipment to table B and unload each flask into the target. The original design, in which nominal speed breaks flasks and slow driving saves them, could not be established in six aging calibrations and was withdrawn.

tools.zh: T4-S v2 托架（预装三瓶，座位已老化）
tools.en: T4-S v2 rack (prepacked with three flasks, aged seats)

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒：三座、双侧开放把手
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier: three seats, two open handles

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3 单伸缩臂
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 single telescoping arm

result.zh: 成功（替代目标）：越缝实测冲击很低，选定 0.25 m/s；223.845 s 时三瓶完好落桌、松手并稳定，记录共 231.70 s。原 L3-3 名义失败／慢速成功的对照仍为撤回状态。
result.en: Success (replacement goal): the measured seam impact was low, so 0.25 m/s was chosen; at 223.845 s all three flasks were intact on the table, released and stable; recording length 231.70 s. The original L3-3 nominal-failure/slow-success contrast remains withdrawn.

title.zh: 路线阻断探测与安全返回·行走 G1（子任务修订版）
title.en: Blocked-route probe and safe return, walking G1 (component revision)

conditions.zh: L3；可行走 G1＋Dex3；隐藏：10 mm 门槛可见，但载货推车能否越过不公开；推车 T3 载不计分试验瓶，T2×3、T4-W、T4-S 在场；授权修订 probe-return-v2：只做通行探测与安全返回，三只评分瓶始终留在 A 不得触碰，上限 120 s。
conditions.en: L3; walking G1 + Dex3; hidden: the 10 mm threshold is visible, but whether the loaded cart can cross it is not disclosed; the T3 cart carries the unscored test flask, with three T2, T4-W and T4-S present; authorized revision probe-return-v2: only the passability probe and a safe return, with the three scored flasks left untouched on A; 120 s cap.

design.zh: 推着载有试验瓶的推车试过门槛，依据实际接触与推进量判定受阻，松开推车后步行返回 A 站点并静止 2 秒，四瓶全部完好。此版本不包含向桌 B 运输。
design.en: Push the cart carrying the test flask at the threshold, judge it blocked from actual contact and lack of progress, release the cart, walk back to station A and stand still for 2 s with all four flasks intact. This version includes no transport to table B.

tools.zh: T3 推车（载试验瓶）
tools.en: T3 cart (carrying the test flask)

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

tools.zh: T4-W 车载托架（R1 接口）
tools.en: T4-W base rack (R1 interface)

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

tools.zh: 不计分试验瓶（公开自身峰值冲量与是否破损）
tools.en: Unscored test flask (reports its own peak impulse and breakage)

embodiment.zh: G1＋Dex3，可行走
embodiment.en: G1 + Dex3, walking

result.zh: 成功（子任务）：79.46 s 的连续运行中，实测推车在门槛处停滞，松开推车并返回 A 静止，四瓶完好、评分瓶未被触碰。原“改用其他方式把三瓶运到 B”的目标未完成。
result.en: Success (component task): in a continuous 79.46 s run the cart was measured stalled at the threshold, released, and the robot returned to A and stood still, with all four flasks intact and the scored flasks untouched. The original goal of switching methods and delivering the three flasks to B remains unfulfilled.

title.zh: 全路线不可行对照·R1（正确退出）
title.en: All-routes-infeasible control, R1 (correct exit)

conditions.zh: 对照；Galaxea R1；桌 B 位于 0.30 m 高的固定台阶平台上（平台 3.4×7 m，后方是墙），无坡道；只有 T1 在场；正确行为是空手进入 Q 区并静止至少 3 s。
conditions.en: Control; Galaxea R1; table B stands on a fixed 0.30 m step platform (3.4×7 m, wall behind), with no ramp; only T1 present; the correct behavior is to enter zone Q empty-handed and stay still for at least 3 s.

design.zh: 须排除直接通行、全部工具及组合、隔台阶够取等路线后退出，可解却退出算误放弃。参考解附全路线类别排除证书，先到平台前伸臂实测够不到目标，再空手驶入 Q 区停稳。
design.en: The agent must rule out driving up, every tool and combination, and reaching across the step before exiting; exiting a solvable task counts as wrongful abandonment. The reference has a route-class exclusion certificate, extends an arm at the platform face to confirm the target is out of reach, then drives empty-handed into Q and stops.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（唯一工具）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (only tool)

embodiment.zh: Galaxea R1 v2.1 轮式双臂
embodiment.en: Galaxea R1 v2.1 wheeled dual-arm robot

refusal_note.zh: 0.30 m 台阶远高于 R1 轮子可越高度，现场无坡道，可移动物体也搭不出可用坡道；从台阶下任何位置到目标区的距离都超过手臂加持物的最大可达范围，后方有墙封闭，因此所有路线类别均被排除。
refusal_note.en: The 0.30 m step is far above what R1's wheels can climb, there is no ramp and no movable object can form one; from anywhere below the step the target lies beyond the arm's reach even with a held object, and a wall closes the rear, so every route class is excluded.

result.zh: 正确退出：在平台前伸臂实测末端离目标仍差 2.39 m，随后空手完全进入 Q 区静止 5.1 s，未接触任何物体、无跌倒；记录共 41.82 s。
result.en: Correct exit: at the platform face the extended arm's tip was still 2.39 m short of the target; the robot then entered Q fully and empty-handed and stayed still for 5.1 s, touching nothing and without falling; recording length 41.82 s.

title.zh: 全路线不可行对照·Stretch（正确退出）
title.en: All-routes-infeasible control, Stretch (correct exit)

conditions.zh: 对照；Stretch 3；桌 B 位于四面均为 0.30 m 台阶的平台上，无坡道、平台上无固定物，不提供 T3；T1、三个 T2、T4-S 在场；公开规则禁止抛掷与底盘倾覆；正确行为是空手进入 Q 区并静止至少 3 s；时限 90 s。
conditions.en: Control; Stretch 3; table B sits on a platform with a 0.30 m step on all four sides, no ramp and nothing fixed to it, and T3 is not provided; T1, three T2 and T4-S present; public rules forbid throwing and base tip-over; the correct behavior is to enter zone Q empty-handed and stay still for at least 3 s; 90 s limit.

design.zh: 允许依据足够的可观察证据直接退出，不强制先失败。参考解应用路线类别排除证书后收臂，空手倒车驶回 Q 区。
design.en: Exiting directly on sufficient observable evidence is allowed; a prior failure is not required. The reference applies its route-class exclusion certificate, stows the arm and backs empty-handed into Q.

tools.zh: T1 弹簧阻尼运输盒（在场，参考解未使用）
tools.en: T1 spring-damper carrier (present, unused by the reference)

tools.zh: T2 单瓶防震套 ×3
tools.en: T2 single-flask cushioned sleeve ×3

tools.zh: T4-S 车载托架（Stretch 接口）
tools.en: T4-S base rack (Stretch interface)

embodiment.zh: Stretch 3 单伸缩臂
embodiment.en: Stretch 3 single telescoping arm

refusal_note.zh: 台阶高于驱动轮可越高度和底盘离地间隙；可移动物体的最低顶面已高于可越台阶，搭不成坡道；手臂加持物或工具的最大可达距离远小于台阶边缘到桌 B 的距离；推链、抛掷和搬动固定体都被排除，最小余量 0.49 m。
refusal_note.en: The step exceeds what the drive wheels and ground clearance can climb; even the lowest movable object is already too tall to serve as a first step, so no ramp can be built; the arm's reach with a held flask or tool is far shorter than the distance from the step edge to table B; pushing chains, throwing and moving fixed bodies are all excluded, with a minimum margin of 0.49 m.

result.zh: 正确退出：空手倒车 2.15 m 完全进入 Q 区，最后 3 s 静止，未触碰任何物体；记录共 19.22 s。
result.en: Correct exit: the empty robot backed 2.15 m fully into Q and stayed still for the final 3 s, touching nothing; recording length 19.22 s.

summary.zh: 以比赛场景为主体：同一颗球在两台机器人之间连续对打，不重置、不补发，对手只能经有界执行器物理击球，对面可以是固定参考对手或另一种身体（UR10e、G1、A3）。另设死球判断：合法球须回击，死球不得触碰并保持准备姿态。人形机器人不焊接、靠真实脚底接触站立，手持拍版本连球拍也不焊接；两个已批准的单次回球参考（UR10e、G1）作为原始任务冻结。
summary.en: The family is built around match play: one ball is rallied continuously between two robots with no resets or replacement balls, and the opponent may strike only through bounded actuators; the opponent is either a fixed reference paddle or another body (UR10e, G1, A3). Dead-ball tasks require returning legal balls while leaving dead balls untouched and holding the ready pose. Humanoids are unwelded and balance on real foot contacts, the hand-held variant does not weld the racket either, and the two approved single-return references (UR10e, G1) are frozen as the original tasks.

acceptance.zh: 签收记录：参考已批准，D2 明确验收；任务表以 D2 计 15/15 完成，扩展配置 46/47 有见证，TT-D-A 的 D1 档仍失败（有证据）。两个原始单次回球参考于 2026-10-27 获批正式发布（table-tennis-0.1.0）。对打均为合作模式，专家使用特权状态离线规划，未做留出 seed 泛化评测；他人复现与不可信智能体沙盒接入仍待完成。
acceptance.en: Sign-off: references approved and D2 explicitly accepted; counted at D2 the task table is 15/15 complete, 46/47 extension configurations have witnesses, and TT-D-A at tier D1 still fails (with evidence). The two original single-return references were approved for formal release on 2026-10-27 (table-tennis-0.1.0). All rallies are cooperative, experts plan offline from privileged state, and no held-out seed evaluation was run; independent-person reproduction and isolated untrusted-agent sandbox integration remain open.

axes.zh: 被测身体（UR10e、G1、A3、G1＋五指手）、对手（发球机、固定参考对手、同构或异构专家）与场景类型（单次回球、连续对打、死球判断、手持拍对打）。D1/D2/D3 是任务内难度档（对打 N=3/5/10），不另计任务；本页逐任务以 D2 结果计。
axes.en: Subject body (UR10e, G1, A3, G1 with a five-finger hand), opponent (launcher, fixed reference opponent, same-body or cross-body expert) and scene type (single return, continuous rally, dead-ball judgment, hand-held racket rally). D1/D2/D3 are difficulty tiers inside each task (rally N=3/5/10) and do not add tasks; each task here is counted by its D2 result.

embodiments.zh: UR10e 六关节固定基座机械臂，球拍刚性固连在法兰
embodiments.en: UR10e 6-joint fixed-base arm, racket rigidly mounted on the flange

embodiments.zh: Unitree G1，29 关节浮动基座，靠脚底接触站立，球拍被动固连在右腕
embodiments.en: Unitree G1, 29 joints, floating base on real foot contacts, racket passively mounted on the right wrist

embodiments.zh: A3 Ultra 人形（a3_ultra_t3d0），不焊接站立，31 个有界关节力矩，球拍固连腕部（偏置 0.22 m）
embodiments.en: A3 Ultra humanoid (a3_ultra_t3d0), unwelded, 31 bounded joint torques, racket mounted on the wrist (0.22 m offset)

embodiments.zh: G1＋Inspire 五指手，球拍为独立刚体，只靠手指接触握持
embodiments.en: G1 with an Inspire five-finger hand; the racket is a free rigid body held only by finger contact

title.zh: UR10e 单次目标回球
title.en: UR10e single target return

conditions.zh: 原始任务，固定基座 UR10e；发球机单发无旋球，四个公开固定配置（nominal、left、right、fast），每局 2.4 s；物理 2 kHz、参考 500 Hz，特权仿真状态观测。
conditions.en: Original task with a fixed-base UR10e; one spin-free launcher feed in four public fixed configurations (nominal, left, right, fast), 2.4 s per episode; physics at 2 kHz, references at 500 Hz, privileged simulator state.

design.zh: 来球在本方台面弹地一次后用球拍合法击回，过网落入对方半台的 0.30 m 目标圆，再回到准备姿态并保持。分层专家为准备接球 → 击球与随挥 → 回位保持，GPU 评估 28,033 个出球候选；评分为 stage-scoring/1：有效击球 25＋越网 25＋对侧落台 20＋命中目标 15＋回位保持 15。
design.en: After one bounce on its own half the ball must be struck legally over the net into the 0.30 m target disk on the far half, then the arm returns to and holds its ready pose. The hierarchical expert runs prepare → strike and follow-through → recover and hold, with a GPU search over 28,033 outgoing-shot candidates; stage-scoring/1 awards contact 25 + net 25 + far-half landing 20 + target 15 + recovery 15.

tools.zh: 法兰固连球拍
tools.en: Flange-mounted racket

tools.zh: 发球机
tools.en: Ball launcher

embodiment.zh: UR10e 固定基座机械臂
embodiment.en: UR10e fixed-base arm

result.zh: 已批准参考：四个配置各 3 次共 12/12 完整成功，每条 100 分，新场景力矩回放 4/4；静止机械臂对照 25 分未成功，越界宽来球 0 分未执行。见证为 nominal 配置的一次完整运行；12 次是四个固定配置的重复，不代表随机泛化成功率。
result.en: Approved reference: 12/12 full successes (three runs in each of four configurations), each scoring 100, with 4/4 fresh-scene torque replays; a stationary-arm control scores 25 without success and an out-of-bounds wide feed scores 0 and is not executed. The witness is one complete nominal run; the 12 runs are repeats of four fixed configurations, not a random-generalisation success rate.

title.zh: G1 自由站立回球与稳定恢复
title.en: G1 free-standing return and stable recovery

conditions.zh: 原始任务，G1 双脚原地站立，靠真实地面接触力，骨盆既不固定也不驱动；29 个关节力矩，500 Hz 浮动基座接触约束 QP，MuJoCo 2 kHz；四个公开固定配置（nominal、left、right、fast），每局 3.0 s；特权状态、无旋。
conditions.en: Original task: G1 stands in place on real ground contact with an unfixed, unactuated pelvis; 29 joint torques via a 500 Hz floating-base contact-constrained QP, MuJoCo at 2 kHz; four public fixed configurations (nominal, left, right, fast), 3.0 s per episode; privileged state, no spin.

design.zh: 与 UR10e 相同的单次目标回球，但挥拍与全身平衡耦合：恢复须双脚受力、躯干直立、根部与关节低速并持续保持，击球落点正确也不能掩盖失衡。120 g 球拍被动固连右腕；不含迈步或连续对打。
design.en: The same single target return as the UR10e task, but the swing is coupled to whole-body balance: recovery requires both feet loaded, an upright torso and low root and joint speeds held over time, so a correct landing cannot hide a loss of balance. The 120 g racket is a passive wrist attachment; no stepping or continuous rally.

tools.zh: 右腕被动固连球拍（120 g）
tools.en: Racket passively mounted on the right wrist (120 g)

tools.zh: 发球机
tools.en: Ball launcher

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1 自由站立
embodiment.en: Unitree G1, free-standing

result.zh: 已批准参考：12/12 完整成功，每条 100 分，独立力矩回放 4/4；原地保持对照 25 分未成功，零力矩与不可达来球均为 0 分。nominal 配置中最小脚底力约 117 N、躯干倾斜约 0.2°、脚滑移不到 1 mm；12 次是四个固定配置的重复。
result.en: Approved reference: 12/12 full successes, each scoring 100, with 4/4 independent torque replays; the hold-pose control scores 25 without success and the zero-torque and unreachable-feed controls score 0. In the nominal configuration the minimum foot force is about 117 N, torso tilt about 0.2 degrees and foot slip under 1 mm; the 12 runs are repeats of four fixed configurations.

title.zh: UR10e 对参考对手连续对打
title.en: UR10e rally against the reference opponent

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，参考对手左右交替回球；同一颗球不重置，首球为原始 nominal 发球，其后每球都由对手物理击出；每拍 3 s、整局 20 s（3N+5）；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with the reference opponent alternating sides; one ball, no resets: the first ball is the original nominal feed and every later ball is struck physically by the opponent; 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode (3N+5); privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 参考对手为抽象龙门球拍（三向平移＋偏航＋俯仰，电机、速度与加速度有界），所有被测方共用，作为控制变量。被测方须在非复位状态下逐拍重新规划、回击到对方目标圆并在拍间恢复，评分 80·C/N＋10·H/N＋10·R_end。参考对手回球区间以原始来球为中心，测连续性而非覆盖范围。
design.en: The reference opponent is an abstract gantry paddle (three slides plus yaw and pitch, with bounded motors, speed and acceleration) shared by all subjects as a controlled variable. The subject must replan each shot from a non-reset state, return to the far target disk and recover between shots; score = 80·C/N + 10·H/N + 10·R_end. The opponent's return envelope is centred on the original feed, so the task tests continuity rather than reach.

tools.zh: 法兰固连球拍
tools.en: Flange-mounted racket

tools.zh: 参考对手（龙门球拍）
tools.en: Reference opponent (gantry paddle)

embodiment.zh: UR10e 固定基座机械臂
embodiment.en: UR10e fixed-base arm

result.zh: D2 见证：一条连续运行得 100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1）。D1、D3 也为 100 分；D3 打满 10 拍后参考对手打出出界死球，被正确放过。
result.en: D2 witness: one continuous run scores 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1). D1 and D3 also score 100; in D3, after ten returns the reference opponent plays a wide dead ball that is correctly let go.

title.zh: G1 对参考对手连续对打
title.en: G1 rally against the reference opponent

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，参考对手左右交替回球；G1 双脚静止支撑、不焊接，右手击球线对准球台中线；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with the reference opponent alternating sides; G1 in unwelded static double support, its right-hand hitting line on the table centre line; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 同 TT-R-U-ref，被测方换成浮动基座 G1，复用原始全身控制器。额外考察连续击球的反作用力在拍间累积、平衡余量是否下降；挥拍可配合腰部转动。
design.en: As TT-R-U-ref, but the subject is the floating-base G1 reusing the original whole-body controller. It additionally tests whether strike reactions accumulate between shots and erode the balance margin; the swing may use the waist.

tools.zh: 右腕被动固连球拍
tools.en: Racket passively mounted on the right wrist

tools.zh: 参考对手（龙门球拍）
tools.en: Reference opponent (gantry paddle)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1 自由站立
embodiment.en: Unitree G1, free-standing

result.zh: D2 见证：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），使用加入瞄准修正的冻结 G1 专家（tag h：在私有仿真副本中预测击球误差后修正瞄准点，真实执行仍只经有界执行器）。D1、D3 也为 100 分；旧版 tag g 的 D1–D3 见证保留。
result.en: D2 witness: 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1) with the frozen G1 expert tag h, which predicts its strike error in a private simulation copy and corrects the aim point while real execution still goes only through bounded actuators. D1 and D3 also score 100; the older tag-g D1–D3 witnesses are retained.

title.zh: A3 对参考对手连续对打
title.en: A3 rally against the reference opponent

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，参考对手左右交替回球；A3 Ultra 不焊接站立，31 个有界力矩、全身 QP 控制，球拍固连腕部（偏置 0.22 m），手指固定成拳；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with the reference opponent alternating sides; unwelded A3 Ultra with 31 bounded torques under a whole-body QP, racket on the wrist (0.22 m offset), fingers fixed as a fist; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin.

design.zh: 第二种人形对同一参考对手的基线，可与 TT-R-U-ref、TT-R-G-ref 直接比较。A3 身高、臂长与质量分布不同于 G1，平衡与挥拍的耦合方式也不同；击球可加入腰部偏航。
design.en: A second-humanoid baseline against the same reference opponent, directly comparable with TT-R-U-ref and TT-R-G-ref. A3 differs from G1 in height, arm length and mass distribution, so balance couples differently with the swing; strikes may add waist yaw.

tools.zh: 腕部固连球拍
tools.en: Wrist-mounted racket

tools.zh: 参考对手（龙门球拍）
tools.en: Reference opponent (gantry paddle)

embodiment.zh: A3 Ultra 人形
embodiment.en: A3 Ultra humanoid

result.zh: D2 见证：一条连续运行得 100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），在线与离线裁判一致。D1、D3 也为 100 分；平衡余量随档位下降（D1 最小脚底力 211 N，D3 左脚低至 26 N），无跌倒。
result.en: D2 witness: one continuous run scores 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1), with online and offline referees in agreement. D1 and D3 also score 100; the balance margin shrinks with tier (minimum foot force 211 N at D1, left foot down to 26 N at D3), with no fall.

title.zh: UR10e 对 UR10e 对打
title.en: UR10e versus UR10e rally

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，对手为冻结的 UR10e 连续对打专家（同一代码绕竖轴镜像），左右交替回球；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 against a frozen UR10e rally expert (the same code mirrored about the vertical axis) that alternates sides; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 两台 UR10e 隔台对打，来球不再是预登记分布，而是同型机器人在同样身体限制下打出的球。除连续对打评分外，另报回合总长与失误归属。
design.en: Two UR10e arms rally across the table, so the incoming balls are no longer a pre-registered distribution but shots produced by a same-type robot under the same body limits. Besides the rally score, total rally length and fault attribution are reported.

tools.en: UR10e expert opponent

embodiment.zh: UR10e 固定基座机械臂
embodiment.en: UR10e fixed-base arm

result.zh: D2 见证：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1）。D1、D3 也为 100 分；最后一拍后撤回的对手机械臂仍被球碰到，记为回合后接触，不计分。
result.en: D2 witness: 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1). D1 and D3 also score 100; after the final return the withdrawn opponent arm is still hit by the ball, which is logged as a post-rally contact and not scored.

title.zh: G1 对 G1 对打
title.en: G1 versus G1 rally

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，两侧均为双脚静止支撑的 G1，对手为冻结的 G1 专家，左右交替回球；不允许迈步；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with a statically standing G1 on both sides, the opponent a frozen G1 expert alternating sides; no stepping; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 同构人形对打：双方都有平衡约束，回球误差相互放大，是本族风险最高的任务。来球偏离接球线时只能靠手臂加腰部够到。
design.en: Same-body humanoid rally: both sides are balance-constrained and return errors amplify each other, making this the riskiest task in the family. When a ball drifts off the receiving line it can only be reached with the arm plus waist.

tools.en: Racket passively mounted on the right wrist

tools.zh: G1 专家对手
tools.en: G1 expert opponent

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1 自由站立
embodiment.en: Unitree G1, free-standing

result.zh: D2 见证：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），双方均为加入瞄准修正的冻结专家 tag h，双脚保持原位。D1、D3 也为 100 分；旧版 tag g 的 D2 为 18 分、D3 为 9 分（G1 落点误差使下一球偏离接球线），失败记录保留。
result.en: D2 witness: 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1), with both sides running the frozen aim-corrected expert tag h and feet kept in place. D1 and D3 also score 100; the older tag g scored 18 at D2 and 9 at D3 (G1 landing errors pushed the next ball off the receiver's line), and those failures are retained.

title.zh: UR10e 对 G1 专家对打
title.en: UR10e versus G1 expert rally

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，UR10e 为被测方，对手为冻结的 G1 专家（tag h），左右交替回球；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with UR10e as the subject and a frozen G1 expert (tag h) as the opponent alternating sides; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 异构对打：同一张球台，被测机械臂要接住另一种身体打出的回球，其分布由对面人形的平衡与够及限制决定。报告相对 TT-R-U-U 的 C 降幅作为跨身体适应量，不比较两种身体的力矩或能耗。
design.en: Cross-body rally: on the same table the subject arm must handle returns from another body, whose distribution is shaped by the humanoid's balance and reach limits. The drop in C relative to TT-R-U-U is reported as cross-body adaptation; torques and energy of the two bodies are not compared.

tools.zh: 法兰固连球拍
tools.en: Flange-mounted racket

tools.zh: G1 专家对手
tools.en: G1 expert opponent

embodiment.zh: UR10e 固定基座机械臂
embodiment.en: UR10e fixed-base arm

result.zh: D2 见证：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1）。D1、D3 也为 100 分；旧版 tag g 对手下 D1–D3 也有见证。
result.en: D2 witness: 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1). D1 and D3 also score 100; D1–D3 were also witnessed against the older tag-g opponent.

title.zh: G1 对 UR10e 专家对打
title.en: G1 versus UR10e expert rally

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，G1 为被测方，对手为冻结的 UR10e 专家，左右交替回球；G1 双脚静止支撑；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with G1 as the subject in static double support and a frozen UR10e expert as the opponent alternating sides; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 与 TT-R-U-G 对调被测方：人形要接住机械臂打出的回球，报告相对 TT-R-G-G 的 C 降幅。两种身体的回球分布差异是待测假设，不预设结论。
design.en: TT-R-U-G with the roles swapped: the humanoid must handle returns from the arm, and the drop in C relative to TT-R-G-G is reported. Differences between the two bodies' return distributions are a hypothesis under test, not an assumed conclusion.

tools.zh: 右腕被动固连球拍
tools.en: Racket passively mounted on the right wrist

tools.zh: UR10e 专家对手
tools.en: UR10e expert opponent

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1 自由站立
embodiment.en: Unitree G1, free-standing

result.zh: D2 见证：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），被测 G1 为冻结专家 tag h。D1、D3 也为 100 分；旧版 tag g 的 D1–D3 见证保留，加入腰部候选前的开发尝试因身体触球失败，记录保留。
result.en: D2 witness: 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1) with the subject G1 running the frozen expert tag h. D1 and D3 also score 100; the older tag-g D1–D3 witnesses are retained, as are earlier development attempts that failed on body contact before waist candidates were added.

title.zh: A3 对 G1 专家对打
title.en: A3 versus G1 expert rally

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，A3 为被测方，对手为冻结的 G1 专家（tag h），左右交替回球；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with A3 as the subject and a frozen G1 expert (tag h) as the opponent alternating sides; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 人形对人形且非镜像：两种人形的身高、臂长和平衡约束不同。报告相对 TT-R-A-ref 的 C 降幅。
design.en: Humanoid against humanoid, not mirrored: the two humanoids differ in height, arm length and balance constraints. The drop in C relative to TT-R-A-ref is reported.

tools.zh: 腕部固连球拍
tools.en: Wrist-mounted racket

tools.zh: G1 专家对手
tools.en: G1 expert opponent

embodiment.zh: A3 Ultra 人形
embodiment.en: A3 Ultra humanoid

result.zh: D2 见证（2026-10-30 重跑）：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），在线与离线裁判一致，相对 TT-R-A-ref 的 C 降幅为 0。D1、D3 也为 100 分；旧版 v2 的 D2 同为 100 分，其 D3 因 G1 对手失误只有 45 分，记录保留。
result.en: D2 witness (re-run 2026-10-30): 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1), online and offline referees agree, C drop versus TT-R-A-ref is 0. D1 and D3 also score 100; the older v2 run also scored 100 at D2, while its D3 scored only 45 because of a G1 opponent fault, and that record is retained.

title.zh: G1 对 A3 专家对打
title.en: G1 versus A3 expert rally

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，G1 为被测方（冻结专家 tag h），对手为 A3 专家，左右交替回球；同一颗球不重置，每拍 3 s、整局 20 s；特权状态、无旋、合作模式。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with G1 as the subject (frozen expert tag h) and an A3 expert as the opponent alternating sides; one ball with no resets, 3 s per exchange and 20 s per episode; privileged state, no spin, cooperative mode.

design.zh: 与 TT-R-A-G 对调被测方：G1 要接住 A3 打出的回球，报告相对 TT-R-G-G 的 C 降幅。
design.en: TT-R-A-G with the roles swapped: G1 must handle returns struck by A3, and the drop in C relative to TT-R-G-G is reported.

tools.zh: 右腕被动固连球拍
tools.en: Racket passively mounted on the right wrist

tools.zh: A3 专家对手
tools.en: A3 expert opponent

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1 自由站立
embodiment.en: Unitree G1, free-standing

result.zh: D2 见证（2026-10-30 重跑）：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），相对 TT-R-G-G 的 C 降幅为 0。D1、D3 也为 100 分；A3 对手规划日志的坐标系标注以派生文件修正，原始文件、执行命令与裁判结果未改。
result.en: D2 witness (re-run 2026-10-30): 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1), C drop versus TT-R-G-G is 0. D1 and D3 also score 100; a coordinate-frame label in the A3 opponent's plan logs is corrected in derived files, while original files, executed commands and referee results are unchanged.

title.zh: UR10e 死球判断
title.en: UR10e dead-ball judgment

conditions.zh: D2：一条连续运行中发球机依次发出 6 颗独立球，3 个为原始合法来球，3 个为擦网死球（擦网后落回对方一侧或落到台外）；每球周期 2.4 s（同原任务）；特权状态、无旋。
conditions.en: D2: in one continuous run the launcher fires 6 separate balls, 3 original legal feeds and 3 net-clip dead balls (clipping the net and falling back on the far side or off the table); 2.4 s per ball as in the original task; privileged state, no spin.

design.zh: 被测方逐球判断：合法球回击（按原 5 段评分），死球不得用球拍或身体触碰并保持准备姿态。死球按本任务约定：未触本方台面即越过端线或侧线、擦网后落回对方一侧或台外、擦台侧；死球误击与合法球误放分开统计。
design.en: The subject judges every ball: legal balls are returned (scored by the original five stages) and dead balls must not be touched by racket or body while the ready pose is held. Dead balls follow the task convention (crossing the end or side line without touching the own half, net clips falling back or off the table, table-side hits); dead-ball strikes and false let-gos are counted separately.

tools.zh: 法兰固连球拍
tools.en: Flange-mounted racket

tools.zh: 发球机（6 球弹匣）
tools.en: Ball launcher (6-ball magazine)

embodiment.zh: UR10e 固定基座机械臂
embodiment.en: UR10e fixed-base arm

result.zh: D2 见证：6 球全部判对，3 个合法球回击、3 个死球正确放过，死球误击 0、合法球误放 0，物理检查通过。D1、D3 也全部判对（三档共 18 球）。
result.en: D2 witness: all 6 balls judged correctly, 3 legal balls returned and 3 dead balls correctly let go, with zero dead-ball strikes and zero false let-gos; physics checks pass. D1 and D3 are also all correct (18 balls over three tiers).

title.zh: G1 死球判断与躯干避让
title.en: G1 dead-ball judgment with body avoidance

conditions.zh: D2：一条连续运行发出 6 颗独立球，3 个原始合法来球、3 个擦网死球（落回对方一侧或台外）；每球周期 3.0 s（同原任务）；G1 双脚静止支撑；特权状态、无旋。
conditions.en: D2: one continuous run with 6 separate balls, 3 original legal feeds and 3 net-clip dead balls (falling back on the far side or off the table); 3.0 s per ball as in the original task; G1 in static double support; privileged state, no spin.

design.zh: 同 TT-D-U，但 G1 躯干本身在球路上，必要时须主动避让（腰部侧倾、俯仰等），身体不得触碰死球，同时不得摔倒。
design.en: As TT-D-U, but the G1 torso itself sits in the ball path and must actively avoid when needed (waist lean and pitch), keeping the body off dead balls without falling.

tools.zh: 右腕被动固连球拍
tools.en: Racket passively mounted on the right wrist

tools.zh: 发球机（6 球弹匣）
tools.en: Ball launcher (6-ball magazine)

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1 自由站立
embodiment.en: Unitree G1, free-standing

result.zh: D2 见证：6 球全部判对，3 个合法球回击、3 个死球正确放过，物理检查通过。D1、D3 也全部判对（三档共 18 球）；D1 中瞄向头部与躯干的死球靠弯腰避让，最小脚底力 35.7 N、未摔倒，两次失败的 D1 尝试保留。
result.en: D2 witness: all 6 balls judged correctly, 3 legal balls returned and 3 dead balls correctly let go; physics checks pass. D1 and D3 are also all correct (18 balls over three tiers); in D1, dead balls aimed at the head and torso are avoided by waist lean with a minimum foot force of 35.7 N and no fall, and two failed D1 attempts are retained.

title.zh: A3 死球判断与躯干避让
title.en: A3 dead-ball judgment with body avoidance

conditions.zh: D2：一条连续运行发出 6 颗独立球（3 个合法来球、3 个擦网死球），沿用为 G1 设计的发球序列；每球周期 3.0 s，共 18 s 仿真；A3 Ultra 不焊接站立；特权状态、无旋。
conditions.en: D2: one continuous run with 6 separate balls (3 legal feeds, 3 net-clip dead balls) reusing the launch sequence designed for G1; 3.0 s per ball, 18 s of simulation in total; unwelded A3 Ultra; privileged state, no spin.

design.zh: 同 TT-D-G：合法球回击，死球不得触碰并保持准备姿态；A3 身体更大，避让约束与 G1 不同。场景、发球序列、裁判与验收阈值均未因 A3 修改。
design.en: As TT-D-G: return legal balls and leave dead balls untouched while holding the ready pose; A3's larger body changes the avoidance constraints. Scene, launch sequence, referee and acceptance thresholds were not changed for A3.

tools.zh: 腕部固连球拍
tools.en: Wrist-mounted racket

tools.zh: 发球机（6 球弹匣）
tools.en: Ball launcher (6-ball magazine)

embodiment.zh: A3 Ultra 人形
embodiment.en: A3 Ultra humanoid

result.zh: D2 见证：18 s 内 6 球全部判对，3 个合法球回击各 100 分，3 个擦网死球靠保持准备姿态正确放过，物理检查通过；D3 也有见证。D1 仍失败（有证据）：3 个合法球回击，2 个死球碰到身体、1 个正确放过；当前控制器与有限搜索未找到安全避让动作，未测试迈步，不构成物理上无法完成的证明。
result.en: D2 witness: all 6 balls judged correctly within 18 s, the 3 legal balls returned at 100 each and the 3 net-clip dead balls let go by holding the ready pose; physics checks pass, and D3 is also witnessed. D1 still fails with evidence: 3 legal balls returned, 2 dead balls hit the body and 1 is let go correctly; the current controller and a finite search found no safe avoidance motion, stepping was not tested, and this is not a proof of physical impossibility.

title.zh: G1 五指手持拍连续对打
title.en: G1 hand-held racket rally

conditions.zh: D2：N=5，参考对手左右交替回球；G1 右手换为 Inspire 五指手，球拍为独立刚体（拍面同焊接版本，含握柄共 0.175 kg），只靠手指接触握持；开局拍柄平放在朝上张开的掌心，手指闭合、抬起并移到准备姿态后约 8.3 s 发球；特权状态、无旋。
conditions.en: D2: N=5 with the reference opponent alternating sides; G1's right hand is an Inspire five-finger hand and the racket is a free rigid body (same blade as the welded version, 0.175 kg with handle) held only by finger contact; the handle starts lying in the open, upturned palm, and the feed fires at about 8.3 s after the fingers close and the racket is lifted to the ready pose; privileged state, no spin.

design.zh: 同 TT-R-G-ref，但球拍不焊接：每次击球冲量对拍柄产生扭矩，握持靠真实接触，拍子滑动或脱手即物理失败。报告相对焊接拍的 C 降幅以及拍柄相对手掌的位移与转角。
design.en: As TT-R-G-ref, but the racket is not welded: every impact torques the handle, the grip relies on real contact, and a slipping or dropped racket is a physical failure. The drop in C relative to the welded racket and the handle's displacement and rotation in the palm are reported.

tools.zh: 手持球拍（独立刚体，不焊接）
tools.en: Hand-held racket (free rigid body, not welded)

tools.zh: 参考对手（龙门球拍）
tools.en: Reference opponent (gantry paddle)

tools.zh: 发球机与拍架
tools.en: Ball launcher and racket rest

embodiment.zh: G1＋Inspire 五指手
embodiment.en: G1 with Inspire five-finger hand

result.zh: D2 见证：100 分（C=5/5、H=5、R_end=1），发球后拍柄最大漂移约 1.67 mm，左侧来球使用腰部辅助击球。D1、D3 也为 100 分（D3 拍柄最大漂移 2.27 mm／5.31°），相对焊接拍 C 降幅为 0。
result.en: D2 witness: 100 (C=5/5, H=5, R_end=1), with a maximum handle drift of about 1.67 mm after the feed and waist-assisted strikes on left-side balls. D1 and D3 also score 100 (D3 maximum handle drift 2.27 mm / 5.31 degrees), and the C drop relative to the welded racket is 0.

summary.zh: 自由基座 Unitree G1（Dex3 手）在 Genesis GPU 接触物理中，把卡在墙角的紧凑冰箱整体移入地面目标区。冰箱背面和两侧受墙或固定柜子限制，原地转不开，只能经正面横把手拉出、沿地面拖移后松手静置。考察受限空间中的接触选择、自由基座负载移位与全身平衡。
summary.en: A free-base Unitree G1 with Dex3 hands, simulated with Genesis GPU contact physics, must move a compact refrigerator wedged in a corner entirely into a floor goal zone. Walls and a fixed cabinet block its back and sides so it cannot be turned in place; it can only be pulled out by its front handle, dragged along the floor, then released to settle. The task tests contact selection in confined space, free-base load relocation and whole-body balance.

acceptance.zh: 只有原始已批准的 G1 参考（g1-space-extraction-0.1.0，2026-10-27 作者批准正式发布）计入验收：固定版本新运行 3/3 完整成功，原始动作回放 0/1（24.40 s 摔倒）的失败记录保留。签收记录另记扩展矩阵 11/12 工程就绪，但扩展项 FRG-02…05 不在本次验收范围内。参考解只证明名义实例存在可行解；正式 benchmark 收录与他人复现仍待完成。
acceptance.en: Only the original approved G1 reference (g1-space-extraction-0.1.0, approved by the author for formal release on 2026-10-27) is accepted: 3/3 fresh complete successes of the frozen version, with the failed raw action replay (0/1, fell at 24.40 s) kept on record. The sign-off also lists the extension matrix as 11/12 engineering-ready, but the extension items FRG-02…05 are not part of this acceptance. The reference only shows that the nominal instance is solvable; formal benchmark admission and independent-person reproduction remain open.

axes.zh: 已验收的只有名义场景一个 case。设计中本任务预先指定 11 个样本（5 个低层种子改变横向位置、深度与摩擦，5 个高层种子改变转运方向，1 个名义样本），只有名义实例有完整见证，其余为 unknown、不计执行分。
axes.en: Only one case, the nominal scene, is accepted. The design pre-specifies 11 draws for this task (5 low-level seeds varying lateral offset, depth and friction, 5 high-level seeds varying the transport direction, and 1 nominal draw); only the nominal instance has a complete witness, and the rest are unknown and receive no execution credit.

embodiments.zh: Unitree G1，自由基座，Dex3 三指手
embodiments.en: Unitree G1, free base, Dex3 three-finger hands

title.zh: 原版：经正面把手拉出墙角冰箱
title.en: Original: pull the corner refrigerator out by its front handle

conditions.zh: 名义配置。冰箱 8 kg、44 × 44 × 80 cm，正面一根横把手；背面与一侧贴墙、另一侧为固定柜子，间隙 35 mm；地面摩擦 0.16–0.22；目标区在开口前方地面。超时 240 s；物理 200 Hz、控制 50 Hz；参考解读取特权仿真状态。
conditions.en: Nominal configuration. The refrigerator is 8 kg, 44 × 44 × 80 cm, with one transverse front handle; its back and one side face walls and the other side a fixed cabinet, with 35 mm gaps; floor friction 0.16–0.22; the goal zone is on the floor in front of the opening. 240 s timeout; physics at 200 Hz, control at 50 Hz; the reference reads privileged simulator state.

design.zh: 冰箱整体（含把手）须进入目标区、保持直立并由地面支撑，松手后与机器人无接触并静置两秒；不得倾倒或推动墙体和柜子。原地大角度转动需要约 91 mm 侧隙，现有只有 35 mm，只能先拉出。参考专家：侧身建立双脚支撑 → 右手抓正面横把手 → 小幅拉出 → 带接触后退并修正横向位置 → 松手静置。
design.en: The whole refrigerator, handle included, must end inside the goal zone, upright and floor-supported, out of contact with the robot and still for two seconds after release, without tipping it or moving the walls or cabinet. Turning it in place would need about 91 mm of side clearance against the 35 mm available, so it must be pulled out first. Reference expert: sideways double-support stance → right hand grips the front handle → short pull-out → walk backward in contact while correcting lateral position → release and settle.

embodiment.zh: Unitree G1（自由基座）＋Dex3 手
embodiment.en: Unitree G1 (free base) with Dex3 hands

result.zh: 选定见证 43.76 s 完整成功，成功分 100，高层 → 低层 → 轨迹三层映射独立复核通过；固定结构接触 0 N，机器人最大倾斜约 14.3°。固定版本新运行 3/3 成功；原始动作开环回放 0/1，于 24.40 s 摔倒。
result.en: The selected witness succeeds completely in 43.76 s with success score 100, and its high-level → low-level → trajectory mappings pass independent audit; fixed-structure contact is 0 N and maximum robot tilt about 14.3 degrees. Fresh runs of the frozen version succeed 3/3; the open-loop raw action replay fails 0/1, falling at 24.40 s.

summary.zh: 自由基座 Unitree G1（Dex3 手）要从带顶盖的 45 mm 水平窄缝深处取出小盒子。G1 腕部比窄缝宽，正面直接伸手够不到，须抓起台面上的自由钩杆，控制工具位姿越过目标后分段回拉，再把盒子完整放入台面目标区并脱离。考察工具获取、工具位姿控制以及可达性与碰撞推理。
summary.en: A free-base Unitree G1 with Dex3 hands must retrieve a small box from deep inside a roofed 45 mm horizontal slot. The G1 wrist is wider than the slot, so a straight frontal reach cannot get there; the robot must pick up a free hook tool from the table, steer it past the target, pull back in stages, then leave the box fully inside a tabletop goal zone and disengage. The task tests tool acquisition, tool pose control, and reachability and collision reasoning.

acceptance.zh: 只有原始已批准的 G1 参考（g1-space-extraction-0.1.0，2026-10-27 作者批准正式发布）计入验收，并须同时披露其局限：固定版本新运行仅 1/3 完整成功，早期批次 0/3；原始动作回放 0/1（4.86 s 摔倒）。签收记录另记扩展矩阵 14/15 工程就绪，但扩展项 SLR-02…08 不在本次验收范围内。该参考证明名义实例存在可行解，不代表控制器稳定；正式 benchmark 收录与他人复现仍待完成。
acceptance.en: Only the original approved G1 reference (g1-space-extraction-0.1.0, approved by the author for formal release on 2026-10-27) is accepted, and its limits must be disclosed with it: fresh runs of the frozen version succeed only 1/3, an earlier cohort 0/3, and the raw action replay fails 0/1 (fell at 4.86 s). The sign-off also lists the extension matrix as 14/15 engineering-ready, but the extension items SLR-02…08 are not part of this acceptance. The reference shows the nominal instance is solvable, not that the controller is robust; formal benchmark admission and independent-person reproduction remain open.

axes.zh: 已验收的只有名义场景一个 case。设计中本任务预先指定 11 个样本（5 个低层种子改变横向位置、深度与摩擦，5 个高层种子改为近端勾回或推到远端出口，1 个名义样本），只有名义实例有完整见证，其余为 unknown、不计执行分。
axes.en: Only one case, the nominal scene, is accepted. The design pre-specifies 11 draws for this task (5 low-level seeds varying lateral offset, depth and friction, 5 high-level seeds switching between pulling back from the near end and pushing out a far exit, and 1 nominal draw); only the nominal instance has a complete witness, and the rest are unknown and receive no execution credit.

title.zh: 原版：钩杆三段短拉取物
title.en: Original: hook retrieval in three short pulls

conditions.zh: 名义配置。35 mm、60 g 黄色小盒子位于 0.60 m 高台面上的窄缝深处；窄缝宽 45 mm、净高约 160 mm、长 0.50 m，两侧与顶盖固定；台面上放有一根 0.46 m 自由钩杆；摩擦 0.28–0.40。超时 240 s；物理 200 Hz、控制 50 Hz；参考解读取特权仿真状态。
conditions.en: Nominal configuration. A 35 mm, 60 g yellow box sits deep inside a slot on a 0.60 m work surface; the slot is 45 mm wide, about 160 mm high and 0.50 m long, with fixed sides and roof; a free 0.46 m hook tool lies on the table; friction 0.28–0.40. 240 s timeout; physics at 200 Hz, control at 50 Hz; the reference reads privileged simulator state.

design.zh: 盒子须完整放入台面目标区，由台面支撑、与机器人和工具均无接触并静置两秒；不得掉落，不得移动固定结构。G1 腕部内切球直径约 52.37 mm，大于 45 mm 缝宽，正面直接伸手不可达（只覆盖正面直伸，不是全局证明）。参考专家：抓起钩杆并拇指对握 → 在入口外校正位姿 → 越过目标后下落勾住 → 最多三段短拉，段间放开由台面支撑的目标并后退 0.12 m 换位 → 脱离并静置。
design.en: The box must end fully inside the tabletop goal zone, supported by the table, out of contact with robot and tool and still for two seconds, without dropping it or moving the fixed structure. The G1 wrist's inscribed sphere (about 52.37 mm) exceeds the 45 mm slot, so a straight frontal reach is excluded (this covers only frontal reaching, not a global proof). Reference expert: grasp the hook with thumb opposition → correct its pose outside the entrance → pass beyond the target and drop the hook behind it → at most three short pulls, releasing the table-supported box and stepping back 0.12 m between pulls → disengage and settle.

tools.zh: 0.46 m 自由钩杆（钩头高 50 mm，约 0.24 kg）

result.zh: 选定见证 136.66 s 完整成功，成功分 100，三层映射独立复核通过；固定结构最大接触约 12.6 N，机器人最大倾斜约 14.6°。固定版本新运行仅 1/3 成功，早期批次 0/3；原始动作开环回放 0/1，于 4.86 s 摔倒。这是可行解见证，不是稳健控制器。
result.en: The selected witness succeeds completely in 136.66 s with success score 100 and passes independent three-level mapping audit; peak fixed-structure contact is about 12.6 N and maximum robot tilt about 14.6 degrees. Fresh runs of the frozen version succeed only 1/3 and an earlier cohort 0/3; the open-loop raw action replay fails 0/1, falling at 4.86 s. This is a feasibility witness, not a robust controller.
